### What is ETHTokyo?

ETHTokyo is a Tokyo-based Ethereum community and coordination layer, bringing together builders, researchers, artists, founders, institutions, public-goods contributors, and independent communities around a shared cypherpunk ethos and optimism for the future.

We exist to advance the development, adoption, and cultural relevance of Ethereum from Tokyo - through credible, open, permissionless spaces for people building the next generation of programmable, verifiable, and privacy-preserving systems. Our role is to help Ethereum in Tokyo become more connected, credible, permissionless, and alive - not through one venue or one official narrative, but through a city-wide network of people and events.

ETHTokyo Week 2026 will take place from September 19 to 27, featuring community-led events, conferences, workshops, meetups, dinners, hackathons, and other Ethereum-adjacent gatherings across Tokyo.

### JPYC Marche in Shibuya

Shibuya Konno Daini Building, 3-6-14 Shibuya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo 150-0002, Japan

### Shop with JPYC in the heart of Shibuya

Experience JPYC in the real world at a one-night marketplace in Shibuya, where you can buy actual products using Japan's yen-denominated stablecoin.

From cosmetics and tiramisu to card games, wooden smart business cards, and original goods, meet local creators and experience simple QR-code payments firsthand.

New to JPYC? No problem. Staff will be available to help first-time users get started.

### What to expect

- Get one raffle entry with every JPYC purchase for a chance to win movie tickets

### Before you arrive

HashPort Wallet is recommended for first-time users: https://wallet.hashport.com

JPYC can be obtained through JPYC EX. Identity verification and Japanese bank account registration are required: https://faq.jpyc.co.jp/s/article/jpycex-getting-started

### Event details

- Address: Shibuya Konno Daini Building, 3-6-14 Shibuya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo

### Organizers

Organized by the JPYC Marche Executive Committee, led by mameta ( https://x.com/mameta_zk ). Hosted by SHIBUYA Q DAO (SQD).

This event is independently organized and is not official content of JPYC Inc.

### ZuCity Japan Annual Popup City

ZuCity is a permanent Zuzalu hub. Our own cryptocity - codename Brooklyn 2.0 - built from abandoned houses we bought and brought back to life in Komoro, Nagano an hour by train from Tokyo. Join this month long coliving to get hands on experience with building public goods infrastructure, meet local Japanese communities, learn how to buy and fix your own houses in Japan like we do,

### Agentic Summit

AIエージェントが自律的に取引・決済・交渉する経済の到来を見据え、それを安全に設計し検証するための信頼基盤 ── 認証・認可・安全性・監査可能性 ── を問う一日。ETHTokyo Week 2026 の中核、ETHGlobal Tokyo 公式サイドイベント。

### PRIVACY SERVE

〒150-0043 Tokyo, Shibuya, Dōgenzaka, 1-chōme-22-７ 道玄坂ピア 1F 東京都渋谷区道玄坂 1-22-7 道玄坂ピア1F

What does privacy look like when it becomes something people can actually use?

Join zERC20 and Swarm Foundation for an informal afternoon around privacy, decentralized infrastructure, and the people building both.

We're bringing together builders, researchers, founders and privacy-minded people in Tokyo to celebrate the launch of zERC20 V2, meet like-minded people, and create space for useful conversations that can turn into actual collaborations.

zERC20 is building private ERC-20 transfers designed to work with the wallets and tokens people already use, while Swarm is building decentralized storage and communication infrastructure for a more resilient internet.

Throughout the afternoon, both teams will host informal Privacy Office Hours. If you're working on something relevant, have an integration in mind, want to explore a proposal, need technical input, or simply want to understand where the two ecosystems could intersect, come and speak directly with the people building them.

It's a space to exchange ideas, find potential collaborators, talk through real use cases, and meet others thinking seriously about privacy and decentralized infrastructure on Ethereum.

We'll also have specialty coffee and matcha, time to stay for a while, and a chance to celebrate zERC20 V2 entering the wild.

zERC20とSwarm Foundationが主催する、プライバシー、分散型インフラ、そしてそれらを構築する人々をテーマにした、気楽な午後の集いにぜひご参加ください。

東京にビルダー、研究者、創業者、そしてプライバシーに関心を持つ人々を集め、zERC20 V2のリリースを祝い、志を同じくする人々と出会い、実際のコラボレーションにつながる有意義な対話の場を設けます。

zERC20は、人々がすでに使用しているウォレットやトークンと連携するように設計された、プライバシー保護機能を備えたERC-20送金システムを構築しています。一方、Swarmは、より強靭なインターネットを実現するための分散型ストレージおよび通信インフラを構築しています。

午後を通して、両チームがカジュアルな「プライバシー・オフィスアワー」を開催します。関連するプロジェクトに取り組んでいる方、統合を検討している方、提案について話し合いたい方、技術的なアドバイスが必要な方、あるいは単に2つのエコシステムがどこで交わる可能性があるのか理解したい方は、ぜひ会場に来て、開発者たちと直接話してみてください。

ここは、アイデアを交換し、協力者を見つけ、実際のユースケースについて話し合い、イーサリアム上のプライバシーや分散型インフラについて真剣に考えている人々と出会える場です。

また、スペシャルティコーヒーや抹茶をご用意しており、ゆっくりとお過ごしいただけるほか、zERC20 V2の正式リリースをお祝いする機会も設けています。

### Ethereum Institutional Summit

A one-day, invitation-only summit in Tokyo for institutional decision-makers and the Ethereum builders shaping the institutional layer of the network.

### ETHGlobal Tokyo

〒105-0001 Tokyo, Minato City, Toranomon, 1 Chome-23-3 虎ノ門ヒルズ森タワー 5F

### Pragma Tokyo

ETHGlobal Pragma is a one-day summit bringing together builders, founders, researchers, and industry leaders shaping the future of Ethereum and web3. Its tightly curated program features high-quality talks, keynotes, product demos, and debates focused on the ecosystem's most important challenges, emerging ideas, and the technologies defining what comes next with a focused audience. Past speakers include Vitalik Buterin (Ethereum), Stani Kulechov (Aave), Nikhil Chandhok (Circle), Hayden Adams (Uniswap), Sergey Nazarov (Chainlink), and Jesse Pollak (Coinbase)

### Ai Psychosis Summit II: Angel Wings

Gettles Bunny quasimatt Kevin Esherick Kitasenju Design MISOSHITA Saeko Ehara Kit Volta Morry Kolman Jon Sarkin Estate | Mark Henderson Sierra Renee Isabel James Concannon Sarah Friend Joshua Wolk Abdou Mika Brennan Wojtyła Dave Krugman

### POST-TOKYO

A week of day raves, onsen trips, yoga and meditation sessions, and intimate chill time at the ZuCity mountain retreat an hour from Tokyo. Come decompress with a curated high-signal, high-vibe group in the center of our own crypto city.

### Hackatsuon 2026

Hackatsuon (a blend of hackathon and katsuo, the bonito that Kesennuma is known for) is a residency and hackathon co-hosted with Kesennuma City, welcoming builders from Japan and abroad.

Kesennuma is a fishing town in the Tohoku region of northeastern Japan, with over $100M in annual catch. Rebuilt after the 2011 earthquake and tsunami, it now faces the same challenges as much of rural Japan - an aging population, depopulation, and a fragile local economy. Cutting-edge technology tends to reach large cities and corporations, but rarely the local governments and communities working on these social challenges. Hackatsuon exists to change that: not a one-off race for prizes, but an invitation to step into a real place, get to know its community, and co-create with the people who live there.

The 2026 residency runs from September 28 to October 11, in Kesennuma.

Live in Kesennuma for the full two weeks. After check-in and orientation (Sep 28), residents dive into community input and fieldwork with city staff (Sep 30 - Oct 1), then form teams and build (from Oct 2), sharing progress at a midpoint review (Oct 4) before final presentations. This is the deepest way to experience Hackatsuon - getting to know the town and its people, and building projects rooted in real local challenges alongside developers from Japan and around the world.

Can't stay for the full two weeks? Join for the hackathon itself, which kicks off on Oct 2 with team formation and development, and continues through the midpoint review on Oct 4. A shorter but hands-on way to team up, build, and be part of the core creative sprint.

- Public showcase (Demo Day & reception) - Oct 10, 2026 @ Pier 7

Open to everyone. Come see what the builders have created at the final presentations, and join the reception to celebrate with the community at Pier 7. No coding required - just curiosity and a willingness to connect.

Whichever way you join, Hackatsuon is where a community rooted in place meets a network that spans the world.

### Urban Transportation

Tokyo is a city optimized for public transportation. Most of the times, the quickest and easiest way to getting from A to B is by trains and buses. If you are staying longer than just a few days, you might want to consider purchasing a SUICA↗︎ or PASMO↗︎ card at for the best experience, which can be obtained at pretty much any train station. You can use these cards to ride the buses also.

Scooters & Bikes : Depending on the area, you will also find scooters and bikes that you can grab around the city, using apps like LUUP↗︎ and LIME↗︎. You should take precaution to stay safe since the streets in Tokyo are generally narrow and crowded.

Taxis : Taxis are available through apps like GO↗︎ and Uber↗︎.

### About the event

For most of the last century, national power was counted in steel, oil, and warheads. In this one it runs on the technologies of money, speech, and compute, the rails beneath economic life and public argument, and now intelligence itself.

If we get this right, America compounds a generational advantage; get it wrong and we cede the century to surveillance, capture, and rivals who have already chosen control.

Who gets access to the most capable systems, and on whose authority?

Does the enormous build-out of energy and compute we need to outpace China become an engine of broad competition, or a set of chokepoints a few firms and agencies can throttle?

Can frontier capability stay open and lawful without being surrendered either to a handful of incumbents or to the most dangerous people online?

### 2026 Speakers

Meet the policymakers, builders, and leaders taking the stage at Freedom Tech DC 2026.

### Last Year's Event

ETHSofia is Bulgaria's premier Ethereum-focused conference, bringing together builders, researchers, and institutions shaping the future of the original smart contract blockchain.

### Conference

The conference takes place on 24 September 2026 at Sofia Tech Park. With a strong regional lens and a global perspective, ETHSofia brings together local leaders and international experts to explore Ethereum trends and use cases, from privacy-preserving infrastructure to real-world asset tokenization.

### Main themes

The program covers onchain privacy and scaling, smart contract security and operations security, consumer DeFi, and Ethereum integrations into Web2 products, delivered by Ethereum teams, service providers, integrating enterprises and security professionals.

### Speakers

Published speakers include Viktor Uzunov (UEB3 Fund), Krum Pashov (Pashov Audit Group), Marc Zeller (Aave Chan Initiative), Nicolas Bacca (Ledger, ZKnox), TokenBrice (Polaris), Klara Kovacevic (ChainSecurity), Jonathan Riss (CertiK), Todor Karaivanov (Chainlink Labs), Mark Richardson (Bancor), Steffen Kux (corpus.core), Josef Gattermayer (ack3) and Vyara Savova (European Ethereum Institute).

### Venue

The John Atanasoff Forum is part of Bulgaria's first science and technology park, surrounded by startups, enterprises, investment funds, a laboratory complex and the Discoverer supercomputer. Tickets are available through Blockchain Week Bulgaria, with speaker, partner and volunteer applications open.

ETHGlobal hackathons enable you to experiment with cutting edge web3 technologies and develop an idea you're passionate about. This is your opportunity to learn about crypto, expand your network, meet industry professionals, and find like-minded people who are collectively creating a new kind of web.

### Tokyo 2026

The Tokyo hackathon runs September 25-27, 2026 at Toranomon Hills Forum, on the fifth floor of Toranomon Hills Mori Tower. The organizer lists $75,000 available in prizes from World, ENS, Uniswap Foundation, 1inch, Sui, Curvegrid and Web3Antivirus.

### Themes and topics

The published tracks include zero knowledge proofs, AI x Crypto, DeFi and crypto consumer applications, Layer 2s and interoperability, public goods, privacy, security and TEEs, data availability, identity and developer tools.

### Building formats

For the first time ever, a project does not have to start at zero. The organizer offers three formats: From Scratch, Extend Open Source, and Ship a Feature. The published rules specify teams of 1-5 members and up to three sponsor SDKs.

### Participation

The event is beginner friendly and includes technical mentorship, curated content, exclusive swag, and free food and drinks. Pragma Tokyo runs as a one-day summit alongside the hackathon week.

### About the event

The Bridge Summit 2026, 서울에서 여러분을 초대합니다

이번 KBW, 9월 28일은 The Bridge Summit에서 함께하세요.

TV조선 × Bridge34가 공동 주최하고, 글로벌 Web3 벤처캐피털 Hack VC가 Main Partner로 함께하는 The Bridge Summit 2026이 오는 9월 28일, 조선 팰리스 서울에서 개최됩니다.

Bridge34

- Bridge34는 글로벌 Web3 프로젝트와 한국 시장을 연결하는 Web3 전문 액셀러레이터이자 마케팅 파트너로, 커뮤니티-미디어-파트너십을 기반으로 국내 Web3 생태계의 성장을 이끌고 있습니다.

TV조선

- TV조선은 대한민국의 주요 종합편성채널로, 폭넓은 미디어 영향력과 콘텐츠 역량을 바탕으로 Web3와 디지털 자산 산업의 대중화를 연결하는 미디어 기업입니다.

Hack VC

- Hack VC는 Web3 및 블록체인 기술에 집중하는 글로벌 벤처캐피털로, 초기 단계부터 유망한 프로젝트와 창업가에 투자하며 차세대 크립토 생태계의 성장을 지원하고 있습니다.

글로벌 Web3 프로젝트부터 기관, 투자자, 미디어, 그리고 한국 커뮤니티까지.

디지털 자산 - AI - 토큰화 금융의 다음 흐름을 만들어가는 플레이어들이 서울에 모입니다.

다양한 세션과 네트워킹, 프로젝트 부스는 물론, 이번 Summit에 참여하는 한국 커뮤니티를 위해 특별한 혜택도 준비되어 있습니다.

이번 The Bridge Summit은

현장을 직접 경험하고 참여하면서 다양한 리워드까지 받아갈 수 있는 컨퍼런스로 준비됩니다.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

> - 관련 정보 또는 서류를 제출하지 않거나 제세공과금 납부가 완료되지 않을 경우 경품 지급이 제한되거나 당첨이 취소될 수 있습니다.

> - 경품 및 리워드의 실제 지급 방식과 일정은 당첨자에게 별도로 안내될 예정입니다.

### 이런 분들을 환영합니다

- XRPL (https://xrpl.org) 및 온체인 AI 인프라에 관심 있는 빌더/개발자
- Agentic payment, x402, MPP, AP2, ACP 등 machine to machine 결제 표준에 관심 있는 분
- 자율 금융 에이전트(autonomous financial agent)의 보안 모델에 관심 있는 리서처/엔지니어
- 블록체인과 t54 생태계 위에서 프로젝트를 구상 중인 빌더
- 웹3 x AI 생태계 네트워킹을 희망하는 분

## Ethereum Korea One 2026

- Record: `premier-ethkorea`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-28T09:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://one.ethereumkorea.io>

### Ethereum Korea One

Two days in Seoul where institutions & builders write Ethereum's next chapter.

같은 체인을 두고 서로 다른 언어를 씁니다.한쪽은 자본과 정책으로, 다른 한쪽은 코드와 커뮤니티로.그 두 대화를 서울에서 잇습니다. One chain, two languages.Two audiences, one city.One speaks in capital and policy,the other in code and community.

### Day 01 - 제도권의 언어The Institutional Voice

토큰화, 스테이블코인, RWA, 디지털 자본시장을 다룹니다. 자산운용사와 은행, 증권사, 정책 입안자가 함께하는 키노트와 라운드테이블로 하루를 채웁니다. Tokenization, stablecoins, RWAs, the digital capital stack. Keynotes and roundtables built for asset managers, banks, brokerages, and regulators.

### Day 02 - 빌더의 언어The Builder Voice

코어 컨트리뷰터부터 이제 막 시작한 프로토콜 팀까지 모입니다. 토크와 패널, 라이트닝 데모, 파이어사이드가 종일 이어지는 한국 빌더 커뮤니티의 하루입니다. From core contributors to emerging protocol teams. Talks, panels, lightning demos, and firesides: a day by and for the Korean builder community.

### 연사 라인업. The lineup

이틀 동안 무대에 오르는 주요 연사입니다. 추가 연사는 확정되는 대로 공개합니다. A main lineup spanning both days. More speakers will be announced on a rolling basis.

### 제도권을 위한 하루 A day for the institutions

자본과 정책이 이더리움을 만나는 자리. 토큰화, 스테이블코인, RWA, 디지털 자본시장. Where capital and policy meet Ethereum. Tokenization, stablecoins, RWAs, digital capital markets.

### 빌더를 위한 하루 A day for the builders

가격 대신 철학과 기술을 말하는 자리입니다. 이더리움 재단이 지원하는 한국 빌더들의 Genesis. Not about price, but philosophy and engineering. Genesis: Korea's builders, backed by the Ethereum Foundation.

### 13팀이 함께Built by thirteen teams

한국 이더리움 생태계를 이끄는 빌더-인프라-리서치 팀들이 공동으로 만듭니다.Co-organized by the builder, infrastructure, and research teams driving Korea's Ethereum ecosystem.

### Event Details / 행사 정보

- Date / 일시: Sep 29th - 30th, 2026 | 09:00 AM - 06:00 PM
- Location / 장소: AT Center, Seoul, South Korea (서울 aT센터)
- Official Website / 공식 웹사이트: www.gwdc.net (https://www.gwdc.net)

Join the Community / 공식 커뮤니티 참여

- GWDC 2026 Telegram Group: t.me/Web3LabsHK (https://t.me/Web3LabsHK)

### About Event / 행사 소개

Following the huge success of our inaugural event in Hong Kong this February, the 2nd Global Web3 Developer Conference 2026 (Global Web3 Dev Con) is officially landing in Seoul, expanding its scale to an unprecedented milestone!

Hosted by Web3Labs, GWDC is Asia's premier developer-focused Web3 summit. Taking place from September 29-30, 2026 (2 days) at the AT Center in Seoul, this mega-edition will champion the ethos of "For Builders, By Builders" on a much grander stage. This year, we are targeting 10,000+ Web3 enthusiasts, 200+ elite global developers, and 100+ tier-1 VCs for deep coding sessions, technical breakthroughs, and high-impact ecosystem exchange.

지난 2월 홍콩에서 성황리에 개최된 첫 대회에 이어, 제2회 글로벌 Web3 개발자 콘퍼런스 2026 (Global Web3 Dev Con)이 전례 없는 역대급 규모로 대한민국 서울에서 개최됩니다!

Web3Labs가 주최하는 GWDC는 아시아 최고의 개발자 중심 Web3 서밋입니다. 2026년 9월 29일부터 30일까지 이틀간 서울 aT센터에서 열리는 이번 대형 서밋은 "For Builders, By Builders(빌더를 위한, 빌더에 의한)"라는 핵심 이념을 더욱 거대한 무대에서 실현합니다. 올해 대회는 10,000명 이상의 Web3 애호가, 200명 이상의 글로벌 엘리트 개발자, 100개 이상의 탑티어 VC가 한자리에 모여 깊이 있는 코딩 세션, 기술적 돌파구 마련, 그리고 영향력 있는 생태계 교류를 펼칠 예정입니다.

Host : Web3Labs

### Event Highlights / 행사 하이라이트

- 10,000+ Mega Summit / 만인 규모의 글로벌 서밋: Connecting 10,000+ attendees worldwide, bringing together foundational layers, applications, and top-tier capitals under one roof. (전 세계 10,000명 이상의 참가자를 연결하고 하위 레이어 공공 체인, 상위 애플리케이션 및 최정상 자본을 한자리에 모으는 메가 서밋입니다.)
- Premier Hackathon / 프리미어 해커톤: 200+ global developers, 50+ breakthrough projects, real-chain tasks + top-tier mentor guidance + institutional VC judging. (200명 이상의 글로벌 개발자, 50개 이상의 혁신적 프로젝트가 참여하며, 퍼블릭 체인 실전 미션, 탑티어 멘토링 및 기관급 VC 심사가 함께 진행됩니다.)
- Global Innovation Exhibition / 글로벌 혁신 프로젝트 전시: 50+ Web3 innovative projects and direct VC matchmaking to accelerate global project launch, liquidity growth, and ecosystem building. (50개 이상의 혁신적인 Web3 프로젝트의 현장 노출 및 VC 직접 매칭을 통해 프로젝트의 글로벌 출시와 생태계 구축을 가속화합니다.)

### Speakers & Agenda / 연사 및 아젠다

Confirmed Speakers & VIP Guests / 참석 확정 연사 및 VIP 라인업

- (More featured speakers will be announced continuously / 추가 연사 라인업은 지속적으로 업데이트될 예정입니다)

### Agenda Focus Themes / 핵심 아젠다 하이라이트

- AI Agents & Autonomous Payments / AI 에이전트 및 온체인 자율 경제 Exploring how AI agents utilize stablecoins for automated micro-payments to power a frictionless decentralized economy. (AI 에이전트가 스테이블코인을 활용해 자율 미세 결제를 수행하며 마찰 없는 탈중앙화 경제를 촉진하는 방향을 모색합니다.)
- DePIN Commercialization / DePIN(탈중앙화 물리적 인프라 네트워크) 상용화 Driving real-world enterprise demand, revenue scaling, and sustainable token-burn mechanisms for hardware networks. (하드웨어 및 컴퓨팅 네트워크의 실제 기업 수요 창출, 매출 확장 및 지속 가능한 토큰 소각 메커니즘을 집중 조명합니다.)
- Tokenomics 2.0 / 토크노믹스 2.0 및 실질 수익 Shifting the paradigm from inflationary narratives to sustainable on-chain revenue models and fee-sharing mechanisms. (단순 내러티브와 인플레이션 덫에서 벗어나 온체인 바이백, 소각 및 수수료 분배를 통한 지속 가능한 실질 수익 모델에 주목합니다.)
- RWA & Institutional Capital / RWA(실물자산) 및 기관급 금융 Bringing traditional assets like T-bills and private credit on-chain to unlock deep liquidity and DeFi composability. (국채 및 사모 신용 등 실물자산을 토큰화하여 깊은 유동성을 확보하고 디파이(DeFi)와의 유기적 결합을 추진합니다.)
- Modular Infra & Restaking / 모듈러 인프라 및 리스테이킹 생태계 Advancing the frontiers of shared security, modular scalability, and seamless omnichain interoperability. (기술적 돌파구를 깊이 있게 다루며 모듈러 블록체인, 리스테이킹 및 옴니체인 상호운용성 네트워크의 공유 보안 진화를 탐구합니다.)
- Prediction Markets & Derivatives / 예측 시장 및 탈중앙화 파생상품 Analyzing the structural growth of on-chain prediction aggregators and next-generation crypto derivatives. (온체인 예측 시장의 기하급수적 성장 트렌드와 차세대 탈중앙화 무기한 선물(Perp DEX) 및 파생상품 도구의 진화를 분석합니다.)

## Crypto Compliance and Legal Roundtable, hosted by Solidus Labs and Yulchon

- Record: `premier-solidusroundtable`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)

### About the event

Crypto Compliance & Legal Roundtable | Seoul

Join us on September 29 during the Korea Blockchain Week in Seoul for an exclusive, invitation-only Crypto Compliance and Legal Roundtable, bringing together a selected group of compliance and legal leaders, regulators, and policy experts.

Hosted by Solidus Labs and Yulchon, this in-person session will focus on advancing global crypto compliance through practical discussion. The roundtable is designed to foster open dialogue, share best practices, and identify actionable solutions to today's most pressing regulatory and compliance challenges.

### Agenda

16:30 - Registration

17:00 - 18:30- Roundtable discussions: Best practices, challenges, and actionable solutions across key crypto compliance and legal topics, including:

- Tokenization and Implementation of the amended Capital Markets Act and Electronic Securities Act
  - How the recently enacted framework will be implemented in practice, including issuance, distribution and the treatment of investment contract securities.
    - Speaker: Ik Hyun Kim, Partner at Yulchon leading the blockchain and digital assets practice
- Cross-border VASP compliance -
  - Korea's planned extension of the Travel Rule to transfers below KRW 1 million
  - Growing regulatory focus on foreign and unregistered VASPs.
  - Stablecoins transfers and future challenges.
    - Speaker: Claire Lee, CEO of CODE
- Unfair Coin Trading Regulatory Frameworks in Korea
  - Overview of actual prosecution and referral cases over the past two years to examine the rankings of the most prevalent types of unfair trading practices and sheds light on the specific schemes and deceptive methods unique to the Korean virtual asset market
    - Speakers: Jackie Baek, Compliance Head of Korea at Crypto.com (https://Crypto.com)

18:30 - Networking

Address: Yulchon, Parnas Tower, 38F 521 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu Seoul Republic of Korea

Places are limited. Registration is subject to approval.

### About Yulchon

Yulchon is a full-service law firm headquartered in Seoul, Korea, advising on a full range of specialized practice areas, including corporate & finance, antitrust, tax, real estate & construction, dispute resolution, intellectual property & technology, and labor & employment. The firm was established in 1997 and has about 700 professionals. In addition to our main offices in Seoul, Yulchon has six overseas offices across five jurisdictions and 10 regional practice teams worldwide. The firm provides the highest quality of legal services to its clients around the globe, including their most complex legal matters.

Yulchon's Blockchain/Virtual Assets Team consists of seasoned experts who bring a wealth of experience and exceptional knowledge to deliver the highest standard of legal services in Korea's finance, blockchain, and virtual asset sectors.

### About Solidus Labs

Born in crypto and built for efficiency across all asset classes, Solidus Labs is the category-definer for agentic-based compliance in trade surveillance and risk monitoring. At its core is HALO, an AI-powered, risk-based platform trusted globally by financial institutions, crypto firms, and regulators to enable proactive, intelligence-led oversight across any product, venue, or asset class.

### Program

Explore tokenized securities, institutional DeFi, digital exchanges, trading infrastructure, and the evolution of programmable financial markets, with workshops, panels, and summit tracks throughout both days.

### Speakers

Leading voices in technology at CV Summit 2026 include Christopher Perkins, Manuel Klein, Dr. Alexander Thoma, Emilio Anting, Mathias Imbach, Catherine Chen, Serge Kaulitz and Jonas Epp, among others.

### Tickets

The standard ticket covers both days of the conference. The VIP experience adds curated extras for leaders, and groups buy three standard tickets and get one free. Exhibition stands to VIP dinners are available for sponsors.

Bridge Seoul (https://bridge-seoul.com) 2026은 웨이브릿지가 코리아 블록체인 위크 기간에 여는 기관 대상 초청 컨퍼런스입니다. 10월 1일, 여의도에서 국내 금융기관과 정책 담당자, 해외 디지털자산 기업이 한자리에 모입니다.

올해 한국 시장은 세 가지 변화를 동시에 지나고 있습니다. 현물 ETF, 디지털자산기본법, 원화 스테이블코인. 기관 자금이 들어올 통로가 하나씩 열리는 중입니다. Bridge Seoul은 그 통로를 실제로 만들고 있는 사람들이 모여, 지금 무엇이 가능하고 무엇이 남았는지 이야기하는 자리입니다.

- 장소: 여의도 (참석 승인 후 위치 공개)
- 진행 언어: 한국어, 영어

■ Audience

현재 움직이고 있는 금융기관, 가상자산 사업자, 정책 입안자, 그리고 한국 내 영향력을 키워가는 글로벌 Web3까지, 이 곳에는 대한민국의 디지털자산 지도를 지금 그려가는 사람들만이 모입니다. 이 곳에서 그려지는 좌표가 곧 한국 디지털자산 경제 지도의 좌표가 될 것입니다.

금융기관 60% - 기업 및 기관 20% - 글로벌 디지털자산 기업 10% - 정책 및 미디어 10%

■ 지난 행사

웨이브릿지가 주최해 온 기관 컨퍼런스는 지난 3년간 1,000명이 넘는 참석자와 200개 이상의 기관이 함께했습니다. 지난해 Golden Wave 2025는 매일경제TV와 공동 주최로 여의도에서 약 400명 규모로 열렸고, Lily Liu(Solana Foundation), Tony Acuña-Rohter(EDX Markets), Yesha Yadav(Vanderbilt University), 민병덕 국회의원이 연사로 참여했습니다. 그 여정이 2026년, Bridge Seoul로 이어집니다.

■ 주최사

웨이브릿지는 기관 대상 디지털자산 매매-수탁 플랫폼 '웨이브릿지 프라임'을 운영하는 가상자산사업자입니다. 스테이블코인 결제, 비트코인 현물 ETF 프라임 브로커리지, 국경 간 송금과 무역 결제를 다룹니다.

■ 등록 안내

티켓 판매는 하지 않습니다. 등록해 주시면 순차적으로 검토해 이메일로 승인 결과를 안내드립니다. 좌석은 250석이며, 정원이 차면 등록을 받지 못할 수 있습니다. 프로그램과 연사는 사정에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다.

bridge-seoul.com (https://bridge-seoul.com) / bridge_seoul@wavebridge.com

Bridge Seoul (https://bridge-seoul.com) 2026 is Wavebridge's invitation-only conference for institutions, held during Korea Blockchain Week. On the afternoon of October 1, Korea's financial institutions, policymakers, and global digital-asset firms gather in one room at Yeouido.

Three shifts are moving through the Korean market at once: spot ETFs, the Digital Asset Basic Act, and the KRW stablecoin. One by one, the channels for institutional capital are opening. Bridge Seoul brings together the people actually building those channels, to talk about what is possible today and what still has to be solved.

■ Event Details

- Date: Thursday, October 1, 2026, 1:00 PM to 6:00 PM KST
- Languages: Korean and English
- Capacity: 250 guests, by invitation and approval
- Host: Wavebridge
- Media Partner: Maeil Business TV

■ Speakers

- Opening Remarks
  Byoung-Dug Min, National Assembly
  Eun-Seok Choi, National Assembly
  Jong-hyun Kim, Chairman, Korea Fintech Industry Association

  Seongkwan Yoon, Bank of Korea

  Samsung Asset Management - Hanwha Asset Management - KB Securities - Meritz Securities - BC Card - K Bank - Kakao Bank - Kim & Chang - Shin & Kim - KODA - FnGuide

■ Program

- 13:50 Opening keynote.
  Korea's Digital Asset Market: The Next Five Years
- 14:05 Session 1
  Asset Managers' Digital Asset Strategy: From ETFs to Stablecoins
- 14:45 Session 2

■ Who Attends

It brings together only those drawing Korea's digital asset map right now: the financial institutions, virtual asset operators, and policymakers already in motion, along with the global Web3 players building real influence in Korea. The coordinates drawn on this day will become the coordinates of Korea's digital asset economy itself.

Financial institutions 60% - Corporates and institutions 20% - Global digital-asset firms 10% - Policy and media 10%

■ Track Record

Wavebridge has hosted institutional conferences for three years, drawing more than 1,000 attendees from over 200 organizations. Last year's Golden Wave 2025 gathered roughly 400 guests in Yeouido, co-hosted with Maekyung Business TV. Speakers included Lily Liu (Solana Foundation), Tony Acuña-Rohter (EDX Markets), Yesha Yadav (Vanderbilt University), and Assemblyman Min Byoung-dug.

■ About the Host

Wavebridge is a registered virtual-asset service provider operating Wavebridge Prime, a digital-asset trading and custody platform for institutions. Its business covers stablecoin payments, Bitcoin spot ETF prime brokerage, and cross-border remittance and trade settlement.

### About the event

Title Sponsor: Top Node, S&P Global

Co-Hosts: Pharos Network, Four Pillars, LayerZero

Organizer: Asia Stablecoin Alliance, The Capital Summit

### Understand the Diverse Asia

Asia is not a single market.

Korea, Japan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Southeast Asia, the UAE, and other markets are each developing their own approach to stablecoins, tokenization, digital money, and financial infrastructure. These approaches are shaped by different regulations, institutions, currencies, payment needs, and capital market structures.

That's why ASA Conference 2026 is returning to Seoul on October 1, 2026 to bring these conversations into one dedicated forum!

In 2025, ASA Conference brought together 700+ builders, issuers, institutions, infrastructure providers, researchers, and policymakers in Seoul. Across 17 sessions, teams including LayerZero, Ethena, Wyoming Stable Token, Canton, Securitize, and Plume explored how Asian stablecoins could move from concept to adoption.

This year's conference goes deeper by moving from the big picture to the market level. ASA Conference 2026 will look at each market on its own terms, examining the issuers, distributors, institutions, use cases, and infrastructure shaping how new forms of money move across Asia.

The program will explore key topics including:

- Stablecoin issuance and distribution
- Local currency stablecoins
- Tokenized deposits and CBDCs
- Tokenization and real-world assets
- Cross-border payments and settlement
- Institutional adoption
- Regulation, compliance, and market infrastructure
- The role of banks, fintechs, payment firms, asset managers, issuers, and policymakers in shaping Asia's digital money future

If you are building, investing, regulating, researching, or operating in stablecoins, tokenization, payments, or digital financial infrastructure across Asia, ASA Conference 2026 is designed for you.

Join us in Seoul on October 1, 2026.

Understand the Diverse Asia.

### About The Capital Summit

The Capital Summit is a curated institutional forum focused on how capital markets move onchain. It brings together investors, asset managers, banks, family offices, and infrastructure builders working at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets.

The summit exists to connect institutional capital with the people building onchain financial infrastructure - not as a trade show, but as a focused forum where allocators, operators, and builders meet across Asia and beyond.

### About Asia Stablecoin Alliance

The Asia Stablecoin Alliance (ASA) is an initiative to accelerate stablecoin adoption across Asia. ASA connects builders, institutions, regulators, researchers, and ecosystem participants working on stablecoin infrastructure, compliance, distribution, and real-world use cases.

The alliance exists to give Asia its own voice, perspective, and coordination in stablecoin innovation. It is not a top down authority, but a network of people working together to move the ecosystem forward.

### About the event

network, learn & leisue - bitcoin retreat comes back with season 4!

It's not a conference. It's not a business trip.It's a one-week tropical reset with Bitcoiners from around the world - diving, tennis, open mics, barbecues, workshops, and sunset beers... all in the most Bitcoin-friendly jurisdiction on Earth - Próspera on Roatan.

Coliving with fellow Bitcoiners in one of the world's most exciting experiments - Próspera special economic zone.

Activities to fill your days: diving, sailing, yoga, sports, BBQ nights, pool parties.

Community stage: open mic, lightning talks and debates about the future of Bitcoin and freedom.

Island exploration - hidden beaches, local food spots, and off-the-map adventures.

A soft landing into Próspera - meet residents, explore business opportunities, and find out what's up there.

Freedom to chill - no rigid agenda. The week has a rhythm, but plenty of space for serendipity.

curious about Próspera digital nomads & entrepreneurs creators, builders & free spirits who go with the flow

party-tourists complainers and freeloaders s****ners and control freaks people allergic to new ideas

Every Bitchill is different, but every is full of activities, networking, tourism, education and chill. Agenda of the upcoming retreat is shaped at published at the Bitchill Plan page.Find below, what type of activities are usually arranged during Bitchill:

Wellness: breathwork workshops, meditation sessions, cold plunge, yoga, longevity clinic visit

From the US: Direct flights from Houston, Miami, Atlanta, Dallas.

From Europe: Via US hubs or San Salvador (San Pedro Sula or Tegucigalpa).

To Plan B (San Salvador): Commercial flights through SAP ($350) or direct charter to Roatán arranged (700,000 sat)

Come for as long as you want! Monthly options are also available.Feel free to find accomodation on your own.

Bitchill is not your typical Bitcoin conference or networking trip. It's a week or longer Bitcoin retreat in the Caribbean, designed for builders, creators, and free spirits who want to recharge while connecting with like-minded people. Instead of endless panels in hotel ballrooms, you'll spend your days diving in crystal-clear waters, joining open mic sessions, playing tennis or golf, and sharing barbecues and beers at sunset.

At the same time, Bitchill gives you a soft landing into Próspera, the world's most Bitcoin-friendly jurisdiction, where you'll meet residents, explore business opportunities, and see firsthand how life on Roatán blends tropical ease with frontier innovation.

Tickets are priced in Bitcoin (sats) and give you access to the full Bitchill experience.The base ticket (200,000 sats) covers:

- Selected group activities - BBQ nights, pool parties, yoga sessions, open mic talks, and intro experiences
- Full logistical support - we help arrange travel, pickups, and make sure your stay is smooth
- Community integration - meet residents, explore Próspera, and get introduced to the Bitcoin District

Accommodation is not included in the base ticket, so you can choose the housing that best fits your vibe and budget. Prices are for one full week:

- Studio: 90,000 sats/night - private, spacious, ideal for couples

Staying longer? Many participants extend their visit and turn Bitchill into a month-long immersion in Caribbean life and Próspera's Bitcoin-first community. We can help arrange that too.

- Daily meals (except special group events like welcome brunch or BBQ nights)
- Optional extras such as premium tours or diving certifications

Bitchill is non-profit - every satoshi collected (and often a few more) goes directly into covering accommodation, activities, and event costs.

Próspera is a special economic zone on Roatán, Honduras, built as a hub for innovation, entrepreneurship, and freedom. It's one of the first places on Earth where Bitcoin is recognized as legal tender, and where you can set up a business, pay taxes, and live fully on a Bitcoin standard.

During Bitchill, you'll meet residents of the zone, tour the facilities, and learn about opportunities ranging from Caribbean real estate to Bitcoin-friendly company incorporation. Many attendees come away seeing not just a retreat, but a glimpse into what a freer future could look like.

Roatán itself is a tropical paradise: white sand beaches, world-class diving, and a relaxed Caribbean vibe. Unlike mainland Honduras, it's safe and designed for international visitors, with a growing expat and Bitcoin community.

Bitchill isn't just a vacation - it's your entry point into the Bitcoin District in Próspera. This is where Bitcoiners are building a neighborhood and an ecosystem powered by freedom and Bitcoin. You'll meet locals, see opportunities in residency, business, and real estate, and experience firsthand what it means to live free on Bitcoin in a pioneering jurisdiction.

January is one of the best months to be on Roatán. It sits right after the rainy season and just as the island shifts into its clearest, breeziest, most comfortable period.

- Very little rain - you might get a short shower, but it's quick and refreshing
- Excellent diving conditions - January typically brings clear water and calmer seas

In short: perfect tropical winter escape. Warm, sunny, and reliable - without the unpredictable downpours of late fall.

If rain happens, it's usually a brief shower that clears the air and opens up beautiful sunsets. All outdoor activities (beach fires, boat trips, tennis, snorkeling) run normally this time of year.

Meals are self-organized, giving you the freedom to explore the island's food scene. Roatán has everything from local Honduran street food like baleadas to fresh seafood grills and high-end Caribbean restaurants. Many places in Próspera accept Bitcoin payments via Lightning, while USD cash is widely accepted elsewhere. Group meals are part of the program, too.

Roatán (RTB) has direct international flights from Houston, Miami, Atlanta, Denver, Belize and Guatemala City. Plus great domestic connection in San Pedro Sula.

We'll be there with pickups, transfers, and local guidance so you never feel lost.

Yes. Most participants are digital nomads or entrepreneurs, so reliable internet is a must. Coliving spaces have solid WiFi, and we also provide SIM backups and Starlink.

There are coworking sessions at the Bitcoin Center in Próspera, but you're always free to work from your villa terrace, the café, or anywhere else.

Roatán is a Caribbean island that welcomes thousands of international tourists every year. It's much safer than mainland Honduras, with a strong expat community and infrastructure designed for visitors.

That said, it's still a developing country: you'll want to be mindful like anywhere else in Latin America. We'll guide you on the do's and don'ts, and you'll feel comfortable moving around.

Both. Bitchill is about freedom, Bitcoin, and community, but it's also about sunbeds, cocktails, and beach barbecues. You'll leave with a tan, new friends, and fresh ideas for building a freer future.

The week is designed to reset your mind and spirit while also giving you exposure to one of the most exciting experiments in governance and Bitcoin adoption anywhere in the world.

### August 17-22, 2026

Week-long builder-first event for people who want to build and launch real Bitcoin projects. Hackathon X workshops X vibes

### every month

Onboarding weekend with workshops, island exploration, networking dinners, accommodation, transportation, and food.

### any time

Come to Roatán anytime, or bring your team for a retreat! We'll tailor and organize your visit for a seamless experience.

### A place to live free

Join us for business opportunities, networking, events, networking, sovereign lifestyle and a free life.

- Record: `premier-token2049-origins-2026`

### Access

Access the world's largest crypto event. Connect with 25,000 attendees, media, and industry leaders shaping Web3.

### Build

Take your idea from concept to working product in 36 hours. Free meals, rest zones, and snacks keep you locked in.

### Demo

Build in DeFi, infrastructure, NFTs, or AI. Get mentorship. Demo on the TOKEN2049 stage to 25,000 attendees.

### Win

Compete for prizes, grants, and accelerator spots. Pitch for funding and global recognition.

### Multichain Infrastructure Challenge

Build a working Web3 product using NOWNodes blockchain infrastructure.

### Best Use of Solana

Build on Solana and turn your idea into a working onchain product.

### Is there a registration fee?

The event is 100% free - including food, drinks, and full access to the TOKEN2049 conference.

### Does TOKEN2049 cover Travel or Accommodation?

No. TOKEN2049 does not cover flights, visa fees, or accommodation. You are responsible for arranging your own travel and stay in Singapore.

### Who Should Apply?

Origins is built for people who ship. This is for you if you are:

### Will there be rest areas at the venue?

Yes. Rest and chill-out spaces are available on a first-come, first-served basis. However, there are no shower facilities at the venue, so we recommend booking comfortable accommodation nearby.

### Do I need to be physically present?

Yes. Physical attendance at Marina Bay Sands in Singapore is required for the full 36 hours. We do not offer online or remote participation.

### Can you help with Visa invitation letters?

Yes. Confirmed participants who need a visa invitation letter can request one once they are accepted. We'll issue a letter to support your visa application.

### Can I apply as an individual?

Yes. Solo applicants are welcome. If you'd like to join a team but don't have one, we'll help you find a team.

### Can I start working on my project before the event beings?

No. To maintain fairness, all project work must begin after the official hacking period starts. You can brainstorm ideas, but no code, designs, or prototypes before kickoff.

### About the event

TOKEN2049 Singapore 2026 runs 7-8 October 2026 at Marina Bay Sands, taking over all five floors of the venue for its biggest edition yet.

### Scale

The organizer expects 25,000+ attendees from 160+ countries, 7,000+ companies, 300+ speakers and 500+ exhibitors, with over 60% of attendees at C-level and more than 1,000 side events across the week.

### Program

Alongside the main stages, the week includes the NEXUS startup competition (500 applicants, 10 finalists pitching on the global stage for equity-free prizes), the TOKEN2049 Origins hackathon (36 hours from concept to working product, with mentorship and a shot at prizes, funding and global recognition), and the Startup Village exhibition area where startups showcase to founders, investors, builders and decision-makers from across the industry.

### Festival and side events

The organizer markets the Singapore edition as a festival and, on its site, invites attendees to experience a "pop-up city" of immersive experiences under one roof at Marina Bay Sands - experiential branding, not a literal temporary city. More than 1,000 side events run across the wider conference week. The official closing party, AFTER2049, returns to the MBS SkyPark on 9 October with Claptone headlining 57 floors above ground, joined by Crusy and residents ANONM, Leon, Milam and Mo-Shi, with 360-degree spatial audio by Polygon Live.

### Tickets

Tickets are on sale now, currently listed at US$599 before the 24 September price increase, payable by credit card or crypto. Get 10% off with our code HASHTAGWEB3.

### Who attends

Founders, investors, developers, exchange and protocol teams, institutions, policymakers and media - anyone shaping the global crypto industry. As Binance founder Changpeng Zhao puts it, it is where everybody comes together and the most important conversations happen.

### Speakers

Selected speakers include Shayne Coplan (Polymarket), Balaji Srinivasan (The Network State), Arthur Hayes (Maelstrom), Adena Friedman (Nasdaq), Richard Teng (Binance), Joseph Lubin (Ethereum / MetaMask), Charles Hoskinson (Input Output Group), Justin Sun (TRON) and Max Verstappen (Oracle Red Bull Racing).

See the [official speaker directory](https://www.token2049.com/singapore/speakers) for the full roster.

### The TokenisationLandscape

Tokenisation is reshaping every sector. From decentralised finance and creator economies to enterprise supply chains and public infrastructure, distributed ledger technology is delivering measurable results today.

### Real-World Assets

From bonds and equities to real estate, tokenisation is enabling fractional ownership, 24/7 settlement, and dramatically lower transaction costs across global markets.

### DeFi & Digital Finance

Decentralised finance protocols are reshaping lending, trading, and payments -- creating open, permissionless financial infrastructure accessible to everyone.

### Supply Chain & Provenance

Blockchain verifies product origin, reduces fraud, and gives consumers transparent, tamper-proof records from source to shelf.

### Digital Identity

Blockchain-backed digital IDs and verifiable credentials are giving individuals control over their data while reducing identity fraud across sectors.

### Creator Economy & IP

Artists, musicians, and creators are using tokenisation to monetise work directly, manage royalties transparently, and build new models of community ownership.

### Public Sector & Infrastructure

From land registries to healthcare records, governments and institutions are adopting tokenisation to improve transparency, reduce costs, and modernise public services.

### Fourth edition in Mumbai

After three landmark editions in Bangalore, the conference moves to Mumbai, India's financial capital, for its fourth edition: closer to capital, institutions and the conversations shaping the next phase of growth.

### Program

The week features more than 50 side events alongside flagship conferences such as the IBW Conference, Devcon and EthGlobal, with hackathons, lounges, investor dinners, workshops, networking sessions and community parties hosted by Indian and global ecosystem players.

### Passes

General passes cover two conference days with the IBW Connect app and expo access. Priority adds the Fairmont lunch buffet and Institutional Forum eligibility. VIP adds the lounge and the pre-conference VIP dinner night, with an Executive tier adding a Fairmont stay and transfers, plus student passes with workshop and hackathon access. Prices exclude GST.

### Who attends

The audience mix spans builders and developers, founders and CEOs, protocol and project teams, investors and capital, policy and institutions, and media and ecosystem contributors.

### Speakers

Confirmed speakers for IBW2026 are announced on the organizer's speakers page, with more to be added closer to the event.

Past editions of India Blockchain Week have featured Vitalik Buterin (Ethereum), Sandeep Nailwal (Polygon), Jesse Pollak (Base), Sreeram Kannan (Eigen Labs), Avery Ching (Aptos Labs), Charles Guillemet (Ledger), Keone Hon (Monad Foundation), Kelvin Koh (Spartan Group), Vishal Kankani (Multicoin Capital), Yusuf Goolamabbas (Animoca Brands), Ashish Singhal (CoinSwitch) and Sumit Gupta (CoinDCX), among others.

### Activation

Special rituals help us to share Cypherpunk culture & build care for each other.

They are activists, developers, cryptographers, ethical investors, philosophers, and researchers who are changing the possibilities for Ethereum on the path to freedom.

Hackathon track

Events for developers are critical activation points behind any cultural change. Every protocol from Aztec to Ethereum needs devs to build on top of it & deliver decentralized, permissionless & privacy-enhancing applications. We invited current privacy hackathon devs to reflect on their experience.

Women in web3 privacy track

Diversity in the web3 industry is a critical challenge, let alone in the privacy market. Let's discuss how we can be more open, diverse & inclusive to different opinions and opportunities.

Activation track

We want everyone to feel, use and contribute to practical privacy tooling. So we will showcase existing tools empowering your journey in decentralized world: Fileverse (http://fileverse.io), Rotki (http://rotki.com), Fluidkey (http://fluidkey.com), Radicle, GnosisVPN.

## Devcon 2026

- Record: `premier-devcon-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-03
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://devcon.org/>

### About the event

Devcon is the annual global event for the movement building free, open, private, and verifiable systems. In 2026 it comes to Mumbai, India, on 3-6 November at G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex.

### Why Mumbai

Devcon calls Mumbai home in 2026 to champion what India is building: deep engineering talent, an open-source community expanding faster than almost any other in the world, and the world's largest public open-source contributor base.

### Program

Programming spans Core Protocol, Privacy and Consent, Security, Futures Worth Building, Users Builders and Agents, Rights Freedoms and Governance, Applied Cryptography, Permissionless Networks, and Open and Verifiable Stack. Formats include talks, workshops, experiences, coworking, art, community hubs, music and hands-on spaces created by the community.

### Tickets

General Admission starts at $499 and is anon-friendly and transferrable with a limit of two per order. Community discounts from $149 cover Indian residents and open-source contributors, with application-based Sanctuary Tech Builder, student and youth passes from $25. All passes include four-day access, catering and swag, plus 18% GST.

### Getting there

The organizer runs an airport welcome booth, with the metro reaching the venue in about five minutes. The event overlaps with Diwali season, so the travel guide advises booking stays early. Speaker, supporter, volunteer and media applications run through the organizer's site.

### El futuro del sistema financiero: una mirada regional

BSL Colombia 2026 reunirá a autoridades, líderes del sistema financiero, representantes de la academia y actores del ecosistema tecnológico de América Latina para analizar los principales desafíos y oportunidades de la transformación financiera.

Las conversaciones abordarán la innovación financiera, la modernización de los sistemas de pago, la evolución regulatoria, los activos digitales, tokenización y las nuevas formas de dinero e infraestructura financiera.

Un espacio regional de diálogo y análisis para conectar experiencias, perspectivas y aprendizajes, promoviendo la colaboración entre el sector público y privado.

### Infraestructura financiera digital

Análisis de la evolución del sistema financiero, los nuevos medios de pago, la tokenización y las infraestructuras digitales de la región.

### Regulación e institucionalidad financiera

Perspectivas de autoridades, reguladores y bancos centrales sobre innovación, estabilidad y evolución normativa.

### Diálogo estratégico regional

Articulación de alto nivel entre el sector público, la banca, los mercados de capitales y el ecosistema tecnológico financiero.

### Impacto económico y financiero

Innovación aplicada a la competitividad, la productividad, la inclusión y el desarrollo económico regional.

### Agenda

- Día 1: Regulación, Infraestructura Financiera y Evolución Institucional 2026-11-04
- Día 2: Tokenización, Stablecoins y Nueva Infraestructura Financiera 2026-11-05
- Día 3: Integración de Mercados, Confianza Institucional y Sistema Financiero 2030 2026-11-06

### Palabras de Apertura

Keynote - "Interoperabilidad, pagos de alto valor y dinero digital: el nuevo mapa de infraestructura"

Keynote - "De la supervisión tradicional a los activos digitales: prioridades regulatorias para Colombia"

Keynote - "Un mercado, tres economías: cómo nuam está construyendo la nueva infraestructura regional de capitales"

Keynote - "El Salvador después de la Ley de Activos Digitales: lecciones desde la regulación y el mercado"

### Keynote - "Finanzas abiertas y tokenización: la próxima agenda regulatoria de Colombia"

Keynote - "Brasil frente a los activos virtuales: marco regulatorio, supervisión y evolución del mercado"

Panel - "El sistema financiero en transformación: infraestructura, innovación y nuevos modelos institucionales"

### Keynote - "Cómo integrar stablecoins en banca: controles, gobernanza y operación"

Panel - "De la regulación al mercado: qué falta para escalar los activos digitales en América Latina"

### Keynote - "Autocustodia para mercados emergentes: inclusión financiera desde Fedi"

Panel - "Pagos transfronterizos y finanzas tokenizadas: stablecoins y nueva infraestructura global"

### Keynote - Cuando el avance en infraestructura financiera modifica el mercado de capitales*

Keynote - "Activos digitales a escala institucional: custodia, seguridad y confianza para el sistema financiero"

### Panel - "De la innovación a escala: nuevos modelos financieros en Colombia"

Keynote - "De la infraestructura financiera a las finanzas programables: la próxima década del dinero y los mercados" *

### Workshops

Todos los Workshops se realizarán en la sala previamente acordada

### Ubicación Estratégica

La Universidad Externado de Colombia está ubicada en el corazón del centro histórico de Bogotá, en el tradicional sector de La Candelaria. Su campus ofrece un entorno académico e institucional privilegiado, cercano a importantes entidades públicas, culturales y empresariales de la capital.

### Infraestructura de primer nivel

Los edificios H e I de la Universidad Externado cuentan con espacios modernos y funcionales, salones equipados, soporte audiovisual y áreas especialmente dispuestas para conferencias, encuentros profesionales y networking.

### Entorno institucional

Un entorno académico y profesional alineado con el carácter de BSL Colombia, preparado para recibir a autoridades, reguladores, líderes del sistema financiero, académicos, empresas tecnológicas y referentes internacionales.

### About the event

ETHGlobal hackathons enable you to experiment with cutting edge web3 technologies and develop an idea you're passionate about. This is your opportunity to learn about crypto, expand your network, meet industry professionals, and find like-minded people who are collectively creating a new kind of web.

### Mumbai 2026

The Mumbai hackathon runs 5-7 November 2026 at Jio World Convention Centre. The organizer lists $175,000 available in prizes across tracks from World, 1inch, 0G, Uniswap Foundation, Arc, Hedera, Arkiv, Whitechain, ENS, Definitive and Chainlink. The published roster spans judges, mentors and speakers from ETHGlobal, Ethereum Foundation, Backpack, MetaMask and ENS.

### Building formats

Projects can start from scratch, extend an open-source repository, or ship a new open-source feature on an existing product during the event. The published rules specify teams of 1-5 members and up to three sponsor SDKs.

### Themes

The published themes include zero knowledge proofs, AI x Crypto, DeFi, crypto consumer applications, Layer 2s, interoperability, public goods, privacy and security, TEEs, data availability, identity and developer tools.

### Venue

Jio World Centre, G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400098, India.

### Around the hackathon

Partners for the weekend include World, 1inch, 0G, ENS, Uniswap Foundation, Arc, Hedera, Arkiv, Definitive Finance and Chainlink Labs. Pragma Mumbai, ETHGlobal's one-day builders summit, takes place on 4 November at Grand Hyatt Mumbai on 26 September alongside the hackathon week.

- Record: `premier-bitcoin-amsterdam-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)

### European focused

Bitcoin Amsterdam is the premier forum to explore Bitcoin's rapid growth, innovations, and transformative applications shaping its future.

### Driving bitcoin Forward

This year, Bitcoin Amsterdam is returning to the Sugar Factory and joining the builders, capital allocators, and pioneers on one pivotal stage.

### experience

Bitcoin is at the center of politics and regulation - Bitcoin Amsterdam unites leaders to shape a fair, thriving future across Europe.

### Jack Mallers

Strike Jack Mallers is the Founder and CEO of Strike, the global Bitcoin app. Prior to Strike, Jack was one of the first application developers on top of Bitcoin's Lightning Network. Jack has spent the last decade of his life in the Bitcoin space, pioneering efforts in distributed systems infrastructure, architecture, and application development.

### Edward Snowden

Edward Snowden is a privacy advocate and former intelligence contractor whose 2013 disclosures revealed the scope of global government surveillance programs, sparking an international debate on privacy, security, and civil liberties. Since then, he has become a prominent voice on digital privacy, encryption, and the relationship between technology and individual freedom, contributing to discussions on the societal implications of surveillance in the digital age.

### Pierre Rochard

Pierre Rochard has researched and written about Bitcoin since 2013. He co-founded the Satoshi Nakamoto Institute in 2014 to curate the best primary source literature. In addition to developing open-source Bitcoin software, Pierre is an outspoken advocate for Bitcoin's decentralized governance. He co-hosts the Noded Bitcoin Podcast and the Bitcoin for Advisors Podcast. Pierre served as the Bitcoin and Lightning product manager at Kraken for three years before joining Riot as the VP of Research.

### Obi Nwosu

Obi Nwosu is cofounder and CEO of Fedi and a zealous advocate for Bitcoin mass adoption. He previously founded the Bitcoin exchange Coinfloor, and holds board positions at ₿trust and Gridless Compute

### Adam Back

Co-founder and CEO of Blockstream, Dr. Adam Back, invented Hashcash, the proof-of-work algorithm cited by Satoshi Nakamoto in the Bitcoin whitepaper, as the future basis for its mining function. Throughout his two-decade-long vocation as an applied cryptographer and security architect, he has held senior roles with a number of technology companies, including Microsoft, EMC, PI, VMware, and Zero-Knowledge Systems, as well as advised many more companies on cryptography and peer-to-peer finance. Dr. Adam Back holds a computer science Ph.D. in distributed systems from the University of Exeter.

### Elizabeth Stark

Elizabeth Stark is CEO and Founder of Lightning Labs, where she is building a programmable financial layer for the internet with fast, scalable bitcoin transactions.

### Joana Cotar

Independent Member of the German Parliament. Founder of the ""Bitcoin im Bundestag"" initiative. The initiative is committed to raising awareness and educating members of the German Bundestag about Bitcoin. It aims to ensure that political decision-makers are always up to date and can adequately consider the impact of Bitcoin on society.

### Ben Arc

Ben Arc is a developer, educator, and open-source contributor focused on improving Bitcoin's usability through Lightning Network tools and self-custody solutions. He is best known for creating and maintaining projects such as LNbits, which help individuals and businesses build on Bitcoin with accessible, open-source infrastructure. Ben is an active advocate for decentralized technologies, privacy, and expanding practical Bitcoin adoption around the world.

- Unchained Summit brings together the institutions, investors, founders, policymakers, traders and technology leaders shaping the next era of digital assets, financial markets and Web3.
- India combines massive digital-asset adoption, deep technical talent and a rapidly evolving ecosystem of financial institutions, capital and Web3 companies. Unchained Summit connects these worlds through business opportunities, partnerships, investment and global market access.

Following successful international editions in Dubai and Vietnam, Unchained Summit now comes to India. For those looking to invest, build, enter the market or shape its next chapter, this is where the right conversations begin.

A day focused on the forces reshaping markets, capital and financial infrastructure, bringing together banks, investors, wealth managers, family offices, regulators, FinTechs, exchanges and institutional market participants.

### About the event

The (un)Banked lands in London, an invite-only gathering of banks, fintechs, and digital asset leaders shaping the next chapter of European finance.

### London edition

The conference takes place on 9 November 2026 at Landing Canary Wharf, a waterside venue in London's Canary Wharf business district. The one-day program brings together more than 500 leaders across banking, fintech, crypto and regulation.

### Program

The published program covers institutional tokenisation, custody and board-level risk, stablecoin payments, institutional capital and digital assets, and the FCA and MiCA regulatory landscape. Registration and coffee begin at 10:00 AM, with closing remarks and networking at 4:30 PM.

### Attendance

The (un)Banked is invite-only. Register interest through the organizer and the team follows up with confirmed guests. One day. One room. London's most senior finance minds.

### Speakers

Published speakers include Giovanni Everduin (Commercial Bank International), Laurent Marochini (Standard Chartered), Daniel Rowlands (Wirex), Oleg Bevz (INPUT Global), Rob Hadick (Dragonfly), Alice Li (Foresight Ventures), Jody Mettler (BitGo), James Butterfill (Coinshares) and Artem Stopnevich (The Vault). Sponsors include Paybis, Foresight Ventures, Purewallet and The Vault. Sponsorship, media, community partnerships and speakership for the London edition are open.

Two days of panels, workshops and closed-door sessions cover custody and institutional infrastructure, stablecoins and cross-border settlement, real-asset tokenization, regulated AI agents and capital strategy. Still have questions about Singapore Blockchain Week? Reach out to our team, and we will be happy to assist you.

It is the world's first cross-border blockchain week, uniting the ecosystems of the Republic of Singapore and the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone. Supported by both Singaporean and Malaysian governments, it is the premier platform to redefine the future of finance, bringing together over 5,000 participants, 120+ speakers, and 80+ global investors from over 70 countries.

The summit operates on a cross-border model. Accredited events and activations will take place across both the Republic of Singapore and Southern Malaysia (Johor). These two strategic ecosystems are in close proximity, located just a 45-minute drive apart, offering a seamless bridge between a global financial center and a high-growth special economic zone.

Our agenda is strictly tailored for institutional and enterprise adoption. Core themes include Real World Asset (RWA) Tokenization, Decentralized Finance (DeFi), Stablecoins & CBDCs, Shariah Compliance in digital assets, Enterprise Blockchain integration, and the convergence of AI and ESG within Web3.

The summit is designed for traditional finance executives, Web3 innovators, asset managers, policymakers, and enterprise leaders. Whether you are navigating regulatory frameworks, exploring high-level business matching, or looking to scale digital asset infrastructure, the event provides world-class content and networking for the global institutional community.

We offer tailored partnership opportunities for enterprises and institutions seeking to align with the region's digital economy. Whether your goal is high-level brand positioning, participating in our strategic network, or engaging in private business matching, we work with you to structure a meaningful presence. Please contact our corporate relations team to explore collaboration.

Absolutely. Facilitating high-level networking and business matching is a core pillar of the summit. With over 10 accredited events throughout the week, attendees will have direct access to top-tier regulators, media partners, and institutional capital to forge meaningful, cross-border partnerships.

Speaker applications are currently open for industry leaders, policymakers, and subject matter experts. You can submit your proposed topics and executive biographies through the contact portal on our website for review by our programming committee.

### About the event

The era of speculation is over. Blueprints reflects our collective mission to finalize the technical, energetic, and regulatory frameworks that will define North American leadership for decades to come. Attend NABS to get hands-on with the people securing our digital future and deploying the next generation of infrastructure.

NABS is the conference for the leaders architecting the future of digital infrastructure. Focused on the core pillars of strategic infrastructure, capital, partnerships, and global leadership, the Summit convenes C-suite executives, policymakers, and innovators to secure and deploy the next generation of North American legacy.

This is where the industry's blueprints are refined and the partnerships that drive global scale are solidified.Hosted by the Digital Infrastructure Network, the Summit provides an unprecedented look through the lens of a state bringing leadership to the global economy.

This year, NABS is expanding into the full digital infrastructure conversation. Our focus includes data centers and compute, AI, energy and the grid, quantum technologies, Bitcoin and digital assets, and the capital and policy that support all of them.

What ties those areas together is that none can develop in isolation. AI needs compute; compute needs power, cooling, and networks; emerging technologies need security, investment, and clear policy.

We're bringing together the operators, technology leaders, investors, researchers, policymakers, and advisers working through those questions. We want people to leave with useful relationships, a clearer understanding of the challenges, and opportunities to move actual projects forward.

- Decentralised Intelligence: The Convergence of AI, Web3 & Data

Sub-Saharan Africa is the 3rd fastest-growing crypto region, per the 2025 report by Chainalysis.

From Jul 2024 to Jun 2025, it saw $205B in on-chain value, up 52% YoY. Nigeria led with $92.1B, nearly three times South Africa's. South Africa ranked second, helped by its clearer regulatory framework, while Ethiopia, Kenya, and Ghana rounded out the top five.

In 2024, South Africa took a major step by approving 248 Crypto Asset Service Provider (CASP) licences (as at December 2024). By December 2025, the FSCA had approved 300 CASPs out of 512 applications received (with 14 declined and 291 still active on the latest published list).

The Travel Rule for crypto asset transfers was implemented in South Africa via Financial Intelligence Centre Directive 9, effective 30 April 2025, aligning the country with international AML/CFT standards to combat financial crime.

As Africa continues to experience rapid growth in crypto adoption, Crypto Fest remains the premier platform to showcase regional and global trends, opportunities, and innovations shaping the future of Web3.

### WHAT TO EXPECT?

Get ready to be inspired by a stellar lineup of 30+ global innovators and thought leaders in the cryptocurrency, Metaverse, blockchain, Web3.0, and DeFi industry.

This is your chance to gain unparalleled insights into the future of decentralized technology and its transformative impact.

Get ready for something new this year - exhibitions are back at the event!

Explore a vibrant exhibition floor packed with leading crypto projects, blockchain innovators, licensed CASPs, fintech solutions, wallet providers, DeFi platforms, and institutional-grade tools.

Dive deep into crypto trends, emerging narratives, top trading tactics, and smart investment plays.

Stay ahead of the curve: uncover where the market is heading and explore the newest blockchain innovations and DeFi opportunities.

Get ready to connect with industry leaders, investors, developers, and innovators shaping the future of blockchain and cryptocurrency at Crypto Fest.

Through interactive sessions, panel discussions, and casual meetups, you'll have the opportunity to build valuable relationships and collaborate on innovative ideas.

### why you should attend

- Attend Cape Town's premier cryptocurrency and blockchain event.
- Explore Latest Trends - Dive into the latest developments in cryptocurrency, from stablecoins, compliance, and regulation to blockchain-based payments shaping the future of finance.
- Unlock the Power of DeFi - Discover boundless opportunities in Decentralized Finance (DeFi) and learn how it's revolutionizing financial empowerment worldwide.
- Stay Ahead of Regulation - Gain invaluable insights into the ever-evolving landscape of digital asset regulation and emerging policies that impact the industry.
- Connect with Africa's Web3 Community - Engage with leading innovators, builders, and investors driving blockchain adoption across the continent.
- Win Exclusive Crypto Swag - Stand a chance to grab crypto-branded socks, freebies, and exciting giveaways, making your experience even more memorable.
- Experience Cape Town's Beauty - Soak in the stunning scenery of one of the world's most breathtaking cities, enhancing your event experience.
- Network & Collaborate - Forge meaningful connections with industry experts, thought leaders, and fellow enthusiasts, sparking new ideas and collaborations that shape the future of Web3.

### who will attend

Prepare to engage with an extraordinary mix of professionals, visionaries, and trailblazers.

These include: industry innovators, global cryptocurrency and blockchain thought leaders, technology and innovation experts, technical decision makers, strategy influencers and analysts, entrepreneurs, FinTech professionals, payment specialists, forex and cryptocurrency traders, cryptocurrency mining entities, cryptocurrency exchanges, retail and institutional investors, software developers and engineers, system architects, technical leads, early adopters, venture capitalists, journalists and content writers, marketing specialists, accountants and auditors, attorneys, regulators, compliance officers, global policy makers, gamers, musicians, artists, key industry influencers and enthusiasts.

### About the event

The Bridge Between TradFi and Digital Assets. The Institutional Summit for Digital Assets. Paris, July 6-7, 2027.

### What it is

Signal Week is the summit for the institutional digital-assets sector, set in Paris. It succeeds seven years of Paris Blockchain Week as its elevation for the decade ahead: where Paris Blockchain Week built credibility as Europe's leading institutional digital asset conference, Signal Week positions it for the decade ahead.

### Audience

The organizer inherits an audience with more than 70% C-suite or investment decision-makers, 36,000-plus facilitated networking meetings, $50 trillion-plus in assets under management represented, and 389 government officials and policymakers. It is built for banking and financial services, asset management, enterprise, digital-asset native firms, traditional finance, infrastructure providers and family offices.

### Speakers

Past stages have hosted Changpeng Zhao (Binance), Jeremy Allaire (Circle), Lily Liu (Solana Foundation), Silvio Micali (Algorand), Charles Hoskinson, Joseph Lubin (ConsenSys), Tim Draper, Jan Van Eck (VanEck), Yoni Assia (eToro) and Arianna Simpson (a16z), alongside French ministers Anne Le Henanff, Clara Chappaz and Marina Ferrari. Featured faces for 2027 include Adam Back, Nikhil Sharma (BlackRock), Kara Kennedy (JP Morgan), Amy Oldenburg (Morgan Stanley), Ben Slavin (BNY), Christian Rau (Mastercard) and Daniel Seifert (Coinbase).

### Participation

Participants span digital-asset native builders, TradFi and fintech institutions deploying at scale, AI-for-finance providers and ecosystem partners. Founding partnerships for Signal Week 2027 are open.

Team1 Korea and Tiger Research are hosting a Namsan hike as part of KBW 2026 side events, on September 26, 2026.

Co-host: Team1 Korea (https://x.com/AvalancheKorea) x Tiger Research (https://tiger-research.com/)

Date & Time: September 26 Saturday 10AM

  - Reaching the summit

Tangem 소개

Tangem은 카드와 반지 형태의 하드웨어 지갑을 만듭니다. EAL6+ 인증 보안 칩, 오픈소스 코드, 외부 감사를 거친 펌웨어를 바탕으로 은행 수준의 보안과 일상적인 사용성을 함께 제공합니다.

주머니 속 셀프 커스터디

배터리도, 케이블도, 시드 문구도 없습니다. Tangem 지갑은 3분 이내에 활성화되고, 스마트폰과 함께 작동하며, 개인 키는 항상 오프라인에 보관됩니다.

Web3를 위한 자유

Tangem을 통해 제3자를 신뢰하지 않고도 토큰을 보관하고, 스왑하고, 관리할 수 있습니다. 세계 어디서든 자산의 통제권은 온전히 사용자에게 있습니다.

Simple. Secure. Tangem.

크립토가 처음인 분부터 오랜 투자자까지, Tangem은 누구나 셀프 커스터디를 쉽게 시작할 수 있게 합니다.

## The Bridge Summit

- Record: `kbw-official-the-bridge-summit-09-28`

### About the event

The Bridge Summit 2026, 서울에서 여러분을 초대합니다

이번 KBW, 9월 28일은 The Bridge Summit에서 함께하세요.

TV조선 × Bridge34가 공동 주최하고, 글로벌 Web3 벤처캐피털 Hack VC가 Main Partner로 함께하는 The Bridge Summit 2026이 오는 9월 28일, 조선 팰리스 서울에서 개최됩니다.

Bridge34

- Bridge34는 글로벌 Web3 프로젝트와 한국 시장을 연결하는 Web3 전문 액셀러레이터이자 마케팅 파트너로, 커뮤니티-미디어-파트너십을 기반으로 국내 Web3 생태계의 성장을 이끌고 있습니다.

TV조선

- TV조선은 대한민국의 주요 종합편성채널로, 폭넓은 미디어 영향력과 콘텐츠 역량을 바탕으로 Web3와 디지털 자산 산업의 대중화를 연결하는 미디어 기업입니다.

Hack VC

- Hack VC는 Web3 및 블록체인 기술에 집중하는 글로벌 벤처캐피털로, 초기 단계부터 유망한 프로젝트와 창업가에 투자하며 차세대 크립토 생태계의 성장을 지원하고 있습니다.

글로벌 Web3 프로젝트부터 기관, 투자자, 미디어, 그리고 한국 커뮤니티까지.

디지털 자산 - AI - 토큰화 금융의 다음 흐름을 만들어가는 플레이어들이 서울에 모입니다.

다양한 세션과 네트워킹, 프로젝트 부스는 물론, 이번 Summit에 참여하는 한국 커뮤니티를 위해 특별한 혜택도 준비되어 있습니다.

이번 The Bridge Summit은

현장을 직접 경험하고 참여하면서 다양한 리워드까지 받아갈 수 있는 컨퍼런스로 준비됩니다.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

총 5,000만원 상당 에어드랍 및 경품

> ① LUCKY DRAW 1등 보상 - 0.1 BTC

> - 조선 팰리스에서 0.1 BTC의 주인공이 탄생합니다.

> 현장에 마련된 부스 미션을 완료한 참가자에게 럭키드로우 참여 기회가 주어집니다.

>

> ② 300만원 상당의 토큰 보상

> - 총 3명의 참가자에게 인당 100만원 상당의 토큰 리워드가 제공됩니다.

>

> ③ 5만원 상당 리워드 × 300명

> 총 300명의 현장 참가자에게 1인당 5만원 상당의 리워드가 제공됩니다.

>

### Hyperliquid Seminar Korea

An invite-only institutional seminar on Hyperliquid and onchain finance, during Korea Blockchain Week 2026

September 28, 2026

2:00PM - 5:30PM KST

Seoul, South Korea [Venue TBA]

Invitation Only | Limited to 150 Guests

### About

Hyperliquid Seminar Korea is an invitation-only seminar hosted by HypurrCorea × TENET during Korea Blockchain Week 2026.

Korea's financial institutions are approaching a moment of change. As the FSC develops guidance on digital asset allocation, banks, brokerages, asset managers and listed corporates are being asked to form a view on markets they have had little structured exposure to.

This seminar is built for that audience. Over an afternoon, we examine what Hyperliquid is, how onchain markets actually function, what stands between an institution and participation today, and where the next twelve months lead. The session assumes no prior crypto background and is delivered to the standard institutional diligence requires.

Builders, researchers and the Korean Hyperliquid community join the same room.

### Program (Tentative)

- Why Hyperliquid, Why Now - Structural change in onchain markets and the rise of Hyperliquid
- From Exchange to Financial Infrastructure - Architecture, market model and ecosystem expansion
- Institutional Access to Onchain Markets - Regulation, KYC and custody, through to how institutions can participate
- The Next Chapter of Hyperliquid - Direction ahead and the next stage of onchain finance
- Networking

### Who's Joining

A curated group of C-suite executives and senior leaders from Korean banks, securities firms, asset managers, listed corporates and family offices, alongside leading builders, researchers and participants from across the global Hyperliquid ecosystem.

### Hosted by

Host: HypurrCorea

Partner: TENET, Korea Blockchain Week by Factblock

Community Partner: Hyperliquid KR

Research Partner: Hyperliquid Research Collective

### Registration

This is an invitation-only event with limited capacity. Registration through Luma does not guarantee admission. Approved guests will receive a confirmation, along with venue details, prior to the event.

The seminar is held under the Chatham House Rule. Press and recording are not permitted.

### About ReboundX

크립토 시장은 늘 트레이딩으로 귀결되며, 트레이딩에는 항상 수수료가 발생합니다. ReboundX는 이러한 수수료를 단순한 비용이 아닌 새로운 기회로 바꾸기 위해, 주요 CEX와 Perp DEX를 아우르는 최고 수준의 리베이트 플랫폼으로 시작했습니다. 거래가 발생하는 즉시 리베이트가 계산되며, 24시간 이내 자동 정산됩니다. 현재 ReboundX는 리베이트 플랫폼을 넘어 트레이딩 터미널이자 DEX-CEX 애그리게이터로 진화하고 있습니다. 다양한 거래소를 하나의 인터페이스에서 연결하여, 트레이더들이 모든 거래에서 더 많은 가치를 돌려받을 수 있는 통합 트레이딩 허브를 구축하고 있습니다.

In crypto, trading is where profits are ultimately realized - and trading always comes with fees. ReboundX began as a highest-rate referral rebate platform across top CEXs and Perp DEXs, turning those fees from a cost into a new opportunity. Today, ReboundX is evolving beyond rebates into a trading terminal and a DEX-CEX aggregator - a single trading hub where traders get more back from every transaction.

### About Sponsors

2024년 전체 무기한 선물 시장의 약 2%에 불과했던 Perp DEX는 2025년 한 해 동안 거래량이 4.3배 성장하며, 사상 최초로 월간 거래량 $1T를 돌파했습니다.

2026년에는 CEX 거래량이 30% 이상 감소하는 상황에서도 성장을 이어가며, 전체 파생상품 시장의 10% 이상을 차지하는 구조적인 시장 축으로 자리잡았습니다. 최고점에서는 시장 점유율이 24%까지 치솟았습니다.

이는 단순한 일시적 트렌드를 넘어, 트레이더들이 중앙화거래소(CEX) 대신 Perp DEX를 선택하는 수요가 본격적으로 자리잡고 있음을 보여줍니다.

앞으로도 온체인 파생상품 시장의 구조적 성장이 이어질 것으로 예상되는 가운데, 글로벌 Perp DEX 시장을 선도하는 주요 프로젝트들이 PERP DEX DAY와 함께합니다.

Variational

2026년 글로벌 0티어 Perp DEX로 주목받고 있는 프로젝트. 크립토 헤지펀드를 DCG에 매각한 경험을 가진 파운더들이 설립한 RFQ 기반 Perp Engine으로, RWA를 포함한 다양한 자산을 온체인에서 거래할 수 있는 인프라를 구축하고 있습니다.

Total Raised: $61.8M

Backed by: Dragonfly, Bain Capital, Coinbase, Zoku Ventures 외 9개 글로벌 투자사

Lighter

18세에 하버드대학교를 졸업하고 수학 올림피아드 수상 및 Citadel을 포함한 글로벌 헤지펀드 경력을 가진 파운더가 설립한 Perp DEX. 블록체인 Perp 시장에서 Zero-Fee 모델을 선도적으로 구현했으며, Robinhood와 Founders Fund 등 글로벌 금융-투자사로부터 투자를 유치했습니다. 현재 Robinhood Chain의 온체인 ZK Perp Engine을 담당하고 있습니다.

Total Raised: $68M

Backed by: Ribbit Capital, Founders Fund, Robinhood, Haun Ventures

Aster

Aster는 YZi Labs의 지원을 받는 프라이버시 중심의 무기한 선물 거래소입니다. 사용자의 거래 활동을 보호하기 위해 Hidden Orders와 같은 기술을 제공하는 것이 특징입니다. 또한 암호화폐, 주식, 원자재에 대한 무기한 선물 계약뿐만 아니라 암호화폐 현물 거래도 지원합니다.

Aster의 기반에는 Aster Chain이 있으며, 이는DeFi의 미래를 구현하기 위해 설계된 Layer 1 블록체인입니다.

Extended

유럽 대표 핀테크 기업 Revolut의 Crypto 출신 파운더들이 설립한 Perp DEX. 투명성과 강력한 매칭 엔진을 핵심으로, 마켓메이커와 트레이더 사이에서 보다 중립적이고 신뢰할 수 있는 거래 환경을 구축하고 있습니다.

In 2024, Perp DEXs accounted for just 2% of the global perpetual futures market. In 2025, trading volume grew 4.3x, surpassing $1T in monthly volume for the first time.

In 2026, Perp DEXs have continued to grow even as CEX volumes declined by more than 30%, capturing over 10% of the overall derivatives market and establishing themselves as a structural pillar of the industry. At its peak, Perp DEX market share reached as high as 24%.

This growth signals more than a temporary trend. It reflects a growing preference among traders to choose Perp DEXs over centralized exchanges, pointing to strong long-term potential for the on-chain derivatives market.

And now, some of the leading Perp DEXs by global market share are coming together for PERP DEX DAY.

Variational

A globally recognized top-tier Perp DEX in 2026, founded by entrepreneurs who previously built and sold a crypto hedge fund to DCG. Variational is building an RFQ-based Perp Engine designed to bring a wide range of assets, including RWAs, on-chain.

Lighter is also powering the on-chain ZK Perp Engine for Robinhood Chain.

Total Raised: $68M

Aster

Aster is a privacy-first perpetual futures exchange where your positions, orders and trading activity stay hidden from other market participants.

Total Raised: Undisclosed

Extended

A Perp DEX founded by former crypto executives from Revolut, one of Europe's leading fintech companies. Built around transparency and a powerful matching engine, Extended aims to create a more neutral, trusted trading environment between market makers and traders.

Total Raised: $19M

Backed by: eToro, Jump Crypto, and 7+ global investors

### About the Event

AI is reshaping the way trading decisions are made. As AI agents begin to perform technical analysis, execute strategies, and place orders automatically, the role of human judgment is being redefined.

When automation tools become widely accessible, what will remain as the real edge for traders?

AI Meets the Chart brings together AI builders, quantitative researchers, and frontline traders to discuss how AI is being integrated into real trading workflows. The event will explore the practical application of AI quant trading, Agentic Trading frameworks, latency-sensitive execution, and the current boundaries of automated decision-making.

Through keynote sessions, panel discussions, and networking, participants will examine where AI can enhance trading performance, where human judgment still matters, and how traders should position themselves in the next phase of AI-driven markets.

To make the experience even more exciting, we've prepared a range of exciting prizes, including gift cards and gold. All participants will have the opportunity to win prizes through our event giveaways and lucky draws.
