### KURS PROGRAMOWANIA BLOCKCHAIN

Jesteś programistą i zastanawiasz się, jak działają aplikacje na blockchainie? Chcesz w praktyce zbudować swój pierwszy działający projekt?

### Ten kurs jest dla Ciebie!

Nasz cel? Pomóc Ci szybko wejść w świat blockchaina, zdobyć doświadczenie w tworzeniu działających projektów w ekosystemie Solana i pokazać, jak wykorzystać nowe technologie w realnych aplikacjach

Dołącz do grupy: Telegram (https://t.me/+m5E-r2fGJ6VkOGRk)

### Dlaczego warto?

Stworzysz działający projekt, który możesz od razu pokazać w portfolio

Nauczysz się Rust i podstaw blockchaina w praktyce, krok po kroku

Pracujesz z mentorami, którzy pokażą, jak rozwiązywać problemy i efektywnie kodować (PS. Pierwszą edycję poprowadził laureat Thiel Fellowship )

Otrzymasz dyplom ukończenia, potwierdzający Twoje nowe umiejętności

Zyskasz dodatkową okazję na udział w Bounties po kursie, gdzie powalczysz o 1000$ z puli nagród

### A to nie wszystko

Już 2 tygodnie po kursie odbędą się BLOCKCHAIN HACK WARSAW i BLOCKCHAIN HACK KRAKÓW, w których możesz zgarnać nagrody za swój projekt!

### Przygotuj się do kursu

1. Edytor kodu

Potrzebujesz dowolnego edytora programistycznego. Polecamy Cursor (https://cursor.com/).

2. WSL (dla użytkowników Windows)

Jeśli korzystasz z systemu Windows, wymagane będzie środowisko Linux poprzez Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/install).

3. Narzędzia deweloperskie Solany

Podczas kursu będziemy tworzyć aplikacje w ekosystemie Solana, dlatego konieczna jest instalacja narzędzi developerskich (Anchor + Solana CLI). (https://www.anchor-lang.com/docs/installation)

4. Phantom Wallet

Potrzebny będzie portfel kryptowalutowy Phantom (https://phantom.com/) jako rozszerzenie do przeglądarki - użyjemy go do testowania aplikacji blockchainowych.

### Dzień 1

10:00-11:00 | Rust Crash Course

Pierwsze kroki w Rust i nauka języka do programowania w ekosystemie Solana.

11:00 - 12:15 | Blockchain 101 + Wprowadzenie do Solana

Podstawy działania blockchaina i wstęp do Solany w praktyce.

12:15 - 13:15 | Przerwa

13:15 - 14:30 | Solana Architecture

Omówienie architektury Solany: programy, konta i tokeny.

14:30 - 15:00 | Setup pierwszego projektu

Konfiguracja środowiska i uruchomienie pierwszego programu.

15:00 - 15:15 | Przerwa

15:15 - 15:45 | Brainstorming - wybór MVP

Wybór pomysłu na własny projekt do dalszej pracy.

15:45 - 16:00 | Podsumowanie dnia

Szybkie podsumowanie, Q&A i przygotowanie do sesji praktycznej.

16:00 - 19:00 | Sesja kodowania z mentorami

Praca nad projektami z pomocą mentorów - koduj tak długo, jak chcesz.

### Dzień 2

10:00 - 10:30 | Program Derived Addresses (PDAs)

Tworzenie i użycie specjalnych adresów dla programów w praktyce.

10:30 - 11:00 | Counter Program - Update Instructions

Pisanie funkcji i instrukcji aktualizujących dane w programie.

11:00 - 11:30 | Testing & Debugging

Testowanie i debugowanie programów - znajdowanie i naprawianie błędów.

11:30 - 12:00 | Cross-Program Invocations (CPI)

Jak programy komunikują się między sobą, pokazane na przykładzie.

12:00 - 12:30 | Hackathon Readiness

Przygotowanie do sprintów i hackathonów - najlepsze praktyki i wskazówki.

12:30 - 13:00 | Resources & Gdzie szukać pomocy

Przydatne materiały, dokumentacja i społeczności dla developerów.

13:00 - 13:30 | Q&A i Last Tips

Odpowiedzi na pytania i wskazówki przed popołudniowym sprintem.

13:30 - 14:00 | Przerwa

14:00 - 18:00 | MVP Sprint z mentorami

Praca nad własnym projektem z pomocą mentorów - koduj, testuj i rozwijaj MVP.

18:00 - 19:00 | Pokazanie projektów

Prezentacja projektów - pokaż efekty weekendowej pracy.

Nie czekaj, dołącz do kursu i zacznij budować swój pierwszy projekt na Blockchainie!

Dołącz do grupy: Telegram (https://t.me/+m5E-r2fGJ6VkOGRk)

### Ważna informacja

Szkolenie jest darmowe, jednak liczba miejsc jest ograniczona, a zainteresowanie bardzo duże - dlatego nie wszyscy zgłoszeni będą mogli wziąć udział. Przepraszamy i zapraszamy na kolejne edycje już niedługo.

Jeśli otrzymałeś(-aś) potwierdzenie udziału, prosimy o przyjście na szkolenie lub wcześniejszą informację o rezygnacji, abyśmy mogli przekazać miejsce osobie z listy rezerwowej.

### About the event

Join AxolDAO for a chill evening of pizza, beer, talks about autonomy, anonymity, and friendly conversation!

Who we are:

Axol.io (https://Axol.io); Xochi.fi (https://Xochi.fi) (/so-chee/)

We believe everyone should be able to have equitable access and understanding of web3, and tech.

Web3 was supposed to bring us together, yet most of us still don't feel that way.

That's why despite the changing world, let's be like the axolotls; regenerative, and soft-bodied, and full of pizza (or whatever you choose to order)!

### About the event

Two days where Taiwan's builders meet the global Ethereum stack, from core protocol research and DeFi to custody, real-world assets (RWA), and institutional-grade applications.

### Day 01 - Sep 13 Cryptonative Day

A full day for Ethereum builders and researchers, covering topics including:

- Protocol Research
- ZK & Privacy
- Wallets & Account Abstraction
- Security
- DeFi & Onchain Finance
- Developer Infrastructure and Applications

### Day 02 - Sep 14 Institution Day

A dedicated day connecting the crypto ecosystem with banks, financial institutions, and enterprise teams. Sessions and discussions will explore:

- Digital Asset Custody
- Real-World Assets
- Stablecoins and Onchain Finance
- Institutional-Grade Applications
- Security, Compliance, and Adoption
- Collaboration between Institutions and Ethereum Builders

### Who Should Apply?

We welcome applications from:

- Developers and Protocol Engineers
- Researchers and Security Professionals
- Founders, Product Builders, and Designers
- DeFi, Wallet, Infrastructure, and Application Teams
- Banks, Financial Institutions, and Enterprise Teams
- Students and Emerging Builders
- Community Organizers and Ecosystem Contributors

### Registration Options

There are two ways to register for ETHTaipei 2026:

### Standard Ticket

Registration for the Standard Ticket is application-based.

Submitting an application does not guarantee admission. Each application will be reviewed individually. Approved applicants will receive a confirmation from Luma.

Please provide complete and specific information to help us review your application.

### Community Ticket

If you received a valid community code from an official ETHTaipei community partner, enter the code during registration to access the Community Ticket.

Community Ticket holders do not require additional application review. Once registration is completed successfully, your attendance will be confirmed through Luma.

### Date & Venue

September 13-14, 2026

POPOP Taipei

No. 13, Section 2, Nangang Rd, Nangang District, Taipei City, 115 Agenda and session details will continue to be announced. Learn more: https://ethtaipei.org/ (https://ethtaipei.org/](https://ethtaipei.org/))

### About ETHTaipei 2026

ETHTaipei 2026 brings Taiwan's builders together with the global Ethereum ecosystem over two days, September 13-14, at POPOP Taipei. Day One, Cryptonative Day, focuses on protocol research, ZK and privacy, wallets and account abstraction, security, and DeFi and developer infrastructure. Day Two, Institution Day, connects banks, financial institutions, and enterprise teams around digital asset custody, real-world assets (RWA), stablecoins, institutional-grade applications, and compliance. Developers, researchers, founders, financial institutions, and community organizers are all welcome to apply.

## AI in the Wild: Silicon Valley Backyard BBQ

- Record: `luma-evt-jE6DXM1iCjgwkRE`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-13T22:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/women-fqdk>
- Original page: <https://luma.com/women-fqdk>

### About the event

Good conversations don't always happen in conference rooms. Sometimes the best ones happen around a backyard grill.

Join fellow Women Defining AI members for a relaxed afternoon of food, thoughtful conversation, and community as we gather in the heart of Silicon Valley for the next AI in the Wild experience.

We'll enjoy a casual backyard barbecue, share ideas over good food, and create space for the conversations we rarely have time for during conferences, Zoom calls, or busy workdays. Throughout the afternoon, we'll mix and mingle through a few lightly facilitated activities designed to help us connect, learn from one another, and explore what's next - for AI, our careers, and our lives.

Rather than a formal workshop or networking event, this gathering is about strengthening relationships, exchanging ideas, and creating space for authentic conversations in a welcoming, relaxed setting.

Along the way, we'll explore questions such as:

- What's one AI tool, workflow, or idea that's genuinely excited you recently?
- What challenge are you currently navigating that this community might help you think through?
- What are you most curious to learn next?
- Where do you see the greatest opportunities - or responsibilities - for women shaping the future of AI?
- How can we continue supporting one another as this community grows?

WE HOPE PARTICIPANTS LEAVE FEELING...

- Connected to an incredible community of women who are shaping the future of AI
- Inspired by what we'll learn about and build together next
- Energized by new ideas, perspectives, and conversations
- Connected to new friends, collaborators, and future thought partners
- Encouraged to stay engaged with the Women Defining AI community

FOOD

We'll provide the grill, along with hotdogs, veggie dogs, buns, and a few basics. We will also provide a few alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverage options.

Potluck contributions are appreciated but completely optional. You may consider bringing:

- Something you'd like to grill
- Or a favorite appetizer, side dish, dessert, or beverage to share

GETTING HERE

Street parking is available throughout the neighborhood with a few spots available in the driveway. Carpooling is great! We're ~8-10 minute walk from the Downtown San Mateo Caltrain Station.

WHAT TO BRING

- Comfortable clothing and shoes - we'll spend most of our time outdoors.
- A light jacket or sweater for the evening if you'd like.
- Your curiosity, favorite AI stories, and willingness to connect with others.

A QUICK NOTE: We have two small, friendly dogs - about the size of housecats - who may come by to say hello during the afternoon.

ABOUT WOMEN DEFINING AI: Women Defining AI is a community helping more women confidently learn, experiment with, and shape the future of artificial intelligence. Through hands-on workshops, open knowledge-sharing, leadership programs, bold initiatives, mentorship, and peer collaboration, members build practical AI skills while supporting one another's ambitions. Together, the community is working to close the gender-tech gap and expand opportunities for women to found, invest in, purchase, and lead the technologies transforming our world.

ABOUT GEODE LIFEWORKS: Geode Lifeworks empowers leaders, organizations, and communities to navigate uncertainty with confidence, curiosity, and courage. From AI and emerging technologies to climate, market disruption, and organizational shifts, we design experiences that help people build the adaptive leadership skills, meaningful connections, and practical approaches needed to thrive through change.

AI in the Wild is Geode Lifeworks' signature event series, bringing conversations about AI beyond the boardroom and into our communities through thoughtful dialogue, movement, and shared experiences.

WE CAN'T WAIT TO WELCOME YOU FOR AN AFTERNOON OF GREAT FOOD, INSPIRING CONVERSATIONS, AND COMMUNITY.

### About the event

An online hackathon bringing together builders and founders across all crypto ecosystems to launch breakout startups.

### Crypto World's Fair

Crypto World's Fair is an open competition of the ideas, technologies, and communities shaping the blockchain ecosystem. Builders and founders exhibit the products and innovations driving the next wave of crypto startups that bring the world's markets onchain. Submissions are due October 12, 2026.

### Awards and opportunities

Teams compete for $840,000 in prizes and $2.5 million in seed funding, including a $30,000 grand prize and $300,000 shared across the next 20 best projects. All hackathon winners are interviewed and considered for Colosseum's accelerator program with pre-seed funding, founder network access and mentorship.

### Tracks

Ecosystem tracks with dedicated prize pools include Solana, Ethereum, Hyperliquid, Base, Tempo, Arbitrum, Zcash and Robinhood Chain, each judged with builders, investors and operators from those ecosystems.

### Judges

The Colosseum team reviews all submissions, joined by track judges including Clay Robbins, Matty Taylor and Nate Levine alongside builders and investors from Phantom, Base, Arcium, MetaDAO and Ellipsis Labs.

### Accelerator

All hackathon winners are interviewed and considered for the Colosseum accelerator program with pre-seed funding, founder network access and mentorship, including a residency collaborating directly with the Colosseum team.

### Livestream workshops

All workshops stream live on Discord, including the kickoff with the Colosseum founders. Participants can watch live, ask questions and follow the program through the event.

## Zcash Privacy Night

- Record: `w3v-zcash-privacy-night`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)

- Description: Source-backed

### About the event

¡Barcelona se prepara para uno de los momentos más importantes del año en el ecosistema cripto! Antes de que arranque la European Blockchain Convention 12 (EBC12), nos reunimos en el Zcash Privacy Night: un encuentro informal, fresco y dinámico pensado para conectar a la comunidad local de la privacidad, defensores de la soberanía digital y apasionados de la Web3.

No es otra charla aburrida de diapositivas. Ven a calentar motores para la EBC12, a pasar un buen rato y a poner a prueba lo que sabes mientras nos tomamos algo en un ambiente 100% cypherpunk y relajado.

¿Qué haremos esa noche?

- Juegos & Trivia Cripto: Desafíos interactivos con preguntas sobre privacidad, Zcash, tecnología ZK y cultura libre. ¡Habrá premios y coleccionables para los ganadores!
- Debate & EBC12 Warm-up: Charlaremos sobre lo que se viene en la convención, las tendencias regulatorias en Europa, las nuevas tecnologías shielded y la actualidad del ecosistema.
- Networking & Snacks: Conecta con desarrolladores, creadores, emprendedores y miembros del Club Zcash Barcelona mientras compartimos bebidas y picoteo.

Tanto si eres un veterano de las finanzas privadas como si acabas de instalar tu primera wallet, este espacio es para ti. Entrada 100% gratuita con registro previo.

### ¡Sorpresa de última hora!

> Tendremos de invitado en el meetup a un miembro de la comunidad de JET (https://www.jet-europa.eu/), y nos hablará un poco de lo que se viene en ese proyecto, su comunidad, y también su plataforma de trading, JTX (https://jtx.com/). ¡Habrá merch! No te lo pierdas.

¡Aforo limitado! Reserva tu plaza y asegura tu lugar en la noche de la privacidad en Barcelona.

---

Términos y condiciones de la actividad

- Esta es una actividad para adultos, por lo que el acceso con niños o menores de edad queda prohibido.
- Al inscribirte para este evento aceptas la posibilidad de que aparezcas en fotos o videos que son usados como reseña del mismo. En caso de no querer salir en las fotos o videos, debes mencionarlo con anticipación.
- No recomendamos ni hablamos de trading o inversión. La inversión en criptomonedas conlleva un riesgo financiero que cada usuario debe asumir de forma individual.
- Este evento tiene fines informativos y de networking, y no constituye en forma alguna una recomendación de inversión.
- Zcash es un proyecto de privacidad, y en el caso de uso de sus billeteras, te recomendamos siempre guardar tu frase semilla, ya que solo tú tienes el control y custodia de tu wallet.
- Este es un evento gratuito, por lo que el pago de la entrada es totalmente voluntario.
- El Club Zcash Barcelona es una comunidad sin fines de lucro, y si deseas hacer algún aporte, donación, o quieres patrocinar nuestras actividades y convertirte en un aliado, ponte en contacto con los organizadores o entra a este link. (https://zcashesp.com/club-zcash-barcelona/?utm_source=luma)
- Desde el Club Zcash Barcelona promovemos el respeto y la inclusión entre todos sus miembros, los speakers, aliados y colaboradores.

## Bitcoin 203: Multi-Sig Transactions: Securing Your Bitcoin with Multiple Keys

- Record: `luma-evt-6JkeUvDvzC7PPVG`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-15T23:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/4p3q8raj>
- Original page: <https://luma.com/4p3q8raj>

### About the event

Looking for the ultimate in Bitcoin security? Locking your bitcoin with multiple keys is a simple, effective solution!

Bitcoin educator and Space member, Tim McTavish, will teach you how to easily create your own multi-sig solution using Sparrow Wallet. No third-party needed!

During this session, we will create a 2-of-3 multi-sig using three keys from participants. We will send ~$20 USD worth of bitcoin to this wallet. From there, we will randomly select a participant to receive this bitcoin. We will then execute a 2-of-3 signature, sending the bitcoin from our multi-sig to this lucky participant!

What you'll learn:

What is a multi-sig?

Why and when should I use multi-sig?

How do you best manage multi-sig keys?

What is a PSBT file and how/when might I use it?

What to bring (optional):

A "receive" address in case you are the lucky winner of $20 worth of bitcoin!

Your laptop with Sparrow Wallet installed

Your signing device

### Agenda

Doors open: 530pm

Discussion: 6pm - 7pm

Discussion/Q&A: 7pm - 8pm

Drinks will be provided

### About the event

An intimate lunch - limited to 12 seats, by invitation only, for qualified allocators.

VanEck - 70 years of conviction over convention

VanEck was founded in 1955 by John C. van Eck on a simple but bold idea: understand the world better than the market, and you create real opportunity. That belief led to one of the first international mutual funds in the US, the first gold equity fund in 1968, early conviction in emerging markets, and a pioneering role in ETFs. Today VanEck manages $237 billion in assets across the globe - still privately owned by the van Eck family, guided by the same philosophy it started with.

Crypto ETNs - regulated access to digital assets

VanEck is one of Europe's leading providers of crypto exchange-traded notes, offering investors listed, fully-collateralized exposure to bitcoin, ethereum, and a broad basket of digital assets - without the complexity of self-custody. Simple, transparent, and competitively priced.

VanEck Alpha Fund - owning what goes from relevant to indispensable

The VanEck Alpha Fund is a concentrated, long-biased hedge fund built around the great technology platform shifts of our time: crypto and AI. Since inception in June 2022, the fund has returned +338% net of fees - versus +177% for bitcoin and +103% for the S&P 500 over the same period. The strategy is straightforward: own the right assets, size into conviction, protect the gains.

Join us for an intimate lunch to discuss markets, digital assets, and what comes next.

By registering, you acknowledge that you have read and accepted the VanEck Privacy Policy (https://www.vaneck.com/globalassets/home/ucits/home/privacy-policy/privacy-policy-from-vaneck.com.pdf).

Disclaimer: Investment in digital assets and digital asset products is subject to extreme volatility and may result in loss of principal.

### Stellar Pro Hackathon

36 hours to build, meet ambitious builders, get hands-on support, and put your work in front of the Stellar ecosystem. Come with an idea, leave with something real!

### Register to attend

It's free! Confirm the consents, then apply with your email or sign in to your Rise In account.

### Submission & Final Presentations

- Submission (required for everyone): Every team in both the Genesis and Scale Tracks must submit their project by the deadline.

### About the event

Moving Canada's Africa Strategy from policy to implementation.

Hosted By The Canada-Africa Strategic Innovation Partnership Alliance (CASIPA).

The Canada-Africa Innovation Partnership Summit brings together decision-makers responsible for turning these national priorities into measurable action.

This executive forum moves beyond policy discussion. Participants will identify partnership opportunities, institutional priorities, investment pathways, research collaboration, and implementation mechanisms that support Canada's long-term engagement with Africa.

The summit will contribute to practical recommendations for governments, universities, investors, founders, corporations, innovation organizations, and the African diaspora.

EVENT AGENDA:

The summit will identify practical actions that strengthen Canada-Africa partnerships through innovation, trade, research, investment, diplomacy, entrepreneurship, education, and institutional collaboration.

The discussion will support implementation priorities identified within Canada's Africa Strategy while creating opportunities for sustained collaboration between Canadian and African organizations.

EXECUTIVE DISCUSSION THEMES

Strengthening Canada-Africa Diplomatic Partnerships

Discussion will examine new models for institutional cooperation between governments, universities, business associations, and international organizations while strengthening people-to-people engagement and diaspora participation.

Trade, Investment and Economic Cooperation

Participants will identify opportunities for investment, commercial partnerships, supply chain diversification, implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area, and greater private sector collaboration between Canada and African economies.

Innovation, Research and Commercialization

Discussion will focus on joint research initiatives, technology commercialization, startup collaboration, university partnerships, artificial intelligence, advanced manufacturing, critical minerals, clean technology, health innovation, and knowledge transfer.

Diaspora Leadership

Participants will examine practical approaches for engaging African diaspora communities as strategic partners in investment, innovation, entrepreneurship, education, trade, and diplomacy, consistent with Canada's commitment to strengthen diaspora engagement.

Youth, Skills and Future Workforce Development

The discussion will identify collaborative approaches supporting entrepreneurship, technical education, research exchange, workforce development, and youth employment across Canada and Africa.

IMPLEMENTATION PRIORITIES

Participants will work toward practical recommendations for:

- Canada-Africa Innovation Partnerships
- Bilateral Research Collaborations
- Institutional Memoranda of Understanding
- Investment Readiness Programs
- Startup Exchange Initiatives
- University Partnership Networks
- Trade and Investment Missions
- Public-Private Partnerships
- Talent Mobility Programs
- Diaspora Engagement Frameworks
- Policy Collaboration Mechanisms
- Long-term Canada-Africa Partnership Roadmaps

EXPECTED OUTCOMES

- Executive implementation recommendations
- Cross-sector partnership commitments
- New institutional collaborations
- Research and innovation initiatives
- Investment opportunities
- Government engagement priorities
- University collaboration framework
- Diaspora engagement recommendations
- Canada-Africa implementation roadmap

### About the event

Bitcoin Builders Club is your monthly hangout in Austin, Texas, for devs, hackers, and founders come together to share ideas, demo projects, and explore the cutting edge of what's possible. Whether hacking on Bitcoin Lightning, developing open-source tools, or launching your next startup, this is your space to build in public, connect with peers, and get real-time feedback from a community of open-source creators.

Every month, expect Austin-style hospitality featuring homestyle food prepared by a local chef, cold drinks, and vibrant conversations with fellow hackers, builders, and founders dedicated to pushing bitcoin innovation forward in Austin.

Reach out to us on PlebLab Telegram (https://t.me/+7aSjyq9_hMkxN2Ix) if you are lost.

Start BBC: 6:15 - 6:20 PM

Builder Presentation: 7:00 - 8:15 PM

What can recent Bitcoin security incidents teach us as builders?

This Monday at Bitcoin Builders Club, we'll take a closer look at two interesting cases involving Liquid and COLDCARD - and explore how software, key generation, and security assumptions can shape the safety of Bitcoin systems.

A friendly, technical discussion on what happened, what we can learn, and how to build more robust systems together.

Hope to see you there!

We'll wrap with open Q&A and a full room discussion where you can ask about your own product, pitch, or strategy.

## WoCS Austin X Cloudflare: The Forward Deployed Era + CS's Shift to Revenue

- Record: `luma-evt-SN7UWBBLgEM1tmn`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-24T22:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/womenofcs-0soy>
- Original page: <https://luma.com/womenofcs-0soy>

### About Event

A new role is showing up on org charts across tech, and it's quietly taking the work that used to define the CSM seat.

The Forward Deployed Engineer is now hands-on with implementation and technical delivery in a way that used to sit with Customer Success. As that work moves off the CSM's plate, the CSM seat isn't disappearing, it's being redefined.

That is the real shift, and it is what this evening is about. When technical delivery is no longer how you prove your value, that value has to show up somewhere else, and more and more that somewhere is the number: the renewal, the expansion, the growth of the account. So the questions get practical fast. What do you hand off? What do you hold onto? And how do you build the language and instincts of someone who owns revenue, even if your title does not say so yet?

This time you'll hear from both sides of that handoff: a Forward Deployed Engineer who can tell you exactly what the role owns and why it exists, and a senior Cloudflare Customer Success leader whose team recently brought FDEs into the org, so she has lived what changes for CS when that work moves. The evening moves from fireside chat into small-group roundtable conversations, so every attendee leaves with a specific next step for wherever they sit in this shift.

As always, bites and beverages will be provided

### What We'll Dive Into

- What a Forward Deployed Engineer actually does, and how it differs from a Technical Account Manager or Sales Engineer
- What changes when technical delivery splits off from the CSM seat, and why this is happening industry-wide at the same time
- Who owns the technical build or deployment now, and what CSMs are starting to own instead
- Owning the number: what revenue ownership looks like for CSMs today, how CS value gets measured when it's less about hands-on technical work, and how the FDE partnership shows up in renewals and expansion
- The hardest part of the transition: proving your value and staying close to the customer when you're no longer hands-on with the technical work
- What to build toward over the next year to stay ahead of this shift rather than behind it

### What You'll Take Away

- Real talking points for the handoff conversations happening in your own org right now, straight from people who have lived this restructuring from both sides of it
- Small-group time to work through the one question that hits closest to home for you, alongside peers navigating the same shift
- A clearer read on what to build toward over the next year: the skills, habits, or relationships that put you ahead of this shift rather than behind it

### Who This Is For

- CSMs and Account Managers figuring out what's staying on their plate and what's moving off it
- CS leaders and Directors/VPs who already own, or are being asked to own, a revenue number
- Women working in Onboarding, Implementation, or Technical Account Management wondering what the creation of the FDE role means for them
- Anyone in post-sales who wants to learn more about the Forward Deployed Engineer function

This event is part of the Women of Customer Success community, built for women working in tech and post-sales. If that's you, we'd love to have you in the room.

### How to Access the Cloudflare Office

Enter Cloudflare along Comal St. and check-in at the front desk. Our event will be hosted on the first floor, to the right of security!

### About Women of Customer Success

WoCS is the leading community for the best and brightest women in post-sales roles and leadership. Our mission is to connect, educate, and empower women to thrive in their careers and lead the way forward. With over 10 chapters worldwide, we are cultivating the next generation of women shaping the future of customer experience.

Join the online community and register for our newsletter (https://womenofcustomersuccess.com/join)

Follow us on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/women-of-customer-success/)

## Ethereum Institutional Summit 2026

- Record: `w3v-ethereum-institutional-summit-2026`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-25T08:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://eis.fracton.ventures>

### About

A one-day, invitation-only summit in Tokyo for institutional decision-makers and the founders and researchers shaping the institutional layer of Ethereum.

The summit brings together global institutional investors, Japanese financial institutions, and project leaders for the first time in Japan at this scale.

The summit takes up the moment Ethereum evolves beyond a digital asset into the financial infrastructure of enterprises.

Stablecoin payments connecting corporate treasuries, tokenized real-world assets entering institutional portfolios, onchain treasury operations restructuring accounting and audit, and institutional-grade DeFi protocols - these are no longer thought experiments. They are working systems being built, deployed, and evaluated right now.

Held in English, with Japanese translation provided including subtitles. Closed Roundtable sessions operate under the Chatham House Rule.

Ethereum is the most accessible public blockchain in the world - and, in fact, the world's largest stablecoin network. Yet one challenge remains: to institutional investors, it can look "too public." What will it take, right now, for more institutional assets to be built and put to work on Ethereum? That is the missing piece of the puzzle - and this summit exists to confront it head-on: the future in which institutions run on Ethereum.

## Boston DAO Converge: Crypto, AI & the Future of Agentic Finance

- Record: `luma-evt-yft0JYJNpkPqwAB`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-25T17:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/converge26>
- Original page: <https://luma.com/converge26>

### About the event

Converge is one afternoon built to do a single thing: get every corner of crypto into the same room and pointed at the same questions. Policy, stablecoins, and AI. None of them belong to any one chain.

This is what ETHBoston and Solana Boston become in 2026. Same organizers, same standard, no longer split by ecosystem.

### On stage

- Coinbase on x402 and agentic onchain payments
- Fidelity recording the FCAT Crypto Brief live
- Circle Research on privacy in payments
- Blockworks Research on the Token Transparency Framework
- SEC, the CFTC, and state fight over perpetuals
- Allora Labs on AI, pricing, and trading digital assets
- Quip on post-quantum security
- Lightning talks, short-format pitches from builders across the afternoon
- Groma on real estate tokenization
- A policy panel on market structure legislation and what passes before the midterms
- More to come!

### Three questions worth an afternoon

Stablecoins. The most boring and most consequential thing in crypto. Payment rails, treasury operations, bank integration, and what actually changes when dollars settle instantly and globally by default. Boston has a real claim on this one.

AI. Agents are starting to hold keys, move value, and make decisions without a human in the loop. Agentic finance is the part of the AI story that runs on crypto rails, and it is arriving well ahead of the frameworks built for it.

Policy. Market structure legislation is moving and the midterms are months away. The rules being written right now decide what everyone else in the room is allowed to build. We are putting candidates, officeholders, counsel, and advocates into sessions with the founders they regulate.

Additional programming spans DeFi, security, infrastructure, and market structure.

### Why Boston

Boston is where crypto meets institutional capital. Fidelity, Circle, Coinbase, Castle Island Ventures, and Accomplice all operate here, and MIT, Harvard, BU, and Northeastern feed a steady pipeline of founders and engineers into the ecosystem. Very few cities have both. Converge is the room where the two sides actually meet.

Converge is part of Boston Fintech Week, which puts this audience in front of the city's traditional finance and fintech crowd, and puts that crowd in front of you.

### The room

Builders beside investors. Startups beside institutions. Students beside operators. Two stages on the 16th and 17th floors of Foley Hoag's conference center at 155 Seaport Blvd, with dedicated sponsor and networking space and harbor views.

### After the sessions

The Converge after-party runs at Cisco Brewers Seaport in the open-air bungalow lounge, a short walk from the venue.

### 2026 Sponsors

Platinum

- Fidelity FCAT
- Foley Hoag

Gold

- Quip Network
- Groma
- Stand with Crypto

Silver

- Yearn

Sponsorship for 2026 is still open; reach out to us!

### Presented by The Boston DAO

The Boston DAO has run this city's independent crypto conferences since 2019. ETHBoston in 2019, 2023, 2024, and 2025. Solana Boston in 2024 and 2025, the first Solana city conference held anywhere. Converge is the two of them, merged.

Friday, September 25, 2026 - Foley Hoag Conference Center, Seaport - Part of Boston Fintech Week - Supported by Stand with Crypto

## Monad Blitz Berlin Hackathon

- Record: `luma-host-evt-evt-X2V7EOKGbPXL9Gv`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-26T07:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/blitz-berlin-sep-2026>
- Original page: <https://luma.com/blitz-berlin-sep-2026>

### About the event

Monad Blitz is coming to Berlin!

Monad Blitz is the longest running vibe-coding web3 hackathon where builders ship fast, learn by doing, and plug directly into the Monad ecosystem. Since launching in May 2025, we've taken 50+ editions of this high-energy one-day hackathon concept across the globe. Shanghai to San Francisco. Lagos to Lisbon.

This isn't just a hackathon. It's a direct line into the heart of the Monad ecosystem, putting you in the same room as the founders, builders, and investors pushing it forward every day.

Whether you're a seasoned onchain builder, a founder looking to ship something new, or a Web2 dev crypto-curious for the first time - Blitz is the best environment for you to experiment on Monad.

### What to expect

- A full day of focused building on Monad's high performance EVM.
- $3,000 USD in prizes
- Organic collisions with developers actively building in the ecosystem
- A tight-knit builder community that ships fast and has fun doing it

THE FLOW

- Learn: Morning workshops and hands-on mentoring to get you up to speed on Monad.
- Build: 7 hours of high-speed execution. Form a team or go solo.
- Ship: Demo your MVP to the crowd.
- Win: Claim your share of the $3,000

Capacity is limited. Apply early to secure your spot.

THE SCHEDULE

- 9:00 AM - Registration & Breakfast
- 10:00 AM - Welcome & Monad Blitz Introduction
- 10:15 AM - Monad 101 Workshop
- 11:15 AM - Hacking Begins
- 1:00 PM - Lunch
- 5:00 PM - Code Freeze
- 5:30 PM - Submission Deadline
- 6:00 PM - Pitches
- 7:30 PM - Prizes, Networking & Closing Remarks

### About Monad

https://www.monad.xyz/?utm_source=luma

Monad is a highly performant and EVM compatible layer 1 blockchain. Re-inventing from the ground up, the innovations in both consensus and execution make it possible to achieve throughput up to 10,000 transactions per second (TPS).

### About Monad Blitz

Monad Blitz is a high-energy, one-day hackathon series designed to empower builders on Monad's high-performance EVM. We've traveled from Shenzhen to San Francisco, bringing together developers to learn, squad up, and ship real projects in a single day. With thousands of participants and hundreds of prototypes shipped to date, Blitz is the ultimate venue for fast execution and high-throughput results. Whether you're an EVM veteran or just starting out, this is your invitation to build the future on Monad.

### About Encode Club

https://www.encodeclub.com/

Encode Club is London's leading community for founders and builders in AI and Web3. With weekly events, hackathons, and accelerator programmes, and the Encode Hub (https://hub.encodeclub.com/) coworking space in Shoreditch, it's where ambitious founders come to learn, connect, and grow.

### Disclaimer

By attending an event organized by Monad Foundation, you are entering an area where photography, audio and video live-streaming and/or recording may occur. Your entry and presence at such an event constitutes your consent to be photographed, filmed (including live-streamed), and/or otherwise recorded and to the release, publication, exhibition, or reproduction of any and all recorded media of your appearance, voice, and name for any purpose whatsoever in connection with Monad Foundation and its initiatives. By attending the event, you waive and release any claims you may have related to the use of such media of you at the event.

## 🦠Perp-Dex Day with ReboundX

- Record: `w3v-perp-dex-day-with-reboundx`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-28T07:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed

### About the event

Hosted by ReboundX

Sponsored by Variational - Lighter - ASTER - Extended

(English Below)

전 세계를 휩쓴 E-Sports Trading의 오리지널 콘텐츠가 돌아옵니다.

전 세계에서 가장 바이럴된 Crypto Trading 이벤트의 원조.

Korea Blockchain Week의 밤, 서울에서 다시 펼쳐집니다.

단 하루, 세계 최고의 Perp DEX들이 한자리에 모입니다.

코드가 빗발처럼 쏟아지는 그 밤, 프로젝트 팀과 트레이더들이 직접 만나고 경쟁합니다.

PERP DEX DAY.

온체인 트레이딩의 최전선을 직접 확인하세요.

### Notice

- 본 이벤트는 승인 전용 행사이며, 정원은 600명 한정입니다. 신청자가 정원을 초과할 경우 ReboundX 터미널 (https://www.reboundx.net/en/terminal-exchange/BINANCE/spot/ETHUSDT)/ 리베이트 (https://www.reboundx.net/en) 사용 유저가 우선 선정됩니다.
- 식별을 위해 ReboundX 회원가입 이메일과 동일한 이메일로 Luma 신청 부탁드립니다.
- 행사 중 촬영된 사진-영상이 이벤트 홍보 및 SNS에 사용될 수 있음을 양해해 주시는 것으로 간주됩니다.

일시: 2026년 9월 28일 월요일

위치: 서울 강남 - 상세 주소는 승인자에게 개별 공개

인원: 600명 (승인 전용)

### About ReboundX

크립토 시장은 늘 트레이딩으로 귀결되며, 트레이딩에는 항상 수수료가 발생합니다. ReboundX는 이러한 수수료를 단순한 비용이 아닌 새로운 기회로 바꾸기 위해, 주요 CEX와 Perp DEX를 아우르는 최고 수준의 리베이트 플랫폼으로 시작했습니다. 거래가 발생하는 즉시 리베이트가 계산되며, 24시간 이내 자동 정산됩니다. 현재 ReboundX는 리베이트 플랫폼을 넘어 트레이딩 터미널이자 DEX-CEX 애그리게이터로 진화하고 있습니다. 다양한 거래소를 하나의 인터페이스에서 연결하여, 트레이더들이 모든 거래에서 더 많은 가치를 돌려받을 수 있는 통합 트레이딩 허브를 구축하고 있습니다.

In crypto, trading is where profits are ultimately realized - and trading always comes with fees. ReboundX began as a highest-rate referral rebate platform across top CEXs and Perp DEXs, turning those fees from a cost into a new opportunity. Today, ReboundX is evolving beyond rebates into a trading terminal and a DEX-CEX aggregator - a single trading hub where traders get more back from every transaction.

### About Sponsors

2024년 전체 무기한 선물 시장의 약 2%에 불과했던 Perp DEX는 2025년 한 해 동안 거래량이 4.3배 성장하며, 사상 최초로 월간 거래량 $1T를 돌파했습니다.

2026년에는 CEX 거래량이 30% 이상 감소하는 상황에서도 성장을 이어가며, 전체 파생상품 시장의 10% 이상을 차지하는 구조적인 시장 축으로 자리잡았습니다. 최고점에서는 시장 점유율이 24%까지 치솟았습니다.

이는 단순한 일시적 트렌드를 넘어, 트레이더들이 중앙화거래소(CEX) 대신 Perp DEX를 선택하는 수요가 본격적으로 자리잡고 있음을 보여줍니다.

앞으로도 온체인 파생상품 시장의 구조적 성장이 이어질 것으로 예상되는 가운데, 글로벌 Perp DEX 시장을 선도하는 주요 프로젝트들이 PERP DEX DAY와 함께합니다.

Variational

2026년 글로벌 0티어 Perp DEX로 주목받고 있는 프로젝트. 크립토 헤지펀드를 DCG에 매각한 경험을 가진 파운더들이 설립한 RFQ 기반 Perp Engine으로, RWA를 포함한 다양한 자산을 온체인에서 거래할 수 있는 인프라를 구축하고 있습니다.

Total Raised: $61.8M

Backed by: Dragonfly, Bain Capital, Coinbase, Zoku Ventures 외 9개 글로벌 투자사

Lighter

18세에 하버드대학교를 졸업하고 수학 올림피아드 수상 및 Citadel을 포함한 글로벌 헤지펀드 경력을 가진 파운더가 설립한 Perp DEX. 블록체인 Perp 시장에서 Zero-Fee 모델을 선도적으로 구현했으며, Robinhood와 Founders Fund 등 글로벌 금융-투자사로부터 투자를 유치했습니다. 현재 Robinhood Chain의 온체인 ZK Perp Engine을 담당하고 있습니다.

Total Raised: $68M

Backed by: Ribbit Capital, Founders Fund, Robinhood, Haun Ventures

Aster

Aster는 YZi Labs의 지원을 받는 프라이버시 중심의 무기한 선물 거래소입니다. 사용자의 거래 활동을 보호하기 위해 Hidden Orders와 같은 기술을 제공하는 것이 특징입니다. 또한 암호화폐, 주식, 원자재에 대한 무기한 선물 계약뿐만 아니라 암호화폐 현물 거래도 지원합니다.

Aster의 기반에는 Aster Chain이 있으며, 이는DeFi의 미래를 구현하기 위해 설계된 Layer 1 블록체인입니다.

Total Raised: Undisclosed

Backed by: YZi Labs

Extended

유럽 대표 핀테크 기업 Revolut의 Crypto 출신 파운더들이 설립한 Perp DEX. 투명성과 강력한 매칭 엔진을 핵심으로, 마켓메이커와 트레이더 사이에서 보다 중립적이고 신뢰할 수 있는 거래 환경을 구축하고 있습니다.

Total Raised: $19M

Backed by: eToro, Jump Crypto 외 7개 글로벌 투자사

In 2024, Perp DEXs accounted for just 2% of the global perpetual futures market. In 2025, trading volume grew 4.3x, surpassing $1T in monthly volume for the first time.

In 2026, Perp DEXs have continued to grow even as CEX volumes declined by more than 30%, capturing over 10% of the overall derivatives market and establishing themselves as a structural pillar of the industry. At its peak, Perp DEX market share reached as high as 24%.

This growth signals more than a temporary trend. It reflects a growing preference among traders to choose Perp DEXs over centralized exchanges, pointing to strong long-term potential for the on-chain derivatives market.

And now, some of the leading Perp DEXs by global market share are coming together for PERP DEX DAY.

Variational

A globally recognized top-tier Perp DEX in 2026, founded by entrepreneurs who previously built and sold a crypto hedge fund to DCG. Variational is building an RFQ-based Perp Engine designed to bring a wide range of assets, including RWAs, on-chain.

Total Raised: $61.8M

Backed by: Dragonfly, Bain Capital, Coinbase, Zoku Ventures, and 9+ global investors

Lighter

Founded by a former Citadel and global hedge fund professional who graduated from Harvard at 18 and was a Math Olympiad medalist. Lighter pioneered the Zero-Fee model in blockchain perpetuals and has attracted backing from leading global financial and investment firms, including Robinhood and Founders Fund. Lighter is also powering the on-chain ZK Perp Engine for Robinhood Chain.

Total Raised: $68M

Aster

Aster is a privacy-first perpetual futures exchange where your positions, orders and trading activity stay hidden from other market participants.

Total Raised: Undisclosed

Backed by: YZi Labs

Extended

A Perp DEX founded by former crypto executives from Revolut, one of Europe's leading fintech companies. Built around transparency and a powerful matching engine, Extended aims to create a more neutral, trusted trading environment between market makers and traders.

Total Raised: $19M

Backed by: eToro, Jump Crypto, and 7+ global investors

### About the Event

AI is reshaping the way trading decisions are made. As AI agents begin to perform technical analysis, execute strategies, and place orders automatically, the role of human judgment is being redefined.

When automation tools become widely accessible, what will remain as the real edge for traders?

AI Meets the Chart brings together AI builders, quantitative researchers, and frontline traders to discuss how AI is being integrated into real trading workflows. The event will explore the practical application of AI quant trading, Agentic Trading frameworks, latency-sensitive execution, and the current boundaries of automated decision-making.

Through keynote sessions, panel discussions, and networking, participants will examine where AI can enhance trading performance, where human judgment still matters, and how traders should position themselves in the next phase of AI-driven markets.

To make the experience even more exciting, we've prepared a range of exciting prizes, including gift cards and gold. All participants will have the opportunity to win prizes through our event giveaways and lucky draws.

### About the Event

Onchain Capital & Liquidity: DeFi & AI is a curated gathering of builders, founders, liquidity providers, and investors shaping the next generation of decentralized financial markets.

As DeFi continues to evolve, liquidity infrastructure, capital efficiency, and sustainable token economies are becoming the backbone of the onchain financial system. This event focuses on how protocols, market makers, and funds are designing new models for liquidity, trading, and capital coordination across crypto networks.

This is a capital-first room. High signal. No fluff.

### Topics You'll See

- Liquidity design and market structure in DeFi
- Capital efficiency and onchain yield strategies
- Tokenomics and sustainable liquidity models
- Market making and institutional liquidity in crypto
- Cross-chain liquidity infrastructure
- The future of onchain financial markets

### What to Expect

- Curated founders, DeFi builders, and liquidity providers
- Deep discussions on market structure and capital flows
- Insights from teams actively deploying capital onchain
- High-quality networking with DeFi-focused investors and funds
- A relaxed, closed-door environment for real conversations

### Agenda (Indicative)

4:00 - 4:45 PM | Arrival & Networking

4:45 - 5:30 PM | Panel: Liquidity Wars - Designing Sustainable DeFi Markets

5:30 - 6:00 PM | Talk: Capital Efficiency & DeFi Market Infrastructure

6:00 - 6:30 PM | Keynote: The Future of Onchain Capital

6:30 - 8:00 PM | Networking & Social

## Crypto Compliance and Legal Roundtable, hosted by Solidus Labs and Yulchon

- Record: `w3v-crypto-compliance-and-legal-roundtable`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-09-29T07:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/fop77t0t>

### About the event

Crypto Compliance & Legal Roundtable | Seoul

Join us on September 29 during the Korea Blockchain Week in Seoul for an exclusive, invitation-only Crypto Compliance and Legal Roundtable, bringing together a selected group of compliance and legal leaders, regulators, and policy experts.

Hosted by Solidus Labs and Yulchon, this in-person session will focus on advancing global crypto compliance through practical discussion. The roundtable is designed to foster open dialogue, share best practices, and identify actionable solutions to today's most pressing regulatory and compliance challenges.

### Agenda

16:30 - Registration

17:00 - 18:30- Roundtable discussions: Best practices, challenges, and actionable solutions across key crypto compliance and legal topics, including:

- Tokenization and Implementation of the amended Capital Markets Act and Electronic Securities Act
  - How the recently enacted framework will be implemented in practice, including issuance, distribution and the treatment of investment contract securities.
    - Speaker: Ik Hyun Kim, Partner at Yulchon leading the blockchain and digital assets practice
- Cross-border VASP compliance -
  - Korea's planned extension of the Travel Rule to transfers below KRW 1 million
  - Growing regulatory focus on foreign and unregistered VASPs.
  - Stablecoins transfers and future challenges.
    - Speaker: Claire Lee, CEO of CODE
- Unfair Coin Trading Regulatory Frameworks in Korea
  - Overview of actual prosecution and referral cases over the past two years to examine the rankings of the most prevalent types of unfair trading practices and sheds light on the specific schemes and deceptive methods unique to the Korean virtual asset market
    - Speakers: Jackie Baek, Compliance Head of Korea at Crypto.com (https://Crypto.com)

18:30 - Networking

Address: Yulchon, Parnas Tower, 38F 521 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu Seoul Republic of Korea

Places are limited. Registration is subject to approval.

### About Yulchon

Yulchon is a full-service law firm headquartered in Seoul, Korea, advising on a full range of specialized practice areas, including corporate & finance, antitrust, tax, real estate & construction, dispute resolution, intellectual property & technology, and labor & employment. The firm was established in 1997 and has about 700 professionals. In addition to our main offices in Seoul, Yulchon has six overseas offices across five jurisdictions and 10 regional practice teams worldwide. The firm provides the highest quality of legal services to its clients around the globe, including their most complex legal matters.

Yulchon's Blockchain/Virtual Assets Team consists of seasoned experts who bring a wealth of experience and exceptional knowledge to deliver the highest standard of legal services in Korea's finance, blockchain, and virtual asset sectors.

### About Solidus Labs

Born in crypto and built for efficiency across all asset classes, Solidus Labs is the category-definer for agentic-based compliance in trade surveillance and risk monitoring. At its core is HALO, an AI-powered, risk-based platform trusted globally by financial institutions, crypto firms, and regulators to enable proactive, intelligence-led oversight across any product, venue, or asset class.

### 🇬🇧 Liquidity Evening by Turtle

Kick off KBW the right way.

The night before the conference opens, join us on a rooftop in the heart of Gangnam for an evening built for the people actually moving liquidity.

Two short keynotes and one panel on where LPs are actually deploying in Korea. The rest of the night is drinks and conversation with the funds, family offices, and builders shaping liquidity in this market. Rooftop in Gangnam, drinks, Seoul skyline.

Date: Tuesday, 29 September 2026

Time: 6:30 PM to 10:00 PM

Venue: L7 Gangnam Floating Bar, Gangnam, Seoul

Language: English, with bilingual hosting

Hosted by: Turtle (https://x.com/turtledotxyz) and Lunar Strategy (https://x.com/LunarStrategy)

Co-hosts: Bond (https://x.com/BondSuperApp_) and 0G Labs (https://x.com/0G_labs)

Premium sponsor: Credi (https://x.com/credilabs)

### Speakers

Essi Lagevardi (https://x.com/SuperChad15), CEO and Founder of Turtle (https://x.com/turtledotxyz) - building one of crypto's largest liquidity coordination networks.

Taweh Beysolow II (https://x.com/TawehBeysolow), CEO and Co-founder of Bond (https://x.com/BondSuperApp_) - ex-Jump Trading and Flowdesk quant, now building the first DeFi super app for the agentic economy.

Michael Heinrich (https://x.com/michaelh_0g), CEO and Co-founder of 0G Labs (https://x.com/0G_labs) - leading the largest AI L1 ecosystem with $325M+ raised; Forbes 40 under 40, ex-Bridgewater and Microsoft.

Alessio Marinelli (https://www.linkedin.com/in/marinellialessio/), CEO of Credi (https://x.com/credilabs) - tokenizing private credit and SME receivables, bringing real-world yield on-chain since 2017.

Tim Haldorsson (https://x.com/TimHaldorsson), Founder of Lunar Strategy (https://x.com/LunarStrategy) and CMO at Turtle - panel moderator. In crypto since 2017, helping 400+ projects scale.

### Who this is for

LPs, family offices, and funds allocating in APAC. Builders and protocols working on liquidity infrastructure. If you move capital or build where it flows, this evening is for you.

### The agenda

- 6:30 PM - Doors open, drinks and catering
- 7:30 PM - Opening keynote: Essi Lagevardi, CEO of Turtle
- 7:45 PM - Partner keynote: Taweh Beysolow II, CEO of Bond
- 8:00 PM - Partner keynote: Michael Heinrich, CEO of 0G Labs: Welcome to the Trillion-Dollar Agentic Economy
- 8:15 PM - Panel: How institutional capital finds DeFi: from first touch to allocation
- 8:35 PM onward - Networking and on-site interviews
- 10:00 PM - Doors close

### Your hosts

Turtle (https://x.com/turtledotxyz) is a liquidity distribution protocol connecting asset issuers to a verified network of 432,000+ on-chain LPs through a unified platform that handles deal sourcing, due diligence, incentive distribution, billing, and LP relationship management, all verifiable on chain.

Lunar Strategy (https://x.com/LunarStrategy), part of Turtle Group, is the crypto growth agency behind 400+ projects since 2019 - from token launches to ecosystem campaigns.

### About our partners

Bond (https://x.com/BondSuperApp_) is the first DeFi super app built for AI agents - trading, lending, and payments in one platform, launched on 0G.

0G Labs (https://x.com/0G_labs) is building the foundational Layer 1 for decentralized AI, with $325M raised and one of the fastest-growing ecosystems in crypto.

Credi (https://x.com/credilabs) brings private credit on-chain, tokenizing high-quality SME receivables to connect DeFi liquidity with real-world yield.

Set on a rooftop deck, with the covered lounge hosting the keynotes and panel. Your first stop before KBW opens.

Spots are limited and registrations are reviewed. Register below to secure yours.

Photos and video will be taken at this event. By registering and being approved, you agree that your image may appear in event coverage and future marketing.

### 🇰🇷 Turtle과 함께하는 Liquidity Evening

KBW의 시작을 함께할 특별한 저녁에 여러분을 초대합니다.

본 컨퍼런스 개막 전날 밤, 강남 중심부의 루프탑에서 실제로 유동성을 움직이는 사람들을 위한 특별한 저녁이 펼쳐집니다.

한국에서 LP들의 자금이 실제로 어디로 향하고 있는지에 대한 두 번의 짧은 키노트와 패널 세션이 진행되며, 이후에는 펀드, 패밀리 오피스, 빌더들과 자유롭게 이야기하고 네트워킹하는 시간을 갖습니다.

강남의 루프탑에서 드링크와 함께 서울의 야경을 즐기며 KBW를 시작해보세요.

날짜: 2026년 9월 29일(화)

시간: 오후 6:30 ~ 10:00

장소: L7 강남 플로팅 바, 서울 강남

언어: 영어, 한-영 이중언어 진행

주최: Turtle (https://x.com/turtledotxyz) & Lunar Strategy (https://x.com/LunarStrategy)

공동 주최: Bond (https://x.com/BondSuperApp_) & 0G Labs (https://x.com/0G_labs)

프리미엄 스폰서: Credi (https://x.com/credilabs)

### 연사

- Essi Lagevardi, (https://x.com/SuperChad15) Turtle CEO & Founder - 크립토 업계 최대 규모 중 하나인 유동성 조정 네트워크를 구축하고 있습니다.
- Taweh Beysolow II (https://x.com/TawehBeysolow), Bond CEO & Co-founder - 전 Jump Trading 및 Flowdesk 퀀트로, 현재 에이전틱 이코노미를 위한 최초의 DeFi 슈퍼앱을 구축하고 있습니다.
- Michael Heinrich (https://x.com/michaelh_0g), 0G Labs CEO & Co-founder - 3억 2,500만 달러 이상의 투자를 유치한 최대 규모의 AI L1 생태계를 이끌고 있습니다. Forbes 40 Under 40에 선정되었으며 Bridgewater와 Microsoft를 거쳤습니다.
- Alessio Marinelli (https://www.linkedin.com/in/marinellialessio/), Credi CEO - 프라이빗 크레딧과 중소기업(SME) 매출채권을 토큰화하며, 2017년부터 실물자산에서 발생하는 수익을 온체인으로 가져오고 있습니다.
- Tim Haldorsson (https://x.com/TimHaldorsson), Lunar Strategy Founder & Turtle CMO - 패널 모더레이터. 2017년부터 크립토 업계에서 활동하며 300개 이상의 프로젝트 성장을 지원했습니다.

### 이런 분들을 위한 자리입니다

아시아 시장에 자금을 운용하고 있는 LP, 패밀리 오피스 및 펀드, 그리고 유동성 인프라를 구축하고 있는 빌더와 프로토콜 관계자를 위한 자리입니다. 자본을 움직이거나 자본이 흐르는 곳을 만들어가고 있다면, 이번 저녁은 여러분을 위한 자리입니다.

### 행사 일정

- 오후 6:30 - 입장 및 웰컴 드링크
- 오후 7:00 - 케이터링 및 커스텀 칵테일
- 오후 7:30 - 오프닝 키노트: Turtle CEO Essi Lagevardi
- 오후 7:45 - 파트너 키노트: Bond CEO Taweh Beysolow II
- 오후 8:00 - 파트너 키노트: 0G Labs CEO Michael Heinrich
- 오후 8:15 - 패널: 한국의 LP와 유동성 분배
- 오후 8:35 이후 - 자유 네트워킹 및 현장 인터뷰 촬영
- 오후 10:00 - 행사 종료

### 주최사 소개

Turtle은 자산 발행사와 432,000명 이상의 검증된 온체인 LP 네트워크를 연결하는 유동성 분배 프로토콜입니다. 딜 소싱, 실사, 인센티브 분배, 빌링 및 LP 관계 관리까지 하나의 통합 플랫폼에서 지원하며, 모든 과정은 온체인에서 검증할 수 있습니다.

Turtle Group의 일원인 Lunar Strategy는 2019년부터 400개 이상의 프로젝트와 함께해 온 크립토 성장 에이전시로, 토큰 출시부터 생태계 캠페인까지 다양한 프로젝트의 성장을 지원해 왔습니다.

파트너 소개

Bond는 AI 에이전트를 위해 구축된 최초의 DeFi 슈퍼앱으로, 트레이딩, 렌딩, 결제를 하나의 플랫폼에서 제공하며 0G에서 출시되었습니다.

0G Labs는 탈중앙화 AI를 위한 기반 Layer 1을 구축하고 있으며, 3억 2,500만 달러의 투자를 유치하고 크립토 업계에서 가장 빠르게 성장하는 생태계 중 하나를 만들어가고 있습니다.

Credi는 우량 중소기업 매출채권을 토큰화하여 DeFi 유동성과 실물자산 수익을 연결하고, 프라이빗 크레딧을 온체인으로 가져오고 있습니다.

본 행사는 루프탑 데크에서 진행되며, 키노트와 패널 세션은 실내 라운지에서 진행됩니다.

KBW가 시작되기 전, 가장 먼저 함께할 자리입니다.

참석 인원은 제한되어 있으며, 모든 신청은 검토 후 승인됩니다. 아래에서 등록하여 자리를 신청해 주세요.

본 행사에서는 사진 및 영상 촬영이 진행됩니다. 행사 등록 후 참석 승인을 받으시면, 행사 관련 콘텐츠 및 향후 마케팅 자료에 본인의 모습이 포함될 수 있음에 동의하는 것으로 간주됩니다.

### About the event

Join us on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, during Sibos Miami 2026 at The Bass Art Museum, located just minutes from the Convention Center, for Opening Bell: Institutional Breakfast: Unlocking Velocity in Trade & Payments, from 7:30AM to 9:30 AM.

Presented by Contour (https://www.contour.network/), powered by XDC Network (https://xdc.tech/?utm_source=luma), and hosted by Agentic Day and Miami Fintech Club, this private, invitation-only morning will bring together leaders from across global trade, payments, and institutional finance.

### About This Morning

Trade finance, payments, stablecoins, digital currencies, standards, and Agentic AI are rapidly converging. This morning will explore how institutions can move beyond fragmented systems toward faster, more connected global financial infrastructure.

The program will combine a refined breakfast, curated networking, and an interactive panel, followed by time for continued conversations before guests return to Sibos Day 2.

### Agenda

7:30 AM - Doors open, breakfast and networking

8:00 AM - Panel and Q&A

8:45 AM - Networking

### The Panel

Unlocking Velocity in Trade to Payments: Digitisation, AI Agents & Stablecoins

A focused panel followed by an open discussion, inviting participants to share perspectives, challenge assumptions, and identify opportunities for collaboration.

### Speakers

Rahul Bhargava

Interim COO, Contour & Sr. Financial Sector Consultant, World Bank

Alexandre Kech

CEO

Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF)

Further speakers to be announced.

### Media Partner

FF News | Fintech Finance (https://ffnews.com/)

Yellow (https://yellow.com)

Who's in the Room

Senior leaders from banks, central banks, regulatory and standards bodies, corporate treasuries, market infrastructures, payments and digital currency companies, and Agentic AI and financial technology firms.

About the Venue: The Bass Art Museum

Originally built in the 1930s, The Bass combines historic Art Deco architecture with contemporary design and rotating exhibitions. The event will be held in the museum's striking Lindemann Family Courtyard, featuring elements of the original building and a soaring 29-foot ceiling.

### About the event

The Big Whale (https://www.thebigwhale.io/) is the leading Market Intelligence provider on Digital Assets, serving 150+ institutional & corporate clients across banks, asset managers, fintechs and digital asset companies.

Join TBW (https://www.thebigwhale.io/), Payward Services (https://www.payward.com/payward-services), DFNS (https://dfns.co/), 21X (https://21x.eu/), Société Générale Forge (https://www.sgforge.com/), and BNP Paribas (https://group.bnpparibas/en/) (AssetFoundry) for an exclusive breakfast in Miami during Sibos!

The payments stack has been under pressure for years. Correspondent banking is expensive and slow. Cross-border rails remain opaque. And the promise of real-time, low-cost global transfers has largely stayed out of reach.

Blockchain infrastructure and stablecoins are now offering an alternative. Not as a disruption from outside, but increasingly as a layer that banks, PSPs, and fintechs are building into their own architectures.

During this exclusive morning, we'll bring together banks, PSPs, trade finance players and fintechs to examine where this rebuild is already happening, what it takes to integrate blockchain and stablecoin infrastructure at scale, and who the real winners of the new payment stack will be.

Thanks to Payward Services, SG Forge, 21X, BNP Paribas, and DFNS for making this event possible. Attending? Share your presence with a dedicated visual here! (https://breakfasts.thebigwhale.io/#miami-september29)

8:30AM - Welcome coffee & croissants

9:00AM - "Stablecoins in Practice: Where They Actually Move Money Today"

- Stéphanie Cabossioras, Chief Strategy at Société Générale Forge (https://www.sgforge.com/)
- Clarisse Hagège, Founder & CEO at DFNS (https://dfns.co/)
- Mark Greenberg, Chief Commercial Officer at Payward Services (https://www.payward.com/)

9:35AM - "Build or Buy: Should You Launch Your Own Stablecoin - or Just Use One?"

- Marek Socha, MD Global Markets at 21X (https://21x.eu/)
- Julien Clausse, Head of AssetFoundry at BNP Paribas (https://group.bnpparibas/en/)

9:50AM - Networking Session

Seats are limited to foster deep, honest discussions and high-quality networking.

Priority access will be given to Corporate members.

Important: doors close at 9:00 AM. It will not be possible to join after that time.

> *English version is available below.

Solana Summit Korea는 한국의 스테이블코인, 규제 프레임워크, 그리고 자본시장의 미래를 그려나갈 기관 중심의 Invite-only 컨퍼런스입니다. 기관 리더, 정책 입안자, 규제 당국, 그리고 디지털 자산 분야를 개척하는 선구자들을 모십니다.

- 일시: 9월 30일 (수) 9:30 - 17:00
- 장소: 서울 여의도
  *상세 정보는 승인된 티켓 소지자에게 안내됩니다.

현재 정부가 스테이블코인 제도화를 적극적으로 추진함에 따라, 서울은 글로벌 정책과 기관 금융이 교차하는 독보적인 위치에 서게 되었습니다.

Korea Blockchain Week(KBW) 2026 기간 중 개최되는 본 서밋은 리테일 마케팅을 배제하고, 기관의 실질적 도입, 운영 준비, 그리고 규제 대응에 집중합니다. 스테이블코인 시대를 준비하는 전통 금융기관과 그 전환을 이끄는 글로벌 선구자들이 직접 연결되는 최고 수준의 장을 지향합니다.

공식 웹사이트 (https://summit.superteamkr.com)

### 기대할 수 있는 것

- 한국 금융 허브의 중심: 서울 여의도에서 열리는 기관 중심 컨퍼런스
- 실행 가능한 인사이트: 솔라나의 주요 전략적 글로벌 파트너들이 전하는 실질적 강연과 임원급 키노트
- 기관 PoC 쇼케이스: 솔라나 재단과 국내 주요 금융기관이 공동 구축한 개념검증(PoC)의 라이브 시연
- 최고 수준의 네트워킹: 메인 컨퍼런스 홀과 분리된 네트워킹 공간 및 프라이빗 오찬

### 참석 대상

- 기관: 디지털 자산 관련 실질적 과제를 추진 중인 상업은행, 자산운용사, 증권사, 핀테크의 임원급 리더
- 정책 입안자 및 규제 당국: 한국의 스테이블코인 및 디지털 자산 입법 프레임워크를 설계하는 관계자 및 자문위원
- 디지털 자산 선구자: 스테이블코인, RWA, 기관용 DeFi에 집중하는 솔라나 생태계 내 창업자 및 핵심 인프라 구축자
- 오피니언 리더: 엄선된 기관 리서치 애널리스트 및 최상위 금융-기술 분야 저널리스트

### Solana Summit is Coming To Korea 🇰🇷

Solana Summit Korea 2026 is a private, curated, and invitation-only conference designed to bring together institutional leaders, policymakers, regulators, and digital asset pioneers in a room where real decisions get made.

- September 30, Wed 10:30 - 17:00
- Yeouido, Seoul

> Please note: Detailed location and entry instructions will be provided to approved ticket holders.

Official Website (https://summit.superteamkr.com)

The defining institutional gathering shaping the future of stablecoins, regulatory frameworks, and capital markets in Korea.

Korea's current administration is actively legislating a stablecoin framework, uniquely positioning Seoul at the intersection of global policy and institutional finance.

Held during Korea Blockchain Week (KBW) 2026, this summit bypasses retail marketing to focus exclusively on institutional adoption, operational readiness, and regulatory compliance.

It serves as the premier space where traditional financial organizations preparing for the stablecoin era connect directly with the global pioneers driving that transition forward.

### What To Expect

- The Center of Korea's Financial Hub: A focused, high-touch institutional conference located in Yeouido, Seoul.
- Actionable Insights: Practical talks and executive keynotes from Solana's major strategic global partners.
- Institutional PoC Showcase: Live demonstrations of Proof of Concepts (PoC) co-built by Superteam Korea and leading Korean financial institutions.
- High-Caliber Networking: A dedicated executive networking lounge separate from the main conference hall, paired with a networking lunch.

### Who Should Attend?

- Institutions: Executive leaders from commercial banks, asset managers, securities firms, and fintechs with active digital asset mandates.
- Policymakers & Regulators: Officials and advisors shaping Korea's stablecoin and digital asset legislative framework.
- Digital Asset Pioneers: Founders and core infrastructure builders within the Solana ecosystem focusing on Stablecoins, RWA, and Institutional DeFi.
- Thought Leaders: Select institutional research analysts and top-tier financial/tech journalists.

> Entry is invite-only & application-based. Due to venue capacity and the curated nature of the event, registration does not guarantee approval.

### About the event

Convergence is a curated evening soirée during Sibos Miami 2026, hosted by OpenZeppelin, WisdomTree, and DFNS, for the leaders bringing traditional finance onchain.

Finance is moving onchain. Tokenized funds, stablecoins, digital custody, and onchain settlement are becoming part of institutional infrastructure, and the people building that shift rarely get a room of their own at a conference of 10,000.

This evening is that room: banks, asset managers, payment networks, capital markets infrastructure, fintechs and neobanks, alongside the teams securing and powering their move onchain. Real conversations, away from the noise of the conference floor.

Join us on Wednesday, September 30 for cocktails in a private venue surrounded by modern art, 4 minutes from the Miami Beach Convention Center (MBCC).

Previous Convergence events drew senior guests from firms including J.P. Morgan, Citi, UBS, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, BNY, Fidelity, Mastercard, Deloitte, and more.

The evening is limited to 100 guests to keep it at conversation scale. Registration is subject to hosts' approval.

### About the hosts

OpenZeppelin (https://www.openzeppelin.com/) is the security standard for onchain finance. Since 2015, its industry-standard smart contracts library has powered $37 trillion in value transferred, alongside 900+ security engagements for leading institutions, blockchain networks, and protocols including DTCC, Fidelity Digital Assets, WisdomTree, Aave, the Canton Foundation and the Ethereum Foundation. Learn more at openzeppelin.com (https://openzeppelin.com).

WisdomTree (https://www.wisdomtree.com/corporate) is a global financial innovator offering a diverse suite of exchange-traded products, models, digital assets, and solutions. A pioneer in bringing regulated tokenized funds to market, WisdomTree is building the bridge between traditional asset management and onchain finance.

Dfns (http://dfns.co/?utm_source=luma) is the leading Wallets-as-a-Service (WaaS) platform to manage digital asset operations and build applications onchain. Dfns is trusted by over 400 fintechs and financial institutions, including Circle, Stripe, First Abu Dhabi Bank, Standard Chartered Bank, Apex, Susquehanna, MoonPay, Fidelity, and many others.

Event Photography

We'll be capturing photos and videos throughout the event. By attending, you agree that we may use event content (including your image) in our marketing materials, social media, and future promotions. If you prefer not to be photographed, please let us know at check-in.

Registration details may be shared with event co-hosts WisdomTree and Dfns for event coordination.

### About the event

Lisbon has always been a city for the people who explore and build. Following that same spirit, INPUT, Paybis and nSureAI (https://Nsure.ai) are bringing together the founders, investors and operators reshaping iGaming and payments, for an evening in Alfama, the oldest neighbourhood in Lisbon.

October 1st, at La Distillerie, a 19th century distillery at the heart of the neighbourhood. Music, Portuguese wine, and the kind of company worth writing home about.

### What to expect

- Founders, investors, and leaders from across iGaming and payments
- Portuguese wine tasting led by a sommelier
- Cocktails and canapés throughout
- DJ set through the night
- Postcard Corner: pick a card, write something worth sending, and drop it in the box. It gets stamped and mailed straight to your door.
- A relaxed evening, no agenda, no panels, just good company

The venue

La Distillerie sits at the heart of Alfama, Lisbon's oldest neighbourhood. A 19th century distillery, high ceilings, stone walls, authentic Portuguese details.

Co-hosted by Paybis

Paybis makes crypto simple for individuals and enterprises. Established in 2014, the company combines a trusted crypto exchange and wallet - to buy, sell, swap and hold over 90 cryptocurrencies - with award-winning crypto-fiat infrastructure. This infrastructure empowers businesses to transfer capital globally, eliminating traditional payment friction.

In 2026, Paybis was recognized as the Best Crypto Payment Provider, a testament to our expansive global reach, rapid onboarding protocols, and the deep expertise of the 200 dedicated professionals who drive our operations.

Processing more than $6bn annually, Paybis is one of the most efficient platforms for acquiring and transacting in digital assets. This commitment to operational excellence is why Paybis maintains one of the highest ratings for crypto companies on Trustpilot, and why 7 million users and hundreds of the world's fastest-growing enterprises consistently rely on our services.

Co-hosted by nSureAI (https://www.nsure.ai/?utm_source=luma)

nSureAI is an AI-native payment fraud prevention solution that turns risk management into a scalable growth engine. It serves crypto exchanges, digital asset platforms, fintechs, stablecoin PSPs, remittance providers, iGaming operators, and prepaid platforms (incl. gift cards), empowering high-risk merchants to maximize net incremental profit by removing payment friction and false declines.

Instead of static rules or shared pooled models,nSureAI builds a dedicated AI model for every merchant, trained on their unique transaction data to isolate legitimate buyer behavior. Backed by a 100% financial liability shift (chargeback guarantee), the platform approves more valid customers to deliver approval rates up to 98%.

Processing over $200B in annual volume, nSureAIis one of the most scalable fraud engines in digital commerce. Rendering decisions under 500ms and handling peak volumes of $80M/hr, nSureAI's operational excellence has driven 3x YoY growth while safeguarding leading global enterprises.

## Metropolis Hackathon Builder Day: London \| $250,000 in prizes

- Record: `luma-host-evt-evt-x18sFHsWoSwnaIP`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-02T09:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/metropolis-lon-oct-2026>
- Original page: <https://luma.com/metropolis-lon-oct-2026>

### About the event

Monad Metropolis is Monad's flagship global hackathon - six weeks, online-first, $250,000 in prizes. This is the London hacker house: one day at Encode Hub to meet other builders working on Metropolis, get your questions answered, and put real hours into your submission.

Metropolis runs 1 September to 13 October. Wherever you are in that window - still shaping an idea, looking for teammates, or deep in the build - this day is for you.

### What to expect

Morning: around two hours of talks and workshops. A technical session run by Monad's engineering team, plus speakers on the things that decide whether a hackathon project becomes a company - go-to-market, fundraising, business model, community and hiring.

Rest of the day: coworking. Desks, fast wifi, coffee, and mentors on the floor.

Come with a team or find one here.

### The Tracks

Onchain Finance & Trading - asset primitives and market infrastructure that only work with fast settlement.

Consumer Products & Payments - crypto that doesn't feel like crypto. Social payments, salary streaming, programmable gifts.

Social, Attention & Culture - open social graphs, attention markets, generative art, competitive feeds.

Trust, Identity & AI Infrastructure - primitives for an AI-native internet. Proof of personhood, content passports, data lockers.

### Prizes

$250,000 total. $30,000 overall winner, $30,000 per track, plus 20+ sponsor bounties from Dynamic, Privy, Perpl, Nansen, Chainlink, Agora, Kuru, MetaMask and others.

### Who should come

Developers, designers and founders building on Monad - or curious about it. Solo builders welcome; teams form on the day. You don't need prior Monad experience, but bring a laptop.

Registration is free and capacity is limited.

Register for Metropolis itself at hackathon.monad.xyz - this event is a London meetup during the build window, not a substitute for entering.

### 0G DevDay: ZERO TO INFINITY

National Gallery Singapore - where history was made. Now we build what's next.

0G DevDay takes over the Supreme Court Terrace & Glass Room at National Gallery Singapore, in the heart of the city's historic Civic District. Housed within the former Supreme Court and City Hall - two national monuments that witnessed some of the defining moments in Singapore's history - the Gallery is a place where the past is preserved and new ideas continue to take shape.

Under the iconic Rotunda dome, historic architecture meets a soaring contemporary glass canopy - a fitting home for ZERO TO INFINITY. For this one day, this space becomes our playground for the next frontier: AI demos, ecosystem showcases, conversations, food, drinks, and the people building what comes next.

A place that holds history. A day to create the next chapter.

Whether you're building AI, investing in its future, or simply curious where the industry is headed next, ZERO TO INFINITY by 0G DevDay is your opportunity to experience the technologies already redefining what's possible.

The future of AI isn't waiting for permission. It already left the ground.

### Venue: National Gallery Singapore

Set within one of Singapore's most celebrated destinations, the venue provides an inspiring backdrop for a day of groundbreaking ideas, immersive experiences, meaningful connections, and the future of AI.

## The Capital Summit x Asia Stablecoin Conference

- Record: `token2049-side-6a98c34d967be0befa88b066`

### What Is Shaping Asia's Digital Asset Market Structure?

Stablecoins and tokenized assets are developing differently across Korea, Japan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Southeast Asia, and the UAE - reflecting each market's regulatory, monetary, and capital-market structure.

The next phase will require more than issuance. It will require a complete institutional market structure supporting the full asset lifecycle:

Issuance → Investment → Distribution → Secondary-Market Liquidity → Independent Assessment

The Singapore edition of The Capital Summit x Asia Stablecoin Conference will focus on five areas:

1. Stablecoin Issuance - Which models can scale across Asia?
2. Tokenization - Which Asian assets will attract global investors?
3. Secondary Markets - Where will tokenized assets trade?
4. Distribution - How will institutions bring these assets to market?
5. Ratings - What frameworks will investors require?

### Programme at a Glance

9:00-11:00 a.m.Executive BreakfastCurated seating, introductions, and senior-level networking

12:00-5:00 p.m.Main ConferenceInstitutional keynotes and focused panel discussions

6:00-9:00 p.m.Institutional DinnerRelationship-building and substantive discussions

### Key Topics and Panels

1. Stablecoin Issuance

How are stablecoins growing in Asia - and which models can achieve institutional adoption?

- Regulated and private-sector issuance
- Local-currency stablecoins and USD rails
- Reserves, redemption, custody, and distribution
2. Tokenization

Which Asian assets will attract global institutional investors?

- Funds, treasuries, credit, real estate, and commodities
- Product structures for international distribution
- Ownership, custody, liquidity, and investor protection
3. Secondary Markets

Where will tokenized assets trade and institutional liquidity develop?

- Regulated exchanges and alternative trading venues
- Onchain and hybrid market models
- Market makers, custody, and cross-border settlement
4. Distribution

How will issuers, exchanges, banks, and asset managers reach investors?

- Exchange and institutional partnerships
- Bank, broker, and digital-platform distribution
- Cross-border access to Asian markets
5. Ratings

What information will institutions require before allocating capital?

- Reserve, liquidity, and credit risk
- Legal, counterparty, and technology risk
- Ratings, disclosures, and reporting standards

### Who Will Attend

Senior decision-makers involved across the digital-asset lifecycle:

- Issuers: Stablecoin and tokenized-asset issuers
- Capital: Asset managers, institutional investors, family offices, and venture investors
- Financial Institutions: Banks, securities firms, and payment companies
- Markets: Exchanges, brokers, and secondary-market operators
- Infrastructure: Custodians, settlement providers, and technology companies
- Risk and Policy: Rating agencies, auditors, data providers, regulators, legal professionals, and researchers

### Institutional Objectives

The programme is designed to:

- Connect Asian issuers with global institutional investors
- Introduce asset managers to distribution and infrastructure partners
- Support partnerships among exchanges, banks, and digital platforms
- Identify credible sources of secondary-market liquidity
- Advance institutional ratings and risk-assessment frameworks
- Connect global companies entering Asia with Asian companies seeking international capital

### About The Capital Summit

The Capital Summit is a curated forum connecting institutional capital with the organizations building onchain financial infrastructure. It brings together investors, asset managers, banks, family offices, issuers, and infrastructure providers across Asia and beyond.
