## Cardano node diversity celebration day

- Record: `token2049-side-6a9922a1d567345aad6834a6`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-06T01:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/x9dm535u>

### About the event

One network. Many builders. A stronger future.

Cardano node diversity is no longer just an ambition. It is becoming real.

On the 6th October in Singapore, Cardano Diversity Celebration Day will bring together representatives from Cardano's different node implementations to share their progress, compare timelines and discuss how independent implementations can strengthen the network. The event will also introduce the Diversity Ambassador Program and invite feedback on the next phase of this collective effort.

Why does this matter? Because a truly resilient blockchain should never depend on one team, one codebase or one way of solving a problem. Independent node implementations give Cardano more protection, more opportunities for innovation and more freedom to evolve.

Node diversity reduces common-mode risk: when implementations are developed independently, they can reveal different edge cases, validate protocol behaviour from different perspectives. It also creates room for improvements in resource efficiency, observability, tooling and operator experience.

This is not about replacing one implementation with another. It is about building complementary infrastructure - giving Cardano more resilience, more engineering options and greater confidence as the protocol evolves.

Cardano Diversity Celebration Day is where the people building that future come together and where the wider community gets to see what comes next

The event will be broadcasted from Singapore but everyone is welcome to join us online.

More information about the even: https://hackmd.io/@Amaru/DiversityCelebrationDraft

### Agenda

- Why diversity matters: decentralization, security and resilience
- Node implementers progress update and timelines (every Cardano node implementer representative will give an overview of their project)
- Amaru incoming initiative: Cardano diversity ambassador program, 2027 Amaru proposal first ideas

### About the event

AI & Formal Verification for Onchain Finance

Defending DeFi, stablecoins and RWAs in the age of AI-powered attacks.

A focused, invite-only gathering for the researchers, founders, and protocol teams shaping the next era of onchain finance, at a moment when attackers have started turning to AI and defense must move from "tested" to "proven."

This session examines a shift already underway. As stablecoins mature into payment rails and RWAs bring real-world value onchain, the value at stake has surged, while AI is making attacks faster, cheaper, and harder to anticipate. Drawing on real exploit investigations and deep security experience across DeFi, stablecoin, and RWA protocols, the conversation centers on what provable security actually looks like when the threat itself becomes intelligent.

Rather than a one-way panel, this is built for genuine exchange among people solving the same problems. Discussions are structured, candid, and grounded in real systems, giving technical and business leaders room to challenge assumptions, compare defensive approaches, and engage directly with leading researchers and peers navigating the same frontier.

### What to Expect

Honest discussion on how AI is reshaping both attack and defence across onchain finance.

Deep dives into recent exploits, failure modes, and the patterns behind them.

A practical look at formal verification, and why provable security is becoming the standard for stablecoins, RWAs, and institutional-grade protocols.

### Who Should Attend

Founders - CTOs - Stablecoin & RWA Teams - Protocol Architects - Security Researchers - Auditors - Institutional & DeFi Builders

Location: Singapore (private venue shared with approved attendees)

Each invitation is personally confirmed.

Seats are extremely limited, and you must confirm.

### Gold Partners

American Fortress

### About American Fortress

AmericanFortress is a privacy and security infrastructure platform for onchain transactions, designed to make digital asset transfers more private, secure, and user-friendly. Its FortressName™ system allows users to send assets using human-readable names while generating stealth addresses to reduce public exposure.

For more information, visit: AmericanFortress (https://americanfortress.io/)

SwapSpace

### About SwapSpace

SwapSpace is a non-custodial crypto exchange aggregator that brings together liquidity from multiple exchange providers, allowing users to compare rates and swap digital assets through a single platform. Operating since 2019, SwapSpace supports thousands of assets and hundreds of thousands of trading pairs.

For more information, visit: SwapSpace (https://swapspace.co/)

Alpaca

### About Alpaca

Alpaca is a global brokerage infrastructure platform providing API-powered access to stocks, ETFs, options, fixed income, and crypto. It enables fintechs, financial institutions, and trading platforms to build and scale investing products through its regulated brokerage infrastructure.

For more information, visit: Alpaca (https://alpaca.markets/)

### Strategic Partners

DCS Group

### About DCS Group

DCS Group traces its roots to 1973, with the launch of Singapore's first Diners Club card programme. It has since evolved into a diverse group of payments companies with capabilities spanning card issuing, merchant acquiring, stablecoin payments, and payment orchestration, that help businesses launch, scale and grow.

For more information, visit: DCS Group (https://www.dcsfintech.com/)

Maelstrom

### About Maelstrom

Maelstrom is an investment fund managed by the family office of Arthur Hayes, co-founder of BitMEX. The firm invests across venture, liquid markets, private equity and public markets, with a focus on infrastructure, products and services advancing decentralized financial systems.

For more information, visit: Maelstrom (https://maelstrom.fund/)

## Institutional Onchain Finance Summit 2026

- Record: `token2049-side-6aa18218967be0befa88d05a`

### About the event

Connecting Financial Institutions, Stablecoins & Digital Asset Infrastructure

Hosted by Cregis - FOMO Pay - Stable - Width

Partner: Tether- MetaComp - 1exchange - CapBridge - CertiK - ZAN -HackenProof - Stablecoin Insider - Activ8

Title Sponsor: FUTURECLOUD. AWS. Avenia

### About the Summit

Onchain finance is becoming increasingly connected with the global financial system.

Stablecoins are moving into payments and settlement, financial institutions are exploring new forms of digital money and tokenized assets, and digital asset security is evolving beyond technology alone to encompass infrastructure, governance and day-to-day operations.

Taking place in Singapore during TOKEN2049 Week, the Institutional Onchain Finance Summit 2026 brings together senior leaders and decision-makers from financial institutions, payments, fintech, stablecoins, digital assets, compliance, security and investment.

Through keynotes, panel discussions and curated networking, the summit provides a focused setting for industry leaders to exchange perspectives on how institutional onchain finance is taking shape today - and what comes next.

### What We'll Discuss

Panel I

What Stablecoins Mean for Banks, Businesses & the Wider Economy

Stablecoins are beginning to reshape how money is held, moved and settled across the global economy. As adoption expands, their impact is extending beyond digital assets into banking, corporate finance, cross-border commerce and access to major currencies.

This panel will explore where stablecoins can improve existing financial services, how banks, payment companies and businesses may participate in the emerging ecosystem, and what wider adoption could mean for liquidity, competition and the movement of money across markets.

Panel II

The New Security Playbook: How Attacks & Defenses Are Evolving Across Digital Assets

Digital asset attacks are increasingly moving beyond code vulnerabilities into infrastructure, identities and operational processes. At the same time, automation, interconnected systems and AI are changing both how attacks are scaled and how threats are detected.

This panel will explore how the security playbook is evolving across smart contracts, signing systems, third-party infrastructure and human workflows - and what organizations need to rethink across prevention, monitoring and incident response.

## Agentic Money 2026

- Record: `w3v-agentic-money-2026`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-06T05:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/97p1rzs3>

### When Intelligence Moves Value - Global Payments & Onchain Finance

A new financial landscape is taking shape in 2026 - one in which agents are becoming economic actors, capable of participating in payments, trading, and treasury operations.

Four layers are beginning to converge:

Agents decide. Payment networks move value. Onchain finance provides assets and liquidity. LLM tokens measure and price model usage.

That is why Money in Motion (https://x.com/moneyinmotion26) and LongTree Labs (https://x.com/LongTreeLabs) are co-hosting the inaugural Agentic Money Summit during TOKEN2049 Singapore Week, with PhotonPay (https://x.com/PhotonPay), DogPay (https://x.com/DogPay_), United Stables (https://x.com/UTechStables), AWS, Eddid (https://www.eddid.com.hk/en), Interlace (https://x.com/InterlaceMoney), FluxA (https://x.com/FluxA_Official) and StableTree (https://x.com/stabletree_ai)as our first announced partners.

> Official Website：https://moneyinmotion.xyz/token2049/agenticmoney2026/

> Partnership and sponsorship inquiries: https://t.me/Mix_Web3

Together, we will explore the question at the center of this emerging system:

When agents can move money, access liquidity, and transact across global markets, how must the financial system evolve?

### Panel 1｜Agentic Payments

How can agents gain verifiable, controllable capabilities for payments and treasury operations?

### Panel 2｜Global Trade Corridors

How can stablecoins and local payment networks reshape collections, acquiring, settlement, and clearing in emerging markets?

### Panel 3｜RWA at Scale

From Asset Issuance to Distribution & Liquidity

### Panel 4｜IWhen Wall Street Goes Onchain

Tokenized Equities, Clearing & AI Composability

### The Questions That Connect the Panels

The most important opportunities - and the hardest design choices - appear where these four conversations intersect:

- When an agent manages assets, initiates payments, and executes transactions on behalf of an individual or a business, how should the financial system identify it, and where should the boundaries of permission and responsibility be drawn?
- When card networks, account-to-account payments, and stablecoin networks are all available, how will an agent choose its payment and settlement route?
- Can stablecoin liquidity accumulated through cross-border payments become a source of capital for trading, financing, and collateralization across U.S. equities and RWAs?
- As U.S. equities and other RWAs move onchain, which trading, financing, and collateral operations can agents automate, and where should their permission boundaries be drawn?
- When agents purchase models, data, and compute, LLM tokens measure usage while stablecoins settle payments. Will these two layers remain separate, or will model usage credits emerge that can be traded and settled directly?

### Build the Next Financial System

No single industry can answer these questions alone. Agentic Money 2026 will bring agent and AI product teams, payment institutions, stablecoin infrastructure providers, onchain asset platforms, liquidity providers, model services, banks, compliance organizations, investors, and researchers into the same room.

We want these conversations to lead to concrete outcomes: a new payment rail, an asset that agents can access programmatically, a partner for entering a new market, a clearer rule for managing risk, or a problem worth years of work.

We hope the most important questions, the most experienced practitioners, and the most promising directions can meet here first - and grow into real products, market connections, and long-term partnerships.

AGENTIC MONEY 2026 is an invitation to explore how the next financial system will work - and to help build it together.

We look forward to welcoming you to AGENTIC MONEY 2026 in Singapore.

POD

After a successful inaugural event in Cannes (https://x.com/MidasRWA/status/2038966272126308742?s=20) that introduced The Clearing House experience, we are looking forward to hosting the second edition on October 6th, 2026 in Singapore, during Token2049. The premise stays the same:

Events and summits have become too noisy for the people actually building.

This is why Midas created The Clearing House, a curated event series for the architects of onchain financial markets. We bring together the primary sources for an invite-only session focused on the real advancement of tokenisation, lending and asset management. No fluff, no wasted time, just the conversations that move the needle.

### Invitation Only

To ensure a high-signal environment, this is a private event. Attendance is strictly limited and accessible only to approved guests.

### Who Will Be There?

A curated assembly of leaders across onchain investing, tokenization, lending and asset management.

- Lending Markets
- Asset Managers
- Risk Curators
- LPs & Allocators
- DeFi Protocols

### Venue

Join us for skyline views and fully catered premium food and drinks at an exclusive rooftop venue in the heart of Singapore - right besides the Marina Sands Bay. Exact location will be available to approved guests only.

### Format

We value your time as much as you do. This isn't another conference mixer; it's an intentional space designed to turn virtual relationships into real-world partnerships.

- Zero Noise: No crowded rooms or generic pitches. We focus on high-signal networking that advances business deals and moves the needle for onchain finance.
- One Panel: A single, focused panel discussion moderated by Dennis Dinkelmeyer, CEO of Midas, featuring a selection of industry leaders. We keep the stage time short so you can spend the rest of the evening with the people who matter.
- The Right Room: Every guest is hand-picked to ensure you are surrounded by decision-makers, not event tourists.

### The Clearing House: 2026 Roadmap

The Clearing House debuted earlier this year in Cannes (https://x.com/MidasRWA/status/2038966272126308742?s=20). Singapore is our second edition, timed around Token2049. We are building a continuous, high-signal network across the globe, so the industry's key decision-makers always have the right room to connect.

After Singapore, expect us to bring this curated experience to:

### Hosted By Midas

These tokens offer full transparency, instant redemptions, and native composability across DeFi. To date, Midas has powered over $2B in asset issuance and paid out $46M in yield.

### Overview

FLOW STATE is a networking-first evening for the Sui ecosystem, co-hosted by Comma3 Ventures and Sui during Sui Basecamp 2026 and TOKEN2049 Singapore.

Sui has become one of the most important high-performance ecosystems in crypto - its object-centric Move model, parallel execution, and deepening on-chain liquidity are drawing in serious capital and a new generation of builders. FLOW STATE brings that world into one room: Sui's core teams, the funds deploying into the ecosystem, and the founders shaping how liquidity, consumer adoption, and infrastructure move on Sui - the counterparts, co-investors, and collaborators worth your evening.

As a team with Mandarin-speaking roots, we're also using this night to open the room to more of the Mandarin-speaking Web3 world - connecting its founders, funds, and creators directly with Sui's core teams and the global capital in attendance.

FLOW STATE 是一场以交流为主轴、为 Sui 生态而办的夜晚，由 Comma3 Ventures 与 Sui 于 Sui Basecamp 2026 与 TOKEN2049 Singapore 期间共同主办。

Sui 已是加密领域最重要的高性能生态之一 - - 对象导向的 Move 模型、并行执行与持续累积的链上流动性，正吸引真正的资本与新一代建设者。FLOW STATE 把这个世界汇聚到同一个空间：Sui 核心团队、正布局这个生态的基金，以及正在塑造 Sui 上流动性、消费采用与基础设施走向的创办人 - - 都是值得你花这一晚结识的对象。

Join us for The Vantage, presented by Beldex and Acurast, supported by EAK and Sigma Capital, powered by The Best Event.

Singapore's premier web3 conference kicks off, but this is the night where the elite will convene for more meaningful and high-signal discussions.

Expect founders, investors, and the operators who have shaped the industry and are still building the next cycle, gathered for a first night that sets the tone for everything after it.

The Vantage is hosted at Singapore's most premium penthouse suite, in an iconic 5-star hotel overlooking Marina Bay. With floor-to-ceiling views of the bay, this premium space reflects the calibre of company you can expect and a level of exclusivity you shouldn't miss.

### Hosted By

Beldex (https://www.beldex.io/)is a privacy-focused decentralized ecosystem building infrastructure for Web3 and AI. Its ecosystem includes BChat for encrypted messaging, BelNet for decentralized private networking, Beldex Browser for private web access, and BNS for decentralized naming.

Acurast (https://acurast.com/) is a decentralized, serverless cloud platform that leverages Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) to provide verifiable and confidential compute for the multi-chain Web3 ecosystem. As a Polkadot parachain, Acurast enables developers to execute complex workloads, automate data flows, and access verifiable oracles - all without relying on centralized infrastructure.

### Supported By

EAK Digital (https://eakdigital.com/)is an award-winning global Web3 communications and marketing agency specialising in strategic communications, public relations, influencer marketing, brand development and live experiences. Headquartered in Dubai, the agency works with leading blockchain companies, technology innovators and emerging brands to build authority, reach new audiences and accelerate global growth. EAK Digital is also the company behind Istanbul Blockchain Week and BlockDown Festival.

Sigma Capital (https://sigmavc.com/) is a Dubai-based, Web3-native venture capital firm backing ambitious founders building the next generation of blockchain-powered businesses. Led by CEO and Managing Partner Vineet Budki, the firm invests across decentralised finance, blockchain infrastructure, real-world asset tokenisation, gaming and artificial intelligence. Beyond capital, Sigma Capital provides portfolio companies with strategic guidance, market access and connections across its global network, helping transformative ideas develop into scalable, commercially successful ventures.

### Powered By

The Best Event (https://www.instagram.com/_thebestevent?utm_source=luma) is the global event series where Web3 comes to life. With over 120+ events organised across 24+ cities, and 60,000 guests, The Best Event is a leader in the space. From bespoke and intimate meetups, to large-scale parties at the likes of Marquee and E11even Miami, we bring together the boldest creators, top brands, and visionaries shaping the future for unforgettable experiences.

For sponsor inquiries for the penthouse editions, please contact Mihir via Telegram (https://t.me/mihirodhrani) or email mihir@tbv.xyz.

- 10:45 AM - Breakfast Served & Unfiltered Industry Discussion

## OKX Dev Day 2026

- Record: `w3v-okx-dev-day-2026`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-07T02:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/l4aq8vii>

### Build a Market. Build a Company

Build with X Layer and OKX AI. Create an application for tokenized stocks or real-world assets, an onchain marketplace, an agent service or an AI-native business.

OKX Dev Day is a developer hackathon that starts online and culminates in a live finale in Singapore. Build a working project with your team and connect with OKX leadership, leading RWA, AI and crypto partners, and venture capital firms.

---

Up to US$100K across winning teams

Applications closed. For selected teams, please refer to the builder kit here (https://www.okx.com/learn/okx-dev-day-builder-kit).

---

Select Register to complete one application per team.

‼ Builder applications only. Requesting to join is not a public event registration or a ticket to the live finale. The finale is limited to selected teams and invited guests. Applying does not guarantee selection.

### What you can build

Choose one primary track when you apply:

---

1. X Layer: Tokenized stocks and RWA

https://web3.okx.com/xlayer

Build applications and infrastructure that use tokenized stocks or real-world assets as onchain building blocks on X Layer. Examples include data and portfolio tools, asset-based payment or commerce experiences, investor or issuer tooling and new ways for users and assets to interact onchain.

2. OKX AI: Agents and AI-native businesses

https://www.okx.ai/

Build agent services and AI-native products for discovery, coordination, collaboration and monetisation. Examples include agent-service marketplaces, data or API services and tools that help agents work or transact with users and other agents.

---

Your project may use both X Layer and OKX AI, but it will be reviewed under one primary track. If both apply, choose the track that best represents the core of your project.

Bring a clear problem and a build your team can deliver. We are looking for working products, not pitch decks.

Final problem statements, technical requirements and judging criteria will be shared with selected teams.

### Key dates

all times are in UTC +00:00 unless stated otherwise

▫Applications close: 15 September 2026 23:59 (extended)

▫Online build period: 17 to 25 September 2026

▫Project submission: 25 September 2026

▫Finalist selection: 28 to 30 September 2026

▫Live finale in Singapore: 7 October 2026

### What selected teams get

- A share of the US$100K prize pool
- Technical resources, onboarding and build support for X Layer and OKX AI
- Opportunities to connect with OKX product leaders, partners and investors
- The chance to become a finalist and demo live in Singapore
- Hackathon prizes and awards, with the prize pool and details to be announced
- OKX Dev Day merchandise, subject to availability

### Prize pool

Up to US$100K is available across winning teams.

Two ways to compete

1. In person, Singapore finale. Teams that demo live on 7 October compete for the headline awards in each track. The largest share of the pool sits here.
2. Remote. Teams that build and submit but cannot travel are still judged and can still win.

Awards are subject to eligibility and the full Terms and Conditions.

### Meet our partners

Joining OKX Dev Day as speakers, judges, mentors and technical experts.

Program partners:

▫Amazon Web Services (https://x.com/awscloud)

▫Morningstar (https://x.com/MorningstarInc?lang=en)

▫Paxos (http://x.com/paxoslabs)

▫MoonPay (https://x.com/moonpay)

▫Centrifuge (https://x.com/centrifuge)

▫xStocks (https://x.com/xStocksFi)

▫Plug and Play (https://www.plugandplayapac.com/)

▫Maximum Frequency Ventures (https://www.mf.xyz/)

▫Liminal (https://liminal.build/)

Community partner:

▫Claude Code Singapore (https://claudecode.sg/)

▫Easy (https://x.com/easya_app)A (https://x.com/MorningstarInc?lang=en)

▫Surgence Labs (https://x.com/surgence_io)

### What teams need to submit

1. Team members and contact information
2. High-level summary of what the team plans to build

After being selected, teams will be expected to provide the following during the Dev Day event on 7 October:

- Working prototype
- GitHub repository
- Prepare to present in front of a panel of judges for 3-5 minutes.

### How selection works

1. Submit one team application through this page by 15 September 2026 at 23:59 UTC+0 (extended, originally 11 September)
2. OKX reviews the team's idea, technical plan and ability to deliver.
3. Selected teams receive the online hackathon details by email.
4. Teams build online and submit a working project by 25 September.
5. Submitted projects are reviewed before finalists are invited to the Singapore event.

We may not be able to provide individual feedback on every application.

Ready to apply? Select Register and complete the builder application.

Travel

OKX does not pay for travel, accommodation, visas or personal expenses. Finalist teams are responsible for getting to Singapore and covering those costs.

Do not book non-refundable travel until OKX confirms your finalist place and attendance details in writing.

### FAQs

Does Request to Join give me a ticket to the finale?

No. Request to Join opens the builder application. Your request will remain pending while applications and projects are reviewed. Only confirmed finalists will be approved in Luma for the Singapore finale.

Is the full hackathon in Singapore?

No. Teams build online from 17 to 25 September. Only the live finale takes place in Singapore.

Does OKX cover travel?

No. Teams cover their own travel, accommodation, visas and personal expenses.

What do I submit?

Selected teams will receive the final checklist before the online build period. It will cover the project description, working demo, OKX integration and technical links.

Are there prizes?

Categories, amounts and terms will be announced soon.

Can I apply on my own?

Yes. You can apply on your own or as part of a team of up to four people. Solo applicants are responsible for delivering the project and attending the Singapore finale if selected.

## Sera.cx predicts 100,000 Stablecoins by 2030: Risk, Regulations and the future of Finance

- Record: `w3v-seracx-stablecoins-liquidity-meet-flow`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-07T06:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/lbmwf1rg>

### About the event

Recommended for PSPs: Payment Gateways, Remittance Houses, CFOs

Read up on The Legal Money Printer: https://x.com/DouglasGan/status/2082033134980452798

Sera is building the FX settlement layer for stablecoins: same-currency clearing at par, cross-currency at the best synthesized rate, settled atomically on-chain, direct pairing with no USD in the middle. Real corridors, real flow.

This is a small, closed-door gathering to bring that flow together with the people who can deepen it.

Over an afternoon we'll sit down with a select group of stablecoin issuers, liquidity providers, market makers, funds, and ecosystem partners to walk through where Sera's live order flow is today, which corridors are pulling hardest (SGD, MYR, BRL, JPY, USD, etc.), and how early liquidity partners can plug into that demand before it's crowded.

What we'll cover

- Where Sera's settlement volume and demand sit right now - the actual data, not a pitch deck
- The corridors with the deepest pull and the thinnest supply
- How liquidity provisioning on Sera works, and what early participation looks like
- Open discussion on stablecoin FX, agentic payments, and treasury use cases

### Who it's for

Stablecoin issuers, liquidity providers and market makers, crypto-native and crossover funds, and infrastructure partners active in emerging-market FX corridors. Intentionally kept small so the conversation stays candid.

### Format

Short framing from the Sera team, then open discussion. Location and full agenda shared on RSVP approval.

Seats are limited and by approval. Request an invite below.

## Token Sale Summit 2026 @ Token2049 Singapore

- Record: `token2049-side-6a9e7f72d567345aad684576`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-07T07:00:00.000Z

### About the event

Join us for an exclusive Token Sale Summit during Token2049 Singapore, designed for founders, C-suites and project leaders preparing a token sale (TGE) or rethinking their launch plan for today's market.

Token sales in 2026 work differently from previous cycles. A successful raise now runs as one connected launch, in which the private and public rounds, TGE, exchange listings and post-listing market making each serve a distinct purpose and are planned together to support the token's success after launch day.

In this invite-only session, our TokenMinds expert team will share practical strategies for this new environment.

Date: Wednesday, October 7, 2026 (during Token2049 Sigapore)

Time: 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM (SGT)

Location: Singapore

Admission: Free (RSVP required)*

*Attendance will be carefully curated, please register to be considered.

### Key Takeaways

- Token Sale setup for 2026, including round structure (private to public route), tokenomics, whitepaper, legal framework and more
- Choosing, and getting selected for, the right launchpads and platforms under today's stricter vetting and compliance
- Token Sale marketing strategies for a more selective market
- Post-TGE liquidity, listings & market engagement

### Why now

Token sale has become more selective now. Exchanges, launchpads and regulators ask sharper questions about sale terms, token rights and unlock schedules, and retail buyers do the same. This session helps you finalize a launch plan that holds up under that scrutiny before the year-end window closes.

### Hosted by TokenMinds

TokenMinds is an award-winning blockchain and AI firm that has run token sales since 2017, supporting 150+ projects through the ICO boom, the IEO/IDO phase, DeFi Summer, the NFT wave and today's launchpad era. TokenMinds provides end-to-end support, from concept and implementation to advisory and maintenance. TokenMinds ensures comprehensive solutions by combining strategic engineering, creative approach, and market analysis. It has been recognized as a leading Web3 and AI company by renowned organizations such as Hackernoon, Metapress, Coinranking, and more.

Important Notes: This is an exclusive summit with a curated guest list. Registration does not guarantee admission; approvals will be sent to selected attendees.

Across our core programmatic themes of business, finance, philanthropy, and health, and a new track on AI innovation, investment, and sovereignty, the event convenes leaders from across industries and sectors for thoughtful dialogue, informed decision-making, and impactful outcomes for more people around the world.At a time of rapid global change, the Asia Summit aims to promote practical solutions, strengthen regional and international cooperation, and create new opportunities for inclusive and sustainable growth. ### 超越热度：RWA 真正落地，还缺什么？

在 TOKEN2049 的第一天夜晚，BiFu 设宴做东，我们邀请 BiFu VIP 及行业嘉宾参与「超越热度：RWA 真正落地，还缺什么？」VIP 私享晚宴。

2026年 TOKEN2049 首日活动结束后，BiFu 来请你吃饭。我们邀请 BiFu VIP 及行业嘉宾参与「超越热度：RWA 真正落地，还缺什么？」VIP 私享晚宴。

放下白天的展会的匆忙和喧嚣，我们希望用一顿丰盛的高级自助晚餐与美酒款待。作为新一代全域资产交易网络，BiFu 期待在这场定向邀请的闭门晚宴中，与 RWA 核心建设者、资本及基础设施代表相聚，共同探讨资产产品化与真实流动的实现路径。

本次活动采用邀请制入场，为嘉宾提供高密度、私密的行业连接，您若认为自己属于被邀请的，请填写报名信息，我们审核后会联系您。

> 如有商务或合作需求，请联系 connect@bifu.co (https://mailto:connect@bifu.co)，或telegram @takshire

### 时间流程｜Agenda

- 17:00-17:30　嘉宾签到、欢迎酒与自由交流
- 17:30-18:10　主持开场、自助晚餐与相互认识
- 18:15-18:45　BiFu CEO、产品负责人及特邀嘉宾分享／主题对谈
- 18:45-19:12　继续用餐、自由交流与第一轮抽奖
- 19:12-19:50　现场表演与集体合影
- 19:50-20:00　自由交流与第二场转场

### 现场嘉宾｜Who Is in the Room

RWA 项目与资产方、交易平台与多资产平台、基金／做市商／VC、财富管理机构与家族办公室、稳定币／支付／托管／安全服务商、金融基础设施团队、新加坡 FinTech 与 Web3 生态代表，以及精选媒体、研究者与专业社群。

### 主办方｜Host：BiFu

成立于 2023 年，BiFu 是融通 Web2 与 Web3 全域资产交易的先锋级平台。

BiFu 是连接数字资产与更广泛全球市场的统一资产网络。我们打破传统金融边界，让用户只需一个账户，即可自由交易 Crypto、外汇、大宗商品、美港股及 RWA。凭借统一账户体系、极速稳定性能、完备合规与社区赋能，BiFu 致力于让全球优质财富走向平权，确保无论机会出现在哪个市场，用户都已「在场」。

### 关于 BiNet｜全域资产交易网络

BiNet 是 BiFu 打造的全域资产交易网络，也是「One Account, Trade the World」这句承诺的底层支撑。

它将加密资产、外汇、大宗商品、股票、RWA 与预测市场六大类市场整合进统一账户体系。用户只需完成一次身份认证，即可用同一个账户、同一笔资金进入全部市场。

在这套体系之下，BiNet 以统一身份、统一资金、统一风控、统一合规四项基础能力为骨架，辅以聚合 200 余家全球交易所的流动性网络、亚毫秒级交易引擎与智能路由，让跨市场交易像在单一市场中一样连贯、顺畅。

资产之间的墙正在被拆除，BiNet 要做的，就是把全球市场装进一个账户。

### 关于 BiFu 财富板块｜BiFu Wealth

RWA 的价值不只在于资产上链，更在于让普通投资者真正有机会参与其中。

BiFu 财富板块面向既有稳健收益诉求、又希望保留资金灵活性的用户，提供一站式资产配置入口。依托 BiNet 的统一账户与跨市场基础设施，RWA 将与加密资产、外汇、大宗商品共同构成多元资产配置体系。

通过将真实世界资产引入链上配置框架，财富板块让过去仅向机构开放的收益来源，逐步成为普通投资者可触达、可理解、可配置的选项。

让 RWA 从行业热词变成普通投资者账户里的真实持仓，这是 BiFu 财富板块对「金融平权」的回答，也是我们对「RWA 真正落地」这个命题给出的实践。

### RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?

On the first evening of TOKEN2049, dinner is on BiFu. We cordially invite BiFu VIPs and industry guests to be our guests at the VIP Private Dinner, "RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?"

Step away from the conference buzz and let us treat you to a premium buffet and free-flowing drinks. As a next-generation unified asset trading network, BiFu is bringing together core RWA builders, capital providers, and infrastructure leaders for an intimate, closed-door discussion on the path from asset productization to real market liquidity.

This exclusive gathering is invite-only, offering a private setting for focused, high-value industry connections.

### Agenda

- 17:00-17:30　Guest check-in, welcome drinks, and networking
- 17:30-18:10　Opening remarks, buffet dinner, and introductions
- 18:15-18:45　Insights and featured discussion with the BiFu CEO, product lead, and invited guests
- 18:45-19:12　Dinner, networking, and the first lucky draw
- 19:12-19:50　Live performance and group photo
- 19:50-20:00　Networking and transition to the second session

### Who Is in the Room

RWA projects and asset originators; exchanges and multi-asset platforms; funds, market makers, and VCs; wealth managers and family offices; stablecoin, payment, custody, and security providers; financial infrastructure teams; representatives from Singapore's FinTech and Web3 ecosystems; and selected media, researchers, and professional communities.

### Host: BiFu

Founded in 2023, BiFu is a pioneering platform connecting Web2 and Web3 markets through unified, multi-asset trading.

BiFu is a unified asset network connecting digital assets with the broader global financial markets. By breaking down traditional market boundaries, BiFu enables users to access Crypto, foreign exchange, commodities, US and Hong Kong equities, and RWA through a single account.

Supported by a unified account system, fast and stable performance, a comprehensive compliance framework, and community participation, BiFu is working to make global wealth opportunities more accessible - so that wherever an opportunity appears, users are already there.

### About BiNet｜The Unified Asset Trading Network

BiNet is the unified asset trading network developed by BiFu and the infrastructure behind the promise: "One Account, Trade the World."

It brings six market categories - Crypto, foreign exchange, commodities, equities, RWA, and prediction markets - into one unified account system. With a single identity verification process, users can access these markets through the same account and the same pool of funds.

BiNet is built on four core capabilities: unified identity, unified funds, unified risk management, and unified compliance. Together with a liquidity network aggregating more than 200 global exchanges, a sub-millisecond trading engine, and intelligent routing, this infrastructure is designed to make cross-market trading as continuous and straightforward as trading within a single market.

The walls between asset classes are coming down. BiNet's goal is to bring global markets into one account.

### About BiFu Wealth

The value of RWA lies not only in bringing assets on-chain, but in giving everyday investors a real opportunity to participate.

BiFu Wealth is designed for users seeking steady return opportunities while retaining the flexibility to respond to changing markets. It provides a single entry point for diversified asset allocation. Supported by BiNet's unified account and cross-market infrastructure, RWA sits alongside Crypto, foreign exchange, and commodities within a broader multi-asset portfolio framework.

By bringing real-world assets into an on-chain allocation framework, BiFu Wealth is making sources of return that were once available mainly to institutions increasingly accessible, understandable, and investable for everyday users.

Turning RWA from an industry buzzword into a real holding in an everyday investor's account is BiFu Wealth's answer to financial inclusion - and our practical response to what it means to bring RWA into real-world adoption.

### About the event

For much of DeFi's history, "yield" was fueled by token incentives, emissions, and liquidity mining. High APYs attracted capital, but too often the yield disappeared when the incentives stopped.

That is changing.

Credit, equities, Treasuries, ETFs, and institutional income strategies are moving onchain, bringing yield generated by real economic activity into DeFi. Interest paid by borrowers. Dividends from companies. Income from public markets. Cash flows that exist beyond token incentives.

As TradFi and DeFi converge, onchain yield is evolving from something created for crypto into a new distribution layer for the world's income-producing assets.

As the saying goes: "If you don't know where the yield is coming from, you are the yield."

Join HoneyB for drinks and a conversation about the next generation of real yield and onchain capital markets.

## The Crossing: Engineering Trust in Institutional Digital Finance

### About the event

An invitation-only VIP reception on the evening of TOKEN2049 Day 1, co-hosted by Safeheron, The Responsible Fintech Institute, DK Bank, Cloudflare and VerifyVASP.

Traditional finance is crossing to digital assets. Not as an experiment anymore, but as a route that has to work every time - for real money, under real rules.

No one company supplies that crossing. Between them, these five cover it end to end:

- Safeheron - the vessel. Open-source MPC and TEE self-custody, so the keys stay yours the whole way across.
- The Responsible Fintech Institute - the charts. Independent standards and published research that make the route defensible.
- DK Bank - the harbour. The official bank of Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City, built for digital assets from day one.
- Cloudflare - the lanes. The network it all runs over, reaching 95% of the world's internet users in roughly 50 milliseconds.
- VerifyVASP - the manifest. Travel Rule at institutional scale: who is on the other end, verified before the value moves.

Five claims, and every one of them checkable.

Then drinks, canapés, and three hours with everyone else who is somewhere mid-crossing.

Places are limited. Request your invitation early.

### About Hosts

Safeheron

Safeheron is the world's leading digital asset self-custody provider. Built on fully in-house developed, open-source Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) and Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) technologies, Safeheron delivers institutional-grade self-custody infrastructure and industry-specific solutions at the highest security standards. Its clients span payment firms, liquidity providers (OTC), digital banks, RWA platforms, trust and asset managers, and commodity trade finance - enabling 100% client control over private keys and assets, and powering full lifecycle digital asset management, operations, and business growth.

The Responsible Fintech Institute

The Responsible Fintech Institute (RFI) is a global nonprofit organisation based in Singapore. Its goal is to create a safe, trustworthy and reliable future for digital finance by building the digital utilities that support responsible innovation. RFI brings together public and private sector stakeholders to help build the rules and technology needed for new digital financial tools, and to make the digital asset sector sustainable and inclusive.

DK Bank

DK Bank is the official bank of Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City. DK Bank provides comprehensive financial services, including handling digital assets, and supports GMC's ambitious development plan.

Cloudflare

Cloudflare's network connects directly with virtually every service provider and cloud provider, reaching 95% of the world's internet users within approximately 50 milliseconds. One of the world's largest networks - powering all services across data centers and delivering unmatched performance, security, and reliability. Every service runs in every data center. Your users get a fast, consistent experience - everywhere.

VerifyVASP

VerifyVASP Pte. Ltd. is a leading Travel Rule solution provider delivering secure, scalable compliance infrastructure for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) worldwide. VerifyVASP offers an end-to-end compliance suite encompassing counterparty due diligence, interoperable messaging protocols, on-chain risk analytics, and advisory on Travel Rule and data protection requirements. Extending beyond compliance, VerifyVASP provides advanced solutions for global law enforcement agencies, enabling the prevention, detection, and investigation of illicit activities involving digital assets.

## RWA Beyond the Hype: Industry Talks & Networking

- Record: `w3v-rwa-beyond-the-hype`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-07T12:00:00.000Z

### 行业分享与交流酒会

RWA 已经不缺关注。接下来更值得讨论的是：真实资产如何成为用户看得懂、信得过、愿意使用的产品，并真正走向规模化？

10 月 7 日晚，在Token2049首日的夜晚，BiFu 诚邀您参加「超越热度：RWA 真正落地，还缺什么？」行业分享与交流酒会。VIP 私享晚宴结束后，现场将转入更开放、更具流动性的第二场活动，欢迎更多 RWA 建设者、合作伙伴及行业同仁加入。

酒会将安排精选BiFu代表以及合作伙伴带来简短、直接的行业分享，并穿插现场表演、足量的酒水来支撑自由交流。我们希望大家可以暂时放下白天密集的会议和行程，聊聊正在推进的项目、眼下遇到的金融问题、RWA的展望，以及接下来可能一起做的事情。

酒会席位有限，报名需经审核；最终入场以审核确认及现场接待容量为准。

> 如有商务合作需求，请联系：connect@bifu.co (https://mailto:connect@bifu.co)，或telegram @takshire

### 时间流程

20:00-20:20嘉宾入场、欢迎酒与自由交流2

20:20-20:55开场及精选合作伙伴／项目分享

20:55-21:50现场表演与自由交流、社交

21:50-22:00第二轮抽奖、致谢与活动结束

### 现场嘉宾

RWA 与 Web3 项目的创始人及联合创始人、生态与增长负责人、交易平台及金融基础设施团队、BiFu 合作伙伴、KOL 与内容创作者、专业社群主理人，以及媒体、研究者、投资机构和新加坡 FinTech／Web3 生态参与者。

### 主办方｜Host：BiFu

成立于 2023 年，BiFu 是融通 Web2 与 Web3 全域资产交易的先锋级平台。

BiFu 是连接数字资产与更广泛全球市场的统一资产网络。我们打破传统金融边界，让用户只需一个账户，即可自由交易 Crypto、外汇、大宗商品、美港股及 RWA。凭借统一账户体系、极速稳定性能、完备合规与社区赋能，BiFu 致力于让全球优质财富走向平权，确保无论机会出现在哪个市场，用户都已「在场」。

### 关于 BiNet｜全域资产交易网络

BiNet 是 BiFu 打造的全域资产交易网络，也是「One Account, Trade the World」这句承诺的底层支撑。

它将加密资产、外汇、大宗商品、股票、RWA 与预测市场六大类市场整合进统一账户体系。用户只需完成一次身份认证，即可用同一个账户、同一笔资金进入全部市场。

在这套体系之下，BiNet 以统一身份、统一资金、统一风控、统一合规四项基础能力为骨架，辅以聚合 200 余家全球交易所的流动性网络、亚毫秒级交易引擎与智能路由，让跨市场交易像在单一市场中一样连贯、顺畅。

资产之间的墙正在被拆除，BiNet 要做的，就是把全球市场装进一个账户。

### RWA 的价值不只在于资产上链，更在于让普通投资者真正有机会参与其中。

BiFu 财富板块面向既有稳健收益诉求、又希望保留资金灵活性的用户，提供一站式资产配置入口。依托 BiNet 的统一账户与跨市场基础设施，RWA 将与加密资产、外汇、大宗商品共同构成多元资产配置体系。

通过将真实世界资产引入链上配置框架，财富板块让过去仅向机构开放的收益来源，逐步成为普通投资者可触达、可理解、可配置的选项。

让 RWA 从行业热词变成普通投资者账户里的真实持仓，这是 BiFu 财富板块对「金融平权」的回答，也是我们对「RWA 真正落地」这个命题给出的实践。

### RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?

RWA no longer lacks attention. The more important question now is how real-world assets can become products that users understand, trust, and choose to use - and how those products can reach meaningful scale.

On the evening of October 7, BiFu invites you to join "RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?", an evening of industry talks and networking. Following the VIP Private Dinner, the venue will transition into a more open and dynamic second event, welcoming a broader group of RWA builders, partners, and industry peers.

The reception will feature concise talks from selected partners, alongside live performances, drinks, and open networking. After a full day at TOKEN2049, this is a chance to talk about the projects currently being built, the problems teams are working through, and where future collaboration may begin.

Capacity is limited and registrations are subject to approval. Final admission will be based on registration confirmation and venue capacity.

> For business enquiries, please contact: connect@bifu.co

### Agenda

20:00-20:20 Guest arrival, welcome drinks, and networking

20:20-20:55 Opening remarks and selected partner/project spotlights

20:55-21:50 Live performance and open networking

21:50-22:00 Second lucky draw, closing remarks

### Who Is in the Room

Founders and co-founders of RWA and Web3 projects, ecosystem and growth leads, trading platforms and financial infrastructure teams, BiFu partners, KOLs and content creators, professional community leaders, as well as media, researchers, investors, and members of Singapore's FinTech and Web3 ecosystem.

### Host: BiFu

Founded in 2023, BiFu is a pioneering platform connecting Web2 and Web3 markets through unified, multi-asset trading.

BiFu is a unified asset network connecting digital assets with the broader global financial markets. By breaking down traditional market boundaries, BiFu enables users to access Crypto, foreign exchange, commodities, US and Hong Kong equities, and RWA through a single account.

Supported by a unified account system, fast and stable performance, a comprehensive compliance framework, and community participation, BiFu is working to make global wealth opportunities more accessible - so that wherever an opportunity appears, users are already there.

### About BiNet｜The Unified Asset Trading Network

BiNet is the unified asset trading network developed by BiFu and the infrastructure behind the promise: "One Account, Trade the World."

It brings six market categories - Crypto, foreign exchange, commodities, equities, RWA, and prediction markets - into one unified account system. With a single identity verification process, users can access these markets through the same account and the same pool of funds.

BiNet is built on four core capabilities: unified identity, unified funds, unified risk management, and unified compliance. Together with a liquidity network aggregating more than 200 global exchanges, a sub-millisecond trading engine, and intelligent routing, this infrastructure is designed to make cross-market trading as continuous and straightforward as trading within a single market.

The walls between asset classes are coming down. BiNet's goal is to bring global markets into one account.

### About BiFu Wealth

The value of RWA lies not only in bringing assets on-chain, but in giving everyday investors a real opportunity to participate.

BiFu Wealth is designed for users seeking steady return opportunities while retaining the flexibility to respond to changing markets. It provides a single entry point for diversified asset allocation. Supported by BiNet's unified account and cross-market infrastructure, RWA sits alongside Crypto, foreign exchange, and commodities within a broader multi-asset portfolio framework.

By bringing real-world assets into an on-chain allocation framework, BiFu Wealth is making sources of return that were once available mainly to institutions increasingly accessible, understandable, and investable for everyday users.

Turning RWA from an industry buzzword into a real holding in an everyday investor's account is BiFu Wealth's answer to financial inclusion - and our practical response to what it means to bring RWA into real-world adoption.

### About the event

NEXUS is TOKEN2049's startup competition for early-stage crypto companies. The organizer's 2026 competition runs on 7-8 October in Singapore, with founders pitching for equity-free prizes before an expert jury and the TOKEN2049 community.

### Competition

The organizer lists a $250,000 prize pool, more than 1,000 applicants and ten finalists. The competition takes place at Marina Bay Sands during TOKEN2049 Singapore on 7-8 October. Startups must have been incorporated from 2023 onwards and raised less than $5 million in investments. Applying is free, and selection is merit-based. The jury includes Tom Schmidt (Dragonfly), Akshat Vaidya (Maelstrom) and Spencer Applebaum (Multicoin Capital).

### What finalists receive

Top ten finalists receive a complimentary startup stand, full TOKEN2049 access on 7-8 October, speaker perks including the speaker reception, networking drinks and lounge access, three complimentary team tickets, photography and session recordings, and event marketing coverage. The jury may make investment offers outside the prize grant.

### First round

The first round takes place on 7 October 2026 as part of the TOKEN2049 Singapore program at Marina Bay Sands.

### Applications

NEXUS 2026 applications closed after the 18 September deadline, with the top 50 announcement on 21 September. The organizer is accepting waitlist registrations for NEXUS 2027.

### Payments, Treasury and Tokenization Summit 2026

The Payments, Treasury & Tokenization Summit is an invitation-only executive gathering bringing together senior leaders shaping how institutions move money, manage liquidity and invest in financial infrastructure.

Convened by 8 Circle, XDC, PwC and in collaboration with Microsoft, during Singapore TOKEN2049 Week. Metable labs will be the Technology partner. The summit will explore the convergence of agentic payments, programmable money, intelligent treasury, tokenized financial infrastructure and institutional liquidity.

This is not a broad industry conference. It is a deliberately curated room of decision-makers - including banking and payments executives, CFOs and treasurers, enterprise technology leaders, and senior risk, compliance and security professionals. Every participant is selected for their decision-making authority, infrastructure or budget ownership, active strategic priorities and ability to contribute to substantive executive dialogue.

Key themes include:

- Agentic payments and machine-initiated transactions
- AI-enabled treasury, liquidity forecasting and FX management
- Programmable money and conditional settlement
- Tokenized deposits, funds and real-world assets
- Institutional access to on-chain liquidity
- Identity, delegated authority, governance and security
- Interoperability across banking and blockchain rails

### AGENDA

8:30-9:00 AM

Executive Breakfast & Curated Introductions

Hosted introductions connecting participants and partners around shared priorities before the programme begins.

9:00-9:30 AM

Keynote Speeches & Host Introductions

Opening remarks and host introductions setting the context for the programme ahead.

9:30-10:20 AM

Roundtable 1: Agentic Payments & Programmable Money

A discussion on how AI agents, programmable payments and emerging settlement models will change the movement of money - while maintaining institutional control, accountability, compliance and security.

10:20-10:30 AM

Break

10:30-11:20 AM

Roundtable 2: Intelligent Treasury, Tokenization & Liquidity Convergence

A discussion on how institutions can tokenize assets, transform treasury operations, manage liquidity and connect digital markets with traditional capital and distribution.

11:20 AM-12:00 PM

Executive Conclusions & Partner Follow-Up

Priority actions for intelligent, programmable and future-secure financial infrastructure, followed by dedicated time for continued conversations.

### EVENT DETAILS

Thursday, 8 October 2026

8:30 AM-12:00 PM

Singapore - TOKEN2049 Week

By invitation only

One morning. One room. The right decision-makers.

## The Treasury Table: A Gathering on Stablecoins, Payments, and the Future of Business Banking

- Record: `w3v-the-treasury-table-a-cfo-summit`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-08T07:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/k8jylkcm>

### About the event

The Treasury Table: Stablecoins, Payments, and Business Banking

The way companies hold, move, and account for money is being rebuilt. Stablecoins are becoming settlement infrastructure, cross-border payments are moving from days to minutes, and the business banking stack is being redrawn around them. For the people who run finance, this is no longer a topic to watch. It is a set of decisions to make.

The Treasury Table is a closed-door afternoon summit for CFOs, VPs of Finance, and heads of treasury, held during TOKEN2049 Week in Singapore. One room, a curated group of finance leaders, and a focused program on the questions that sit on their desks right now.

Across two panels and a keynote, the conversation covers:

- Stablecoins as treasury and settlement infrastructure, and what regulatory clarity now allows
- Cross-border payments, payroll, and vendor settlement at global scale
- The future of business banking: accounts, cards, and the modern finance stack
- What tokenized assets and onchain cash management mean for the balance sheet

The format is built for substance, not pitches. Panels are led by operators and finance leaders, followed by an extended networking reception where the real conversations happen.

Thursday, 8 October 2026

3:30 PM to 6:30 PM, GMT+8

Location: To be shared upon approval

Attendance is by approval. Priority is given to finance leaders at operating companies. Seats are limited to keep the room senior and the conversation candid.

If your company builds for this audience and you would like to explore a partnership, DM @ASHWALIAN on Telegram.

- Capital - funds, market makers, family offices, DAO & corporate treasuries
- Yield - RWA issuers (private credit, T-Bills), top DeFi protocols, L1/L2s, lending markets
- Rails - vault infra providers, neobanks, wallets, custodians, bridges, oracles.

### What to Expect

- Strict Curation - No retail, no tourists. Decision-makers only.
- The Convergence - Capital (LPs, treasuries) + Product (DeFi, RWAs) + Distribution (neobanks, wallets, bridges), rails connecting both sides.
- Golden Hour Deal Flow - structured for introductions during the sunset window.
- Zero Noise - just the liquidity layer of the industry in one room.

Why It Matters

As DeFi matures into its next capital cycle, alignment between infrastructure, liquidity, and strategy becomes critical. Proof Of Liquidity exists to create the environment where that alignment can happen - naturally and effectively.

Hosted By:

Yield Network (https://www.yieldnetwork.io) is the capital formation and distribution firm for onchain markets.

We sit between institutional capital and onchain yield: we structure the products and raise the capital that fills them. Clients range from L1/L2 chains and DeFi protocols to digital asset managers and issuers of tokenized yield products.

What we run:

Pre-deposit and launch campaigns - capped, time-limited raises run end to end on our platform, from soft commitment through deposit and reporting

Lending programs - market design, curator coordination, and anchor capital for onchain lending markets

Liquidity strategy - program design, LP validation, infrastructure coordination, and launch execution for teams building a liquidity program from the ground up

Embedded yield - onchain yield integrated into fintechs, wallets, and consumer platforms that want yield products without building the stack themselves

LP dealflow - vetted deals with clear terms, capacity, and timelines for the capital side

### About the event

NEXUS is TOKEN2049's startup competition for early-stage crypto companies. The organizer's 2026 competition runs on 7-8 October in Singapore, with founders pitching for equity-free prizes before an expert jury and the TOKEN2049 community.

### Competition

The organizer lists a $250,000 prize pool, more than 1,000 applicants and ten finalists. The competition takes place at Marina Bay Sands during TOKEN2049 Singapore on 7-8 October. Startups must have been incorporated from 2023 onwards and raised less than $5 million in investments. Applying is free, and selection is merit-based. The jury includes Tom Schmidt (Dragonfly), Akshat Vaidya (Maelstrom) and Spencer Applebaum (Multicoin Capital).

### What finalists receive

Top ten finalists receive a complimentary startup stand, full TOKEN2049 access on 7-8 October, speaker perks including the speaker reception, networking drinks and lounge access, three complimentary team tickets, photography and session recordings, and event marketing coverage. The jury may make investment offers outside the prize grant.

### Final round

The final round takes place on 8 October 2026 as part of the TOKEN2049 Singapore program at Marina Bay Sands.

### Applications

NEXUS 2026 applications closed after the 18 September deadline, with the top 50 announcement on 21 September. The organizer is accepting waitlist registrations for NEXUS 2027.

## Origins Hackathon Prize Ceremony

- Record: `token2049-side-6aa41d6d8ffcc4e5ece10d0f`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-08T16:40:00+08:00

### About the event

The Origins prize ceremony concludes the TOKEN2049 Origins hackathon in Singapore. The organizer's 6-8 October program gives builders 36 hours to develop a working product, receive mentorship and demo on the TOKEN2049 stage at Marina Bay Sands.

### Prizes and tracks

The organizer lists a $150,000 prize pool. Tracks include agentic commerce on Cardano, workflows using the Chainlink Runtime Environment, multichain infrastructure with NOWNodes, and applications built on Solana. Teams compete for prizes, grants and accelerator opportunities, and standout teams pitch for funding and global recognition.

### Participation

Origins is free, including food, drinks and full access to the TOKEN2049 conference. Physical attendance at Marina Bay Sands is required for the full 36 hours; remote participation is not offered. Teams may have up to four members, and solo applicants are welcome. Applications opened on 19 August with participants announced on 28 September.

### Schedule

Registrations opened on 19 August with an application deadline of 18 September and participants announced on 28 September, ahead of the 6-8 October hackathon.

### Rules

To keep the competition fair, all project work must begin after the official hacking period starts. Participants may brainstorm ideas in advance, but no code, designs or prototypes before kickoff. The venue provides rest and chill-out spaces on a first-come, first-served basis.

### About Finality Forum

Held on 9 Oct 2026, Finality Forum is a full-day conference focused on institutional digital assets - with tracks across Infrastructure, Payments & Stablecoins, RWA & Tokenization, Agentic Commerce, Trading & Institutional Liquidity, and Institutional Privacy.

- Payments & Stablecoins: Where stablecoins stop being a crypto story and start being the global payments story.

Banks, asset managers, funds, exchanges, custodians, tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers, in one room, talking about what it actually takes to put regulated assets on public chains without getting burned.

What we will talk about

Tokenization at scale: what breaks when a fund, bond or money market structure moves on-chain. ERC-3643, ERC-4626 vaults, NAV oracles, transfer restrictions and the compliance layer around them. Lessons from Project Guardian pilots going to production.

Stablecoins as payment rails: MAS-regulated issuance, reserve attestations, mint and burn controls, blacklist and freeze functions, and where issuers have been exploited.

The institutional security bar: what a board, a regulator and a counterparty should be able to ask for before capital moves. Audits, formal verification, monitoring, key management, incident response.

What went wrong in 2026: a closed-door walk through the year's institutional-grade incidents, and what each one should have caught earlier.

### Format

Seated dinner for 21. Short opening from QuillAudits, then moderated conversation under Chatham House rules. No recording, no press, no slides.

Who is at the table

Heads of digital assets, treasury and product at banks and asset managers. Founders and CxOs of tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers. Fund partners with RWA and stablecoin exposure. Regulators and policy leads by invitation.

Seats are confirmed personally. Registering here is a request, not a confirmation. Venue in the Marina Bay area, shared with confirmed guests.

### About QuillAudits

8+ years securing Web3. 1,500+ audits, 1M+ lines reviewed. 20+ RWA and tokenization protocols audited including Plume, Lumia, Pharos and Zoth. Full lifecycle security: AI and human audits, formal verification, OpSec, multisig review and monitoring.

Friday's Formula 1 program at the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix includes the first practice session and Sprint Qualifying at the Marina Bay Street Circuit.

### Friday, 9 October

The track program runs on local Singapore time, eight hours ahead of UTC: Porsche Carrera Cup Asia practice at 14:05-14:50, the Formula 1 car presentation at 15:00-16:00, the first practice session at 16:30-17:30, the teams' press conference at 18:30-19:30, and Sprint Qualifying at 20:30-21:14. The Porsche Carrera Cup Asia support series shares the Friday program with its practice session.

### Circuit

The race takes place over 62 laps of the 4.927-kilometre Marina Bay Street Circuit. The official timetable is subject to change.

After a 2023 layout change the lap runs 19 corners over 4.927 kilometres, and the bumpy street surface plus humidity make it one of the most physically demanding races on the calendar.

### About the event

Members of Light DAO's leadership recently participated in Edge Esmeralda and came away feeling it was one of the most impressive, inspiring and transformative business gatherings we had ever experienced - because it was not a conference, retreat or summit.

It was a Society Incubator - an extraordinary integration of worlds that are rarely found in one place.

In a single day, you might:

Begin the morning with a tea ceremony, breathwork or yoga

Move into a talk with brilliant researchers, founders and investors on frontier science and emerging technology

Spend a few hours building software, testing experimental health wearables, collaborating in a maker space, or creating in a media lab

Head into nature, join a wellness session, or get absorbed in a discussion on the latest in AI agents, fintech or longevity

Continue the conversations over dinner late into the evening - or end the night with music, ecstatic dance or a calming sound bath

For families, dedicated programs for kids and teens, starting at age 4, offer opportunities to play, learn, create and build within their own community

Alongside all of this are deep conversations about consciousness, philosophy, society and human flourishing

It felt like stepping into a living laboratory for the future - a temporary village designed to explore and experiment with how we might live, work, learn, build and thrive differently.

It offered a glimpse of what the world could look like when innovation, human flourishing and community are developed together.

### This is Edge City

Edge Cities are 3-4 week Living Labs and Society Incubators - international popup villages where frontier technology, science, entrepreneurship, consciousness, culture, art, well-being and community are not separate tracks, but part of one shared environment.

Edge Cities have already taken place in Patagonia, Chiang Mai, Cape Town and Esmeralda, two hours north of San Francisco.

Edge Esmeralda - June 2026

- 850 residents from 60+ countries
- Nearly 300 stayed for the full month
- 800+ sessions and experiments
- Families came with 48 kids

What made it so extraordinary was being surrounded by brilliant, conscious innovators genuinely committed to advancing humanity - with enough time together for real relationships, collaborations and radical ideas to develop.

www.EdgeEsmeralda.com (https://www.EdgeEsmeralda.com)

That experience convinced us that Edge City offers something unusually valuable for the Light DAO community.

So this October, we're taking our community to the next Edge City.

### The Next Edge City: Goa, India

October 11 - November 1, 2026

We're taking our community to Edge India in Goa - a three-week Living Lab and Society Incubator with hundreds of participants, approximately 65% coming from outside India.

Light DAO will have our own RESIDENCY within the larger Edge India community, so our members can take part in the full Edge experience while also connecting more intimately with our own community.

### A Living Lab Created by Its Community

One of the things that makes Edge Cities especially unique and powerful is its unconference-style format. Much of the experience is created by the participants themselves - through the talks, demos, experiments and working groups they lead around the ideas and projects they care most about.

Light DAO will also host more intimate gatherings within our own Residency, led by our guests.

Once registered, Light DAO Owner Members are welcome to contact us with ideas you might like to lead or contribute to. We can't guarantee a place in either the Light DAO or Edge programming, but we'd love to hear what you are most excited to share.

That participatory spirit is part of what makes Edge a true Living Lab: the community does not simply attend the experience - it helps create it.

### A Special Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency

We're delighted to be partnering with SingularityNET for a 3-week Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency at Edge India. This is the first collaboration of its kind we've run with the SingularityNET team.

Everyone racing toward AGI is making the same bet: that a bigger model gets there. SingularityNET is not.

Led by Dr. Ben Goertzel, who launched the term and concept of Artificial General Intelligence, the team scales Beneficial General Intelligence on Hyperon, a cognitive architecture with two decades of research behind it. It holds knowledge, goals and decisions in a form you can inspect, shows its reasoning, and runs under explicit permissions - which is what makes it deployable inside real institutions.

The residency puts you in the room with the people building it. Talks, working sessions and open build time for developers, founders, researchers, investors, and anyone serious about AGI, ASI and beneficial technology.

Bring what you are already building. Leave with something concrete: a technical integration, a partnership, an investment conversation, or a prototype you put together on-site at Edge India.

### Why Join the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency?

In addition to the full Edge India experience, our Residency gives you a more intimate community to connect, collaborate and build with throughout your stay, including:

Light DAO + SingularityNET talks, working sessions and open build time

More intimate conversations and collaborations within our residency group, particularly with SingularityNET's leadership and tech team.

Light DAO-organized meals, including opportunities for participants to lead topic conversations

Optional group outings and shared experiences

Opportunities for Light DAO Owner Members to propose topics they may want to lead or contribute to

A shared home base at our beachfront resort

Think of our residency as your home community within the larger Edge India Living Lab.

### What Makes Edge Cities a Unique Living Lab + Society Incubator

Hear Edge Cities co-founder Timour Kosters talk about the multidisciplinary, multigenerational and global vision behind Edge Cities - including its unconference format and experiments.

He shares how the experience stretches people's sense of what is possible, helps them embody that expansion, and activates new collaborations and directions. In 1-3 weeks, many participants accelerate results that might otherwise have taken months or longer.

The Edge experience is designed around focused work, collaboration, wellness, community and time to enjoy Goa.

Your Edge Pass includes the full Edge India experience - programming, coworking, wellness, community gatherings and more.

### Pricing

Edge India Pass

Prices increase weekly

- 2-3 weeks (same price): $1,500-$2,000
- 1 week: $750-$1,000
- Day pass: $150-$200
- Indian citizens: 50% discount

Our Beachfront 4-Star Resort

www.RivaResorts.com (https://www.RivaResorts.com)

Our Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency will be based at Edge India's central hotel.

- Private room + breakfast: $100 per room/night
- Lunch + dinner: approximately $30 - 50/day
  Your choice - at the resort or anywhere in Goa

Yes - you get your own private room. At $100/night including breakfast, this is an exceptional value for a beachfront 4-star resort.

If you're coming as a couple, it is the same $100/night including breakfast for 2!

Roommates also the same $100/night!

Lunches, dinners and excursions are paid individually, giving you the flexibility to join our residency plans, other Edge activities, or your own plans in Goa.

### Joining the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency

Edge Cities are curated communities with an application and approval process.

Light DAO Owner Members and friends we already know:

Please RSVP here on Luma. You will automatically be approved to Edge India through our Residency.

If you are new to us:

Please RSVP here on Luma and complete the registration questions thoughtfully. Thank you.

Once approved through the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency, you will not need to complete a separate Edge City application.

Ready to Join?

Choose one of the two ticket options above.

Once approved, we'll send you:

- the direct link to purchase your Edge ticket at the current lowest price
- the resort reservation link

Come experience our collaboration between Edge Cities, SingularityNET and Light DAO - where frontier ideas, deep community and real opportunities to build and collaborate come together in one Living Lab.

You may leave with a partnership, a prototype, a new collaborator, or an entirely new direction you had not imagined before joining this unique Society Incubator.

### About the event

The Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2026 takes place over 62 laps of the 4.927-kilometre Marina Bay Street Circuit on Sunday, 11 October.

### Sunday race program

The track program runs on local Singapore time, eight hours ahead of UTC: the Porsche Carrera Cup Asia second race at 15:40-16:15, the drivers' parade at 18:00-18:30, the national anthem at 19:44-19:46, and the Grand Prix of 62 laps or 120 minutes at 20:00-22:00.

### Circuit

The Marina Bay Circuit is a street track with the city's skyline as its backdrop and has hosted the night race since 2008. The official timetable is subject to change.

The Marina Bay Circuit arrived on the scene in 2008 with the city skyline as its backdrop, hosting the first night-time race in Formula 1 history. After a 2023 layout change the lap runs 19 corners over 4.927 kilometres, and the bumpy street surface plus humidity make it one of the most physically demanding races on the calendar.

### Following the weekend

The sessions can be followed live on F1 TV, with tickets and hospitality packages available through Formula 1 official channels.

## AI x Crypto: Innovation, Efficiency and Staying Safe in a New Digital Economy

### AI x Crypto: Innovation, Efficiency and Staying Safe in a New Digital Economy

Artificial intelligence is rapidly reshaping the crypto and blockchain landscape, moving beyond basic automation into smart research, dynamic risk management, and adaptive trading tools that can help users process information and navigate increasingly complex digital markets.

However, operating at the speed of AI presents a fresh set of challenges. Fast execution, complex automated tools, and shifting market environments mean users need to understand not just the opportunities, but how to navigate potential technical limits and emerging risks safely.

Join this educational discussion to explore the opportunities and challenges at the intersection of AI and crypto. We will look at how AI is transforming the sector, what users should be aware of, and the practical steps everyone can take to use emerging tools more safely and responsibly.

### Discussion Topics

- How AI is transforming crypto: The role of AI in blockchain products, user experiences, data analysis, customer support, security monitoring and operational efficiency.
- New products and opportunities: How AI-enabled tools are changing the way people interact with wallets, decentralised applications, market information and digital-asset platforms.
- Efficiency and automation: Where AI can help simplify complex processes, improve access to information and support better decision-making.
- Understanding Tool Capabilities & Limits: Knowing what AI can and cannot do
- Responsible Adoption & Oversight: Building the core financial knowledge and critical-thinking habits needed to guide AI tools safely, rather than relying on them blindly.

### Schedule

- 6.30pm - Welcome, registration and check in
- 7.15pm - Fireside chat
- 7.45pm - Networking drinks and pizzas
- 9:30pm - Doors close

### Speakers

Simon Babakhani - CEO, Zebec

As Zebec's co-founder, Simon brings 10+ years of leadership experience from senior roles in private equity and advisory at Breyer Capital, Parthenon, and Oliver Wyman

Lucia Camarillo- Marketing Manager UK, Bitget (moderator)

A seasoned marketing professional with nine years of global, in-house experience - including over three years specialising in the Web3 sector - driving growth across startups, scale-ups, and established enterprises. She is currently Marketing Manager at Bitget, a leading crypto exchange serving over 125 million users worldwide. Passionate about making Web3 accessible, Lucia frequently shares her expertise through industry conferences and webinars. Specialising in integrated field marketing, she designs high-impact experiences that accelerate demand, build robust pipelines, and deepen customer engagement across the Fintech landscape.

### About Zebec

https://zebec.io/

Zebec is a leader in global stablecoin payroll, processing $500M+ in volume across 280+ enterprise clients. Since 2021, we've built an ecosystem spanning payroll, payments, banking infrastructure, and multi-chain Mastercard-backed cards, enabling enterprises to pay employees globally in real time and give them instant access to their funds.

### About Bitget

https://www.bitget.com/en-GB

Bitget is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange serving over 125 million users worldwide. In the UK market, the platform delivers an innovation-driven spot trading experience featuring access to over 200 digital assets. Backed by a 300 million dollar protection fund and advanced security infrastructure, Bitget actively drives mainstream crypto adoption through structured educational initiatives, including its Blockchain4Youth and Blockchain4Her programs. Furthermore, as part of its global impact strategy, Bitget has partnered with UNICEF to provide essential blockchain education to 1.1 million people by 2027.

### About Encode

https://www.encodeclub.com/

A global developer community empowering builders through hackathons, accelerators, and educational programmes. They also offer a vibrant coworking space (https://hub.encodeclub.com/) in the heart of Shoreditch, London!

## XRP LEDGER HACKATHON

- Record: `w3v-xrp-ledger-hackathon`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-24T12:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed

### About the event

Sprint, build, and launch on the XRP Ledger in 36 hours in New York City, the weekend before Swell (https://swell.ripple.com/).

Hosted by XRPL Commons (https://www.xrpl-commons.org), this hackathon brings hackers into the room where the ecosystem's institutions, investors, and decision-makers are already gathered - with a project and a story to tell. Whether this is your first commit on XRP Ledger or you've been building for years, there's a track for you.

### 4 Tracks

- Protocol Innovation: work on the ledger itself: amendments, client implementations, tooling. Paired with a 3-day Core Dev Bootcamp (Oct 20-22) (http://luma.com/xrpl-core-dev-bootcamp2) as your on-ramp.
- Agentic Finance: build the rails that let autonomous agents transact on-chain safely and at machine speed.
- Lending & Borrowing: build on top of the XRP Ledger Lending Protocol (XLS-66) and Single Asset Vaults (XLS-65), currently in validator voting.
- Why Not: the open lane, for whatever XRP Ledger project you can't stop thinking about.

### Already Building?

Bring an existing project - on XRP Ledger or elsewhere - and use the 36 hours to add XRPL rails or ship a new feature. Only what you build during the hackathon counts toward judging.

### Registration details

Should the event be oversubscribed, we may ask attendees to place a small refundable deposit to confirm their spot.

By registering for this event, you consent to being photographed and filmed, and to the use of these photos/videos for promotional purposes.

All participants are required to agree with and adhere to the code of conduct (https://swell.ripple.com/code-of-conduct)
